meanings.definition: Used when talking about one person or thing that is not special or specific.
meanings.definition_cn: 一个（指不特定的人或事物）
meanings.example: I found a tiny ladybug crawling on my shoe.
meanings.example_cn: 我在鞋子上发现了一只小瓢虫在爬。

meanings.definition: Having the skill or power to do something.
meanings.example: I am able to tie my own shoes now.
meanings.example_cn: 我现在能自己系鞋带了。

meanings.definition: On the topic of something.
meanings.example: Mom read a story about dinosaurs before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈在睡觉前读了一个关于恐龙的故事。

meanings.definition: Almost or close to a number or amount, but not exactly.
meanings.example: There are about twenty kids in my class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班大约有二十个孩子。

meanings.definition: In a higher place than something else.
meanings.example: The aeroplane flew above the clouds.
meanings.example_cn: 飞机飞到了云层的上方。

meanings.definition: More than a certain number or amount.
meanings.example: You need to score above eighty points to get a prize.
meanings.example_cn: 你需要得到八十分以上才能获奖。

meanings.definition: To take something offered.
meanings.example: Please accept this small gift as a thank you.
meanings.example_cn: 请收下这份小礼物作为感谢。

meanings.definition: To say “yes” to it.
meanings.example: She was happy to accept the invitation to Sam’s birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 她很高兴接受萨姆生日派对的邀请。

meanings.definition: Someone or something that is very good at what they do.
meanings.example: She is an ace at solving tricky puzzles.
meanings.example_cn: 她很擅长解各种棘手的谜题。

meanings.definition: A playing card with a single spot or symbol on it.
meanings.example: He pulled the ace of spades from the deck during the card game.
meanings.example_cn: 打牌时他从牌堆里抽出了黑桃A。

meanings.definition: To do really well or get a very high score on something.
meanings.example: She aced her spelling test and got every word right.
meanings.example_cn: 她拼写测验得了满分，每个单词都拼对了。

meanings.definition: A pain that doesn’t go away.
meanings.example: After running around all day, Mia had an ache in her legs.
meanings.example_cn: 跑了一整天之后，米娅的腿又酸又疼。

meanings.definition: To have a pain that stays and does not go away.
meanings.example: My legs ache after running around at recess.
meanings.example_cn: 课间跑来跑去之后，我的腿又酸又疼。

meanings.definition: To finish something successfully after trying.
meanings.example: You can achieve your goals with practice and hard work.
meanings.example_cn: 通过练习和努力，你可以实现自己的目标。

meanings.definition: To get something, often by working for it or learning it.
meanings.definition_cn: 获得；取得（常指通过努力或学习）
meanings.example: I hope to acquire new skills in art class.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望能在美术课上学到新技能。

meanings.definition: Going from one side to the other side of something.
meanings.example: We ran across the playground to the swings.
meanings.example_cn: 我们跑过操场去玩秋千。

meanings.definition: To perform a part in a film, play, etc.
meanings.definition_cn: 表演（电影、戏剧等中的角色）
meanings.example: I will act in the school play next month.
meanings.example_cn: 下个月我要在学校话剧里表演。

meanings.definition: To behave in a certain way.
meanings.example: Please act politely when you visit someone’s house.
meanings.example_cn: 去别人家拜访的时候，请举止有礼。

meanings.definition: Something that someone does, like a good deed.
meanings.example: Helping a friend is a kind act.
meanings.example_cn: 帮助朋友是一件善举。

meanings.definition: A person who pretends to be someone else in a play or movie.
meanings.example: My brother wants to be an actor and perform on stage.
meanings.example_cn: 我哥哥想当一名演员，在舞台上表演。

meanings.definition: To change so that you can fit new conditions or situations.
meanings.definition_cn: 适应；调整以适应新环境
meanings.example: Animals adapt to their habitats in clever ways.
meanings.example_cn: 动物用巧妙的方式适应自己的栖息地。

meanings.definition: To put things together to make a bigger amount.
meanings.example: Let’s add these numbers to see the total.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们把这些数字加起来看看总数。

meanings.definition: To put in extra or more of something.
meanings.example: Can you add more cheese to my pizza?
meanings.example_cn: 你能在我的披萨上多加些奶酪吗？

meanings.definition: To make a small change to something so it fits better.
meanings.example: I had to adjust my chair so I could reach the table.
meanings.example_cn: 我得调整一下椅子，才能够到桌子。

meanings.definition: To look at someone or something with respect or pleasure.
meanings.example: I really admire how bravely you tried the new slide.
meanings.example_cn: 我真的很佩服你勇敢地去尝试那个新滑梯。

meanings.definition: To say something is true, even if it’s hard to say.
meanings.example: Lily had to admit she broke the vase.
meanings.example_cn: 莉莉不得不承认是她打碎了花瓶。

meanings.definition: To allow someone to enter a place.
meanings.example: Only students with a library card will be admitted into the reading room.
meanings.example_cn: 只有持有借书证的学生才可以进入阅览室。

meanings.definition: To take something as your own, like a pet or an idea.
meanings.example: We might adopt a kitten from the animal shelter.
meanings.example_cn: 我们可能会从动物收容所领养一只小猫。

meanings.definition: A grown-up person.
meanings.example: You need to be an adult to drive a car.
meanings.example_cn: 你得是个成年人才能开车。

meanings.definition: Something that is meant for grown-ups.
meanings.example: You can’t go into that part of the swimming pool because it’s for adult swimmers only.
meanings.example_cn: 你不能进入泳池的那个区域，那里只供成年游泳者使用。

meanings.definition: To tell someone what you think they should do.
meanings.example: My teacher will advise me on which books to read.
meanings.example_cn: 我的老师会建议我读哪些书。

meanings.definition: To make something change in some way.
meanings.example: Not getting enough sleep can affect your mood.
meanings.example_cn: 睡眠不足会影响你的心情。

meanings.definition: Happening later than something else.
meanings.example: We ate dessert after dinner was finished.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭结束后我们吃了甜点。

meanings.definition: Following something else.
meanings.example: The students lined up after their teacher in the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 学生们在走廊里跟在老师后面排队。

meanings.definition: Doing something one more time or repeating it.
meanings.example: Can we visit the zoo again next weekend?
meanings.example_cn: 下周末我们能再去动物园吗？

meanings.definition: The number of years someone or something has lived.
meanings.example: At the age of seven, I learned how to ride a bike.
meanings.example_cn: 七岁时我学会了骑自行车。

meanings.definition: To grow older or become old.
meanings.example: Cheese needs time to age before it's ready to eat.
meanings.example_cn: 奶酪需要时间发酵才能吃。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about something that happened in the past.
meanings.definition_cn: 以前；（用于谈论过去）……之前
meanings.example: I visited my grandparents two weeks ago.
meanings.example_cn: 两个礼拜前我去看望了祖父母。

meanings.definition: To say “yes” to something.
meanings.example: I agree to help you build the tall block tower after school.
meanings.example_cn: 我同意放学后帮你搭那座高高的积木塔。

meanings.definition: To be the same as someone else in thinking or opinion.
meanings.definition_cn: （在想法或意见上）与某人一致
meanings.example: We both agree that chocolate ice cream is the best flavour.
meanings.example_cn: 我们都同意巧克力冰淇淋是最好的口味。

meanings.definition: In front of.
meanings.example: The blue car is ahead of us in the line.
meanings.example_cn: 那辆蓝色的车排在我们前面。

meanings.definition: Happening before something else.
meanings.example: She finished her homework ahead of everyone else.
meanings.example_cn: 她比其他所有人都早写完了作业。

meanings.definition: Help or support that you give to someone who needs it.
meanings.example: The nurse gave aid to the student who scraped her knee.
meanings.example_cn: 护士给那个擦破膝盖的学生提供了帮助。

meanings.definition: To give help or support to someone.
meanings.example: Can you aid me with carrying these heavy books?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我搬这些很重的书吗？

meanings.definition: A goal you want to reach.
meanings.example: My aim is to get better at piano this year.
meanings.example_cn: 我的目标是在今年把钢琴弹得更好。

meanings.definition: To try hard to reach something you want or hope to do.
meanings.example: If you aim to finish your homework before dinner, you’ll have more time to play.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你想在晚饭前完成作业，就会有更多时间玩。

meanings.definition: To point something at a target or goal.
meanings.example: Please aim the ball at the basket before you throw it.
meanings.example_cn: 投掷之前请把球对准篮筐。

meanings.definition: The gas all around us that we breathe.
meanings.example: Take a deep breath of fresh air outside.
meanings.example_cn: 到户外深深呼吸一口新鲜空气。

meanings.definition: The open sky above us.
meanings.example: Kites fly high up in the air on windy days.
meanings.example_cn: 在有风的日子里，风筝飞得很高。

meanings.definition: To let fresh air get to something.
meanings.example: Open the window to air out the room.
meanings.example_cn: 打开窗户给房间通通风。

meanings.definition: To tell or warn someone that something might be wrong or dangerous, so they can be ready or careful.
meanings.example: The loud siren will alarm people if there’s a fire.
meanings.example_cn: 如果着火了，响亮的警报声会让人们警觉起来。

meanings.definition: A loud noise that warns of danger.
meanings.example: The fire alarm rang loudly and everyone left the building.
meanings.example_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来，所有人都离开了大楼。

meanings.definition: A device or sound that wakes you up or reminds you to do something.
meanings.example: The alarm woke me up early for school.
meanings.example_cn: 闹钟早早把我叫醒，该去上学了。

meanings.definition: A book to keep photos or music in.
meanings.example: We looked at our family photo album together last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天晚上我们一起翻看了家里的相册。

meanings.definition: Paying close attention to what’s happening.
meanings.example: The dog stayed alert while watching the house.
meanings.example_cn: 那只狗看家的时候一直保持警觉。

meanings.definition: A notice or signal that warns you something important or dangerous is happening.
meanings.example: We got an alert on the school speaker that it was time for a safety drill.
meanings.example_cn: 学校广播发出了通知，告诉我们该进行安全演练了。

meanings.definition: A creature from another planet.
meanings.example: In the movie, an alien came to visit Earth.
meanings.example_cn: 在电影里，一个外星人来到地球拜访。

meanings.definition: Very different, strange.
meanings.example: The creature looked alien with its bright green skin and three eyes.
meanings.example_cn: 那个生物有着鲜绿色的皮肤和三只眼睛，看起来怪怪的。

meanings.definition: Having life and not being dead.
meanings.example: The tiny bird was hurt, but it was still alive.
meanings.example_cn: 那只小鸟受伤了，但它还活着。

meanings.definition: The whole amount or every part.
meanings.example: All the cookies disappeared during the party.
meanings.example_cn: 派对期间所有饼干都不见了。

meanings.definition: In a complete way or totally.
meanings.example: He was all wet after running through the sprinkler.
meanings.example_cn: 他跑过喷水器后浑身都湿了。

meanings.definition: A narrow street or path.
meanings.example: We played basketball in the alley behind our house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在房子后面的小巷里打篮球。

meanings.definition: A big reptile with a long mouth, sharp teeth, and a strong tail.
meanings.example: We watched an alligator sunbathe at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在动物园看了一只短吻鳄晒太阳。

meanings.definition: To let something happen.
meanings.example: Dad will allow us to have ice cream after dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会允许我们晚饭后吃冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: Very close to happening but not quite.
meanings.example: I almost finished the book before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 睡前我几乎读完了这本书。

meanings.definition: By yourself.
meanings.example: After school, Max waited alone for his mom to pick him up.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后，马克斯独自等着妈妈来接他。

meanings.definition: Feeling sad because you don’t have anyone with you.
meanings.example: After moving to a new city, Jake sometimes felt alone because he hadn’t made any friends yet.
meanings.example_cn: 搬到一座新城市之后，杰克有时候会感到孤单，因为他还没有交到任何朋友。

meanings.definition: Following a path.
meanings.example: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
meanings.example_cn: 我们沿着河边散步，看鸭子。

meanings.definition: Something that has happened before now.
meanings.example: I already finished my chores this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我今天早上已经做完了家务。

meanings.definition: Adding another thing, like saying "too" or "as well."
meanings.example: I like apples, and I also like bananas.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢苹果，也喜欢香蕉。

meanings.definition: Another choice or a different option.
meanings.definition_cn: 另一种选择；可替代的东西
meanings.example: Walking is a good alternative to driving short distances.
meanings.example_cn: 短途出行时，走路是开车的很好的替代方式。

meanings.definition: A word used to show two things are different or surprising together.
meanings.example: Although it was raining, we still had fun inside.
meanings.example_cn: 虽然下着雨，我们在室内仍然玩得很开心。

meanings.definition: Happening at every time or never stopping.
meanings.example: I always brush my teeth before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我总是在睡前刷牙。

meanings.definition: To surprise someone very much.
meanings.example: The magic trick will amaze everyone at the party.
meanings.example_cn: 这个魔术会让派对上的每个人都大吃一惊。

meanings.definition: A yellow-orange colour.
meanings.example: The traffic light turned amber, warning the cars to slow down.
meanings.example_cn: 交通信号灯变成了黄灯，提醒车辆减速。

meanings.definition: A hard, yellow-orange substance formed from tree resin that is often used as a gemstone in jewellery.
meanings.example: The necklace had a beautiful piece of amber set in the middle.
meanings.example_cn: 项链中间镶嵌着一块漂亮的琥珀。

meanings.definition: A special vehicle used to take sick or hurt people to the hospital.
meanings.example: The ambulance rushed to help the injured cyclist.
meanings.example_cn: 救护车赶去帮助那位受伤的骑行者。

meanings.definition: In the middle of or surrounded by other things or people.
meanings.example: There were many ladybugs among the flowers.
meanings.example_cn: 花丛中有许多瓢虫。

meanings.definition: Used before a word that starts with a vowel sound to mean one thing that is not specific.
meanings.definition_cn: 一个（用于元音音素开头的词前，指不特定的）
meanings.example: I saw an amazing rainbow after the rain stopped.
meanings.example_cn: 雨停后我看到了一道美丽的彩虹。

meanings.definition: A word used to join two things or ideas together.
meanings.definition_cn: 和；与（用来连接两个事物或想法）
meanings.example: Lily likes to draw and paint colourful pictures.
meanings.example_cn: 莉莉喜欢画色彩斑斓的画。

meanings.definition: A strong feeling when you are mad.
meanings.example: She tried to hide her anger when she lost the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛输了，她努力掩饰自己的怒气。

meanings.definition: The space where two lines meet.
meanings.example: The math teacher asked the class to measure the angle between the two lines.
meanings.example_cn: 数学老师让同学们测量这两条线之间的角度。

meanings.definition: Feeling very mad.
meanings.example: I felt angry when someone took my favourite toy without asking.
meanings.example_cn: 当有人没问就拿走我最喜欢的玩具时，我很生气。

meanings.definition: A living thing that moves and is not a plant.
meanings.example: My favourite animal at the zoo is the giraffe.
meanings.example_cn: 我在动物园最喜欢的动物是长颈鹿。

meanings.definition: The part between your foot and your leg.
meanings.example: Lucy twisted her ankle while jumping off the swing.
meanings.example_cn: 露西从秋千上跳下来时扭到了脚踝。

meanings.definition: To make someone a little angry.
meanings.example: The buzzing fly began to annoy me during lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭时，那只嗡嗡叫的苍蝇开始让我烦。

meanings.definition: One more of the same kind.
meanings.example: May I please have another cookie?
meanings.example_cn: 我可以再要一块饼干吗？

meanings.definition: A different one from before.
meanings.example: I didn’t like that book, so I chose another from the shelf.
meanings.example_cn: 我不喜欢那本书，所以从架子上另选了一本。

meanings.definition: To expect something and prepare for it.
meanings.example: I anticipate having lots of fun at the birthday party tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我期待明天在生日派对上玩得很开心。

meanings.definition: Feeling worried or nervous about something.
meanings.example: I felt anxious before my first day at a new school.
meanings.example_cn: 刚转学的第一天我感到很焦虑。

meanings.definition: Even just one, or whatever amount there is, no matter how small.
meanings.definition_cn: 哪怕只有一个，或是不管数量有多少
meanings.example: Do you have any pencils I could borrow?
meanings.example_cn: 你有什么铅笔可以借给我吗？

meanings.definition: Anyone or anything, it doesn’t matter which.
meanings.example: Any game is better than being bored.
meanings.example_cn: 任何游戏都比无聊要好。

meanings.definition: Any person, so it could be anyone.
meanings.example: Is there anybody who knows the answer?
meanings.example_cn: 有谁知道答案吗？

meanings.definition: Any person at all.
meanings.example: Anyone can join the science club after school.
meanings.example_cn: 任何人放学后都可以加入科学俱乐部。

meanings.definition: Any thing, no matter what it is.
meanings.example: I can do anything if I try my best.
meanings.example_cn: 只要我尽力，我什么都能做。

meanings.definition: In or to any place at all.
meanings.example: You can find dandelions almost anywhere in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 公园里几乎到处都能找到蒲公英。

meanings.definition: Separated by some space.
meanings.example: The puzzle pieces were spread apart on the table.
meanings.example_cn: 拼图碎片散开放在桌子上。

meanings.definition: To show you like something by clapping your hands.
meanings.example: The whole audience began to applaud after the amazing performance.
meanings.example_cn: 精彩的表演结束后，全场观众都开始鼓掌。

meanings.definition: A round fruit that can be red, green, or yellow.
meanings.example: I picked a shiny red apple from the tree.
meanings.example_cn: 我从树上摘了一个鲜亮的红苹果。

meanings.definition: To be thankful for something.
meanings.example: I really appreciate when my friends help me clean up.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友帮我打扫卫生时，我真的很感激。

meanings.definition: To fully understand the value or meaning of something.
meanings.definition_cn: 充分理解（其价值或意义）
meanings.example: I really appreciate how much my parents help me with my schoolwork.
meanings.example_cn: 我非常感激父母在学业上帮我那么多。

meanings.definition: To move closer to someone or something.
meanings.example: Let's approach the puppy slowly so we don't scare him.
meanings.example_cn: 我们慢慢走近那只小狗，以免吓到它。

meanings.definition: A particular method or way of doing something.
meanings.example: We need a different approach to solve this maths problem.
meanings.example_cn: 解决这道数学题我们需要换一种方法。

meanings.definition: To say “yes”.
meanings.example: My parents will approve my sleepover if I finish my homework first.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我先做完作业，父母会同意我去朋友家过夜。

meanings.definition: To think something is good or right.
meanings.example: The teacher really seemed to approve of my creative drawing in art class.
meanings.example_cn: 老师似乎很欣赏我在美术课上的创意画。

meanings.definition: The fourth month of the year.
meanings.example: My birthday is in April, and I love springtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我的生日在四月，我喜欢春天。

meanings.definition: A part or section of a place or space.
meanings.example: We played in the grassy area behind our house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在房子后面那片草地上玩。

meanings.definition: To disagree with someone, often by talking loudly.
meanings.definition_cn: 争论；争吵（常指大声争论）
meanings.example: My brother and I sometimes argue about which game to play.
meanings.example_cn: 我和哥哥有时会因为玩哪个游戏而争吵。

meanings.definition: The part of your body between your shoulder and hand.
meanings.example: My arm got tired after painting the big poster.
meanings.example_cn: 画完大海报后我的胳膊酸了。

meanings.definition: To give someone weapons.
meanings.example: The knight was armed with a sword and shield.
meanings.example_cn: 骑士佩戴着剑与盾牌。

meanings.definition: To get ready to take action or do something important.
meanings.example: The team armed themselves with water bottles before the big race.
meanings.example_cn: 大赛前，队员们都准备好了水壶。

meanings.definition: A large group of soldiers.
meanings.example: The army marched through the city during the parade.
meanings.example_cn: 游行期间，军队列队穿过城市。

meanings.definition: In a circle or all over something.
meanings.example: We sat around the campfire and told stories.
meanings.example_cn: 我们围坐在篝火旁讲故事。

meanings.definition: Close to a certain number or amount, like about.
meanings.example: There are around twenty students in my class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班大约有二十名学生。

meanings.definition: To put things in a neat order.
meanings.example: Let's arrange the chairs in a circle for the game.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们把椅子摆成一圈来玩游戏。

meanings.definition: To make plans or organise something.
meanings.example: We need to arrange a time to practice our dance.
meanings.example_cn: 我们需要安排一个时间来练习舞蹈。

meanings.definition: A thin stick with a sharp tip for shooting.
meanings.example: The archer pulled back the bow and let the arrow fly toward the target.
meanings.example_cn: 弓箭手拉开弓，把箭射向靶子。

meanings.definition: A simple shape, usually a line with a pointed end, that shows direction.
meanings.example: The sign had an arrow pointing to the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 指示牌上有一个箭头指向操场。

meanings.definition: Things like painting, drawing, or making music.
meanings.example: I love making art with colourful paints and markers.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢用彩色的颜料和马克笔创作艺术。

meanings.definition: To act in a certain role.
meanings.example: He dressed up as a superhero for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 他扮成超级英雄去参加派对。

meanings.definition: In the same way or manner as something else.
meanings.example: Try to write as neatly as you can.
meanings.example_cn: 尽量写得像你能做到的那样工整。

meanings.definition: The soft, grey powder left after something burns.
meanings.example: A little bit of ash fell from the campfire.
meanings.example_cn: 篝火落下了一点灰烬。

meanings.definition: Feeling bad or sorry because you did something wrong.
meanings.example: He felt ashamed after breaking the vase, but he said sorry.
meanings.example_cn: 打碎花瓶后他很羞愧，但他道了歉。

meanings.definition: To one side.
meanings.example: She stepped aside so her friend could pass by.
meanings.example_cn: 她往旁边站了站，好让朋友过去。

meanings.definition: To say something because you want an answer or help.
meanings.definition_cn: 询问；提问（想要答案或帮助）
meanings.example: You can ask the teacher if you don’t understand.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你不明白，可以问老师。

meanings.definition: To make a request for something.
meanings.example: I will ask my mom for permission to visit my friend's house.
meanings.example_cn: 我要征得妈妈的同意，去朋友家做客。

meanings.definition: To gather in one place.
meanings.example: Let's assemble in the gym before the school play begins.
meanings.example_cn: 学校话剧开始前，我们在体育馆集合。

meanings.definition: To put parts together to make a whole.
meanings.example: Dad and I will assemble the new bookshelf after dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭后爸爸和我将一起组装新书架。

meanings.definition: To decide how good or important something is.
meanings.example: The teacher will assess our reading skills at the end of the week.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会在周末评估我们的阅读能力。

meanings.definition: To help someone do something.
meanings.example: Can you assist me in carrying these heavy books?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我搬这些很重的书吗？

meanings.definition: To tell someone something to make them feel sure.
meanings.example: I assure you that your secret is safe with me.
meanings.example_cn: 我向你保证，你的秘密我会保守好。

meanings.definition: Used to show the exact time something happens.
meanings.definition_cn: 表示某事发生的确切时间
meanings.example: The movie will start at 7 o’clock.
meanings.example_cn: 电影将在 7 点钟开始。

meanings.definition: In a certain place or position.
meanings.example: She sat at the front of the classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 她坐在教室的前排。

meanings.definition: To try to do something.
meanings.example: I will attempt to finish my puzzle before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我会在睡前试着完成我的拼图。

meanings.definition: A try to do something.
meanings.example: Her first attempt at baking cookies turned out great.
meanings.example_cn: 她第一次烤饼干就烤得很好。

meanings.definition: To go to an event or place.
meanings.example: We will attend the school play this Friday.
meanings.example_cn: 这周五我们要去看学校的戏剧表演。

meanings.definition: The way you think or feel about something.
meanings.example: Having a positive attitude makes every day better.
meanings.example_cn: 积极的态度会让每一天都更好。

meanings.definition: To pull something or someone closer.
meanings.example: The bright flowers attract butterflies to the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到花园里来。

meanings.definition: The eighth month of the year.
meanings.example: August is usually the hottest month of the year.
meanings.example_cn: 八月通常是一年中最热的月份。

meanings.definition: Describes something impressive, important, or noble.
meanings.definition_cn: 威严的；庄严的；令人敬重的
meanings.example: The princess entered the hall with an august presence that made everyone stop and stare in admiration.
meanings.example_cn: 公主带着威严的气度走进大厅，让大家都不禁驻足赞叹。

meanings.definition: Your mum’s or dad’s sister, or your uncle’s wife.
meanings.example: My aunt took me to the zoo for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我姑姑带我去动物园过生日。

meanings.definition: The season when the leaves fall off the trees.
meanings.example: We rake the colourful leaves in autumn.
meanings.example_cn: 秋天我们用耙子收集彩色的落叶。

meanings.definition: To stay away from something.
meanings.example: We cross the street to avoid the big puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 我们过马路，好绕开那个大水坑。

meanings.definition: Not asleep.
meanings.example: I was still awake when the clock struck midnight.
meanings.example_cn: 钟敲响十二点的时候我还醒着。

meanings.definition: To give a prize to someone for doing something well.
meanings.example: The teacher will award a gold star to the student who reads the most books.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会给读书最多的学生颁发一颗金星。

meanings.definition: A special prize given for doing something well.
meanings.example: She won an award for her beautiful singing in the school contest.
meanings.example_cn: 她在学校比赛中因美妙的歌声而获奖。

meanings.definition: Knowing about something.
meanings.example: Sam was aware that the test was tomorrow, so he studied extra hard.
meanings.example_cn: 萨姆知道明天要考试，所以他格外努力地学习。

meanings.definition: When you are paying attention and being careful about what is happening around you.
meanings.example: Be aware of cars when you cross the road.
meanings.example_cn: 过马路的时候要注意车辆。

meanings.definition: Not in a place, or not here.
meanings.example: When the teacher looked for David, he was away from his desk.
meanings.example_cn: 老师找戴维的时候，他不在自己的课桌旁。

meanings.definition: Far from this place.
meanings.example: Our cousins live far away from us.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的表亲们住得离我们很远。

meanings.definition: Very bad.
meanings.example: The milk smelled awful, so we threw it out.
meanings.example_cn: 牛奶闻起来坏透了，所以我们把它倒掉了。

meanings.definition: A very young child who cannot walk or talk yet.
meanings.example: The baby laughed when I made a funny face.
meanings.example_cn: 我做鬼脸时婴儿笑了。

meanings.definition: To move towards where you started.
meanings.example: We walked back to the house after the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束后我们走回了家。

meanings.definition: The part furthest behind, or towards the rear.
meanings.example: The dog has a white spot on its back.
meanings.example_cn: 这只狗背上有一块白斑。

meanings.definition: To help someone or agree with what they are doing.
meanings.example: My friends always back me up when I need help.
meanings.example_cn: 当我需要帮助时，朋友们总是支持我。

meanings.definition: Meat from a pig that is usually cooked and eaten for breakfast.
meanings.example: I had crispy bacon and eggs for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我早餐吃了脆培根和鸡蛋。

meanings.definition: Not good or pleasant.
meanings.example: It’s bad to tell lies or be mean to others.
meanings.example_cn: 说谎或对别人刻薄是不对的。

meanings.definition: Used to admit a mistake or fault.
meanings.example: When I spilled my juice on the table, I said, “Sorry, my bad!” because I knew it was my fault.
meanings.example_cn: 我把果汁洒在桌子上时，说了一句 “抱歉，是我的错！”，因为我知道这是我的失误。

meanings.definition: A small pin or tag that shows who you are or what group you belong to.
meanings.example: Sarah earned a reading badge for finishing ten books.
meanings.example_cn: 萨拉读完十本书，获得了一枚阅读徽章。

meanings.definition: A soft container used to carry things.
meanings.example: I packed my bag with snacks and a water bottle for the trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我把零食和水瓶装进了包里，准备去旅行。

meanings.definition: To put things into a bag.
meanings.example: The shopkeeper bagged the apples for me.
meanings.example_cn: 店主帮我把苹果装进袋子里。

meanings.definition: A round bread roll with a hole in the middle.
meanings.example: I like my bagel toasted with cream cheese.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢吃烤过的贝果抹上奶油奶酪。

meanings.definition: To cook food in an oven.
meanings.example: Let’s bake cookies for the school fair.
meanings.example_cn: 我们来烤些饼干，拿去学校的游园会卖吧。

meanings.definition: Something that has been cooked by baking, like a casserole or a tray of cookies.
meanings.example: For dinner, we had a cheesy pasta bake that everyone loved.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们吃了芝士焗意面，大家都很喜欢。

meanings.definition: A person whose job is making bread and cakes.
meanings.example: The baker gets up early to make fresh bread.
meanings.example_cn: 面包师很早起床来做新鲜的面包。

meanings.definition: Staying steady and not falling over.
meanings.example: She used her arms to keep her balance on the beam.
meanings.example_cn: 她在平衡木上张开双臂保持平衡。

meanings.definition: When both sides have the same weight and stay steady.
meanings.example: The balance of the scale showed that both bags of apples weighed the same.
meanings.example_cn: 天平的平衡状态显示，两袋苹果重量一样。

meanings.definition: To stay steady and not fall over.
meanings.example: Can you balance on one foot without falling over?
meanings.example_cn: 你能单脚保持平衡而不摔倒吗？

meanings.definition: A round object that you throw, kick, or play games with.
meanings.example: We played catch with a big, bouncy ball.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用一个大大的弹力球玩接球游戏。

meanings.definition: A large, formal event where people dress up and dance.
meanings.example: The princess invited everyone in the kingdom to the royal ball.
meanings.example_cn: 公主邀请王国里所有人参加这场皇家舞会。

meanings.definition: To say something is not allowed.
meanings.example: The school will ban cell phones during class.
meanings.example_cn: 学校将禁止上课期间使用手机。

meanings.definition: A rule that says something is not allowed.
meanings.example: There is a ban on chewing gum at our school.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学校禁止嚼口香糖。

meanings.definition: A long yellow fruit that is soft and sweet inside.
meanings.example: I sliced a ripe banana onto my cereal.
meanings.example_cn: 我把一根熟透的香蕉切成片放到了麦片上。

meanings.definition: A group of people who play music together.
meanings.example: My friend plays the drums in a band.
meanings.example_cn: 我朋友在一个乐队里打鼓。

meanings.definition: To join together with others and make a group.
meanings.example: We need to band together to finish this big puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 我们得团结起来，才能拼完这个大拼图。

meanings.definition: A thin ring or strip of material worn around something.
meanings.example: She wore a silver band on her finger.
meanings.example_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚银戒指。

meanings.definition: A strip of cloth used to cover and protect a cut or wound.
meanings.example: The nurse wrapped a bandage around my finger.
meanings.example_cn: 护士把我的手指包扎了起来。

meanings.definition: To cover a cut or injury with a bandage.
meanings.example: The nurse bandaged my scraped knee after I fell.
meanings.example_cn: 我摔倒之后，护士包扎了我擦伤的膝盖。

meanings.definition: A place where people keep their money safe.
meanings.example: Dad went to the bank to put some money in his account.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸去银行往他的账户里存了一些钱。

meanings.definition: The land that is next to or along the edge of a river or stream.
meanings.example: We saw ducks swimming by the river bank.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看见鸭子沿着河岸游水。

meanings.definition: To put your money in a safe place, like a bank.
meanings.example: I want to bank my birthday money so I can save it.
meanings.example_cn: 我想把生日收到的钱存进银行，这样就能存起来。

meanings.definition: A long block or stick.
meanings.example: He ate a chocolate bar after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后他吃了一块巧克力。

meanings.definition: To stop something from happening.
meanings.example: The teacher will bar anyone from entering the room until it’s clean.
meanings.example_cn: 在房间打扫干净之前，老师会不让任何人进去。

meanings.definition: A place where adults go to buy and drink beverages, especially drinks like soda or alcohol.
meanings.example: Dad and his friends watched the football game together at the local bar.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸和他的朋友们在当地的酒吧一起看足球比赛。

meanings.definition: You almost didn’t do something, but you just managed to do it.
meanings.example: I was so sleepy that I barely stayed awake during the movie.
meanings.example_cn: 我困得不行，看电影的时候差点就睡着了。

meanings.definition: The bottom part of something that supports it.
meanings.example: The lamp fell off its base and broke.
meanings.example_cn: 台灯从底座上掉下来摔坏了。

meanings.definition: To use something as a starting point or foundation.
meanings.example: The teacher asked us to base our stories on real events.
meanings.example_cn: 老师让我们把故事建立在真实事件的基础上。

meanings.definition: Absolutely necessary or most important—something you need to have or know before anything else.
meanings.example: Learning the basic rules helps you play the game well.
meanings.example_cn: 学会基本规则能帮你把游戏玩好。

meanings.definition: Simple and not fancy, having only what is needed without extra details or decorations.
meanings.example: She wore a basic white T-shirt and jeans to the party.
meanings.example_cn: 她穿了一件简单的白T恤和牛仔裤去派对。

meanings.definition: A container made of woven strips, used for carrying or holding things.
meanings.example: We put fresh apples in the basket at the orchard.
meanings.example_cn: 在果园里，我们把新鲜的苹果放进篮子里。

meanings.definition: A wooden stick used in sports.
meanings.example: He swung the bat and hit the ball far.
meanings.example_cn: 他挥起球棒，把球打远了。

meanings.definition: To hit something using a bat.
meanings.example: I will bat the ball as far as I can during the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛的时候我要把球尽量打远。

meanings.definition: A small animal with wings that can fly at night.
meanings.example: We saw a bat flying around the streetlight after dinner last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天晚饭后，我们看到一只蝙蝠围着路灯飞来飞去。

meanings.definition: Washing yourself in water.
meanings.example: After playing in the mud, I needed a bath.
meanings.example_cn: 在泥里玩过之后，我需要洗个澡。

meanings.definition: To wash your body in a tub of water.
meanings.example: I like to bath in warm water after a cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 在冷天过后，我喜欢泡个温水澡。

meanings.definition: A part of the sea or lake that bends into the land.
meanings.example: The boat sailed quietly across the bay.
meanings.example_cn: 小船静静地在海湾上行驶。

meanings.definition: To exist, to live.
meanings.example: I want to be a kind person when I grow up.
meanings.example_cn: 长大后我想做一个善良的人。

meanings.definition: To link a subject to a description, like “She is happy.”
meanings.example: The soup is hot and smells delicious.
meanings.example_cn: 汤很烫，闻起来很香。

meanings.definition: Sandy land next to the sea.
meanings.example: We built a sandcastle on the beach last summer.
meanings.example_cn: 去年夏天我们在沙滩上堆了一座沙堡。

meanings.definition: The hard, pointed mouth of a bird.
meanings.example: The parrot used its beak to crack the nut.
meanings.example_cn: 鹦鹉用它的喙把坚果啄开。

meanings.definition: A small seed that can be cooked and eaten, often found in a pod.
meanings.example: We planted a bean seed and watched it grow.
meanings.example_cn: 我们种下一颗豆子，看着它长大。

meanings.definition: A large, furry animal that can stand on two legs and eats plants and animals.
meanings.example: We saw a big brown bear at the zoo eating honey.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在动物园看到一只大棕熊在吃蜂蜜。

meanings.definition: To put up with something difficult or unpleasant.
meanings.example: The bridge can bear the weight of many cars at once.
meanings.example_cn: 这座桥能承受许多汽车同时通过的重量。

meanings.definition: Hair that grows on a man’s chin and cheeks.
meanings.example: Uncle Joe has a long, bushy beard.
meanings.example_cn: 乔叔叔留着长长的、浓密的胡子。

meanings.definition: To win against someone in a game or contest.
meanings.example: I tried to beat my high score in the video game.
meanings.example_cn: 我试着打破我在电子游戏里的最高分。

meanings.definition: To hit something again and again, usually with your hand or an object.
meanings.example: He used a stick to beat the drum and make music.
meanings.example_cn: 他用棍子敲鼓奏乐。

meanings.definition: The steady sound or rhythm you hear in music.
meanings.example: I like to clap my hands to the beat of the song.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢随着歌曲的节拍拍手。

meanings.definition: Used to show the reason for something.
meanings.example: I’m smiling because today is my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我在微笑，因为今天是我的生日。

meanings.definition: To start to be something different or new.
meanings.example: I want to become a scientist when I grow up.
meanings.example_cn: 长大后我想成为一名科学家。

meanings.definition: A piece of furniture that you sleep on.
meanings.example: I jumped onto my soft bed after a long day.
meanings.example_cn: 漫长的一天过后，我跳上柔软的床。

meanings.definition: An insect that flies, makes honey, and can sting.
meanings.example: The bee buzzed from flower to flower in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 蜜蜂在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

meanings.definition: Meat that comes from a cow.
meanings.example: We had beef stew for dinner on a cold night.
meanings.example_cn: 寒冷的夜晚我们晚餐吃了炖牛肉。

meanings.definition: An insect with a hard shell on its back.
meanings.example: A shiny beetle crawled across the sidewalk.
meanings.example_cn: 一只闪亮的甲虫爬过了人行道。

meanings.definition: Happening earlier than something else.
meanings.example: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.
meanings.example_cn: 睡觉前要刷牙。

meanings.definition: In front of something in place.
meanings.example: The statue stands before the museum entrance.
meanings.example_cn: 雕像立在博物馆入口前。

meanings.definition: To ask for something in a way that shows you really want it.
meanings.example: The puppy would beg by looking up with big, hopeful eyes when he wanted a treat.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗想要零食时会用大大的、充满希望的眼睛抬头乞求。

meanings.definition: To start.
meanings.example: Let’s begin our art project now.
meanings.example_cn: 我们现在开始做手工吧。

meanings.definition: At the back of something or someone.
meanings.example: The cat hid behind the curtain during the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨中，猫躲在了窗帘后面。

meanings.definition: A living thing, like a person or an animal.
meanings.example: Being kind to others makes the world better.
meanings.example_cn: 善待他人会让世界变得更好。

meanings.definition: Something you think is true.
meanings.example: My belief is that hard work always pays off.
meanings.example_cn: 我相信努力总会有回报。

meanings.definition: To think that something is true or real.
meanings.example: I believe you can do anything you set your mind to.
meanings.example_cn: 我相信只要下定决心，你什么都能做到。

meanings.definition: A metal object that rings when hit.
meanings.example: When the school bell rings, we know it’s time to go to class.
meanings.example_cn: 学校铃一响，我们就知道该去上课了。

meanings.definition: In a lower place than something else.
meanings.example: The cat hid below the table during the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨中，猫躲在了桌子下面。

meanings.definition: Not as much as a certain number or amount.
meanings.example: You can only join the ride if you weigh below 40 kilograms.
meanings.example_cn: 体重低于 40 公斤，你才可以乘坐这个游乐项目。

meanings.definition: A strap you wear around your waist.
meanings.example: Dad said, “Don’t forget to wear your belt or your pants might fall down!”.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸说，别忘了系腰带，不然裤子会掉下来的！

meanings.definition: A long seat for several people.
meanings.example: Let’s sit on that wooden bench and watch the ducks swim across the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐到那张木长椅上，看鸭子游过池塘吧。

meanings.definition: To make something curved.
meanings.example: Can you bend the straw so it fits better in your glass?
meanings.example_cn: 你能把吸管弯一下，让它更好地插进杯子里吗？

meanings.definition: A place where something curves or turns.
meanings.example: There’s a bend in the road where the river curves around.
meanings.example_cn: 路上有个弯道，河水在那里拐了个弯。

meanings.definition: A small, round, juicy fruit.
meanings.example: We picked every juicy berry we could find on the bush.
meanings.example_cn: 我们采下灌木丛上能找到的每一颗多汁的浆果。

meanings.definition: Next to or at the side of something.
meanings.example: My dog always sits beside me on the couch.
meanings.example_cn: 我的狗总是坐在我旁边的沙发上。

meanings.definition: Used when you are comparing one thing to another to show a difference.
meanings.definition_cn: 用于将一物与另一物对比，以此体现差异
meanings.example: Beside her big brother, Mia looked very small. (This means, compared to her brother, Mia looked small.)
meanings.example_cn: 跟哥哥站一块儿，米娅就显得小小的。（也就是：对比哥哥，米娅个子矮。）

meanings.definition: In the space that separates two things or people.
meanings.example: The ball rolled between the couch and the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 球滚到了沙发和墙之间。

meanings.definition: Sharing something with two or more people or things.
meanings.example: Let’s split the last cookie between us.
meanings.example_cn: 我们分着吃掉最后一块饼干吧。

meanings.definition: A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal to move.
meanings.example: I ride my bicycle to school every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天早上骑自行车上学。

meanings.definition: Large in size.
meanings.example: There’s a big tree in our backyard with a swing.
meanings.example_cn: 我们后院有一棵大树，上面挂着秋千。

meanings.definition: Very important or having a lot of meaning.
meanings.example: Winning the spelling bee was a big moment for me.
meanings.example_cn: 在拼字比赛中获胜对我意义重大。

meanings.definition: A two-wheeled vehicle you pedal.
meanings.example: Let’s ride our bikes to the park after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们骑车去公园吧。

meanings.definition: To ride a bicycle.
meanings.example: We like to bike to the park on weekends.
meanings.example_cn: 周末我们喜欢骑车去公园。

meanings.definition: A very, very big number that is equal to one thousand million (1,000,000,000).
meanings.definition_cn: 一个非常非常大的数字，等于十亿
meanings.example: There are over a billion stars in the sky.
meanings.example_cn: 天上有超过十亿颗星星。

meanings.definition: A container for trash.
meanings.example: Please throw your empty juice box in the bin before leaving the classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 离开教室前，请把空果汁盒扔进垃圾桶。

meanings.definition: To throw something away or put it in the trash.
meanings.example: After finishing his homework, Tom decided to bin all his scrap paper.
meanings.example_cn: 汤姆做完作业后，决定把所有废纸扔进垃圾桶。

meanings.definition: An animal with feathers and wings that can usually fly.
meanings.example: A blue bird sang outside my window at dawn.
meanings.example_cn: 一只蓝鸟在黎明时飞到我的窗外唱歌。

meanings.definition: Being born.
meanings.example: We celebrated my baby sister’s birth by having a little party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们办了个小派对，来庆祝小妹妹的出生。

meanings.definition: The special day each year when you celebrate the day you were born.
meanings.example: I had a fun party with my friends on my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我生日那天和朋友们办了个好玩的派对。

meanings.definition: A small, sweet baked food that is crisp and dry.
meanings.example: I had a biscuit and a glass of milk for my snack.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了一块饼干，喝了一杯牛奶当作点心。

meanings.definition: A small piece.
meanings.example: Can I have just a tiny bit of your chocolate bar, please?
meanings.example_cn: 请问我能吃一点点你的巧克力吗？

meanings.definition: To cut or grip with your teeth.
meanings.example: Be careful not to bite your lip while you run.
meanings.example_cn: 跑步的时候小心别咬到嘴唇。

meanings.definition: A small piece of food you take with your teeth.
meanings.example: He took a big bite of his juicy apple.
meanings.example_cn: 他大口咬了一口多汁的苹果。

meanings.definition: The darkest colour, like the night sky with no stars.
meanings.example: The black cat slept quietly on the windowsill.
meanings.example_cn: 那只黑猫静静地躺在窗台上睡觉。

meanings.definition: To say that someone is the reason something bad happened.
meanings.example: Don’t blame others when you make a mistake.
meanings.example_cn: 犯错的时候，不要怪别人。

meanings.definition: Saying or thinking that someone is responsible for something bad that happened.
meanings.example: The blame for the broken window was given to Tom because he kicked the ball.
meanings.example_cn: 大家认为是汤姆打碎了窗户，因为是他踢的球。

meanings.definition: Empty, with nothing on it.
meanings.example: The teacher gave us a blank piece of paper to draw on.
meanings.example_cn: 老师给了我们一张空白的纸来画画。

meanings.definition: Not able to see.
meanings.example: The blind man uses a guide dog to help him walk safely along the footpath.
meanings.example_cn: 那位盲人用导盲犬帮他安全地走在人行道上。

meanings.definition: A solid piece of material.
meanings.example: We stacked the wooden blocks to make a tall tower.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把木块叠起来，搭了一座高塔。

meanings.definition: To stop something from getting through.
meanings.example: A big truck will block the road while workers fix the street.
meanings.example_cn: 工人们修路的时候，一辆大卡车会挡住路。

meanings.definition: Used for a street or junction, it means the space or group of buildings between two streets.
meanings.example: We walked one block to get from our house to the ice cream shop.
meanings.example_cn: 我们从家走一个街区就到冰淇淋店了。

meanings.definition: The red liquid that moves through your body and keeps you alive.
meanings.example: The nurse took a little blood for my checkup.
meanings.example_cn: 护士为我的体检抽了一点点血。

meanings.definition: The flower part of a plant.
meanings.example: Look at the beautiful bloom on the rose bush in the garden!
meanings.example_cn: 看花园里玫瑰丛上开的花多漂亮啊！

meanings.definition: To open up with flowers.
meanings.example: The flowers will bloom in the garden this spring.
meanings.example_cn: 今年春天花园里的花会开。

meanings.definition: To move air.
meanings.example: If you blow hard enough, you can make all the dandelion seeds float away.
meanings.example_cn: 你如果用力吹，就能把蒲公英的种子全都吹飞。

meanings.definition: A hard hit.
meanings.example: The soccer player took a blow to the head but was okay.
meanings.example_cn: 那个足球运动员头部挨了一下，但没事。

meanings.definition: Something sudden and upsetting.
meanings.example: Losing his favourite toy was a real blow to Tim because it made him very sad.
meanings.example_cn: 弄丢了心爱的玩具对蒂姆来说是个不小的打击，这让他特别难过。

meanings.definition: The colour of the sky on a clear day.
meanings.example: The sky was so blue and clear this afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 今天下午天空那么蓝那么清澈。

meanings.definition: A small, round, blue fruit that is sweet and juicy.
meanings.example: I added fresh blueberry to my yogurt.
meanings.example_cn: 我在酸奶里加了新鲜的蓝莓。

meanings.definition: Not sharp, so it cannot cut or poke easily.
meanings.example: The pencil was blunt, so I had to sharpen it.
meanings.example_cn: 铅笔太钝了，我得把它削尖。

meanings.definition: A small vehicle that floats and moves on water.
meanings.example: We took a boat ride on the lake last summer.
meanings.example_cn: 去年夏天我们在湖上乘船游玩。

meanings.definition: All the physical parts of a person or animal.
meanings.example: The human body is amazing and can do many things.
meanings.example_cn: 人的身体很神奇，能做许多事情。

meanings.definition: To heat a liquid until it bubbles.
meanings.example: Mum will boil some water so we can make warm hot chocolate after our walk.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈会烧点水，这样我们散步回来就能做热巧克力了。

meanings.definition: The bubbling and steaming that happens when something is very hot.
meanings.example: Watch the pot for the first boil before you add the pasta.
meanings.example_cn: 等锅里第一次冒泡了，再放意面进去。

meanings.definition: The hard part inside your body that supports you.
meanings.example: The dog chewed on a big bone in the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 狗在院子里啃着一块大骨头。

meanings.definition: To make a loud noise to show you don’t like something, often at a show or game.
meanings.example: The audience began to boo when the magician’s trick didn’t work.
meanings.example_cn: 魔术师的魔术表演失败时，观众开始发出嘘声。

meanings.definition: A loud sound people make to show they don’t like something, usually by saying “boo!”
meanings.example: The referee heard a big boo from the fans after the bad call.
meanings.example_cn: 裁判做出不公判罚后，听到球迷发出一阵巨大的嘘声。

meanings.definition: Pages with words or pictures that you can read.
meanings.example: I borrowed a funny book from the school library.
meanings.example_cn: 我从学校图书馆借了一本有趣的书。

meanings.definition: To arrange for something to happen in the future, like a seat or a time.
meanings.example: Dad will book a table for us at the pizza restaurant.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会在披萨餐厅给我们订一张桌子。

meanings.definition: A heavy shoe that covers the ankle.
meanings.example: I put on my rain boots before jumping in the puddles.
meanings.example_cn: 我穿上雨靴，然后去踩水坑。

meanings.definition: To turn on or start up a computer.
meanings.example: Press the power button to boot the computer.
meanings.example_cn: 按电源键来启动电脑。

meanings.definition: Feeling tired and uninterested because nothing is fun.
meanings.example: I felt bored when it rained all day and we stayed inside.
meanings.example_cn: 下了一整天雨待在家里，我觉得很无聊。

meanings.definition: Not interesting or fun, so it makes you feel tired or want to do something else.
meanings.example: The movie was so boring that I almost fell asleep.
meanings.example_cn: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着了。

meanings.definition: To come into life.
meanings.example: I was born in the spring, when the flowers started blooming.
meanings.example_cn: 我出生在春天，那时候花儿开始开了。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about two things or people together.
meanings.example: Both of my cousins are coming to the picnic.
meanings.example_cn: 我的两个表兄妹都要来参加野餐。

meanings.definition: A hard container, often made of glass or plastic, used to hold liquids.
meanings.example: Shake the bottle before you pour the juice.
meanings.example_cn: 倒果汁前先摇一摇瓶子。

meanings.definition: To spring back into the air after hitting something.
meanings.example: Watch the ball bounce high on the trampoline.
meanings.example_cn: 看球在蹦床上弹得高高的。

meanings.definition: A sudden jump or movement back after hitting a surface.
meanings.example: The ball made a big bounce after it hit the floor.
meanings.example_cn: 球撞到地板之后弹得很高。

meanings.definition: A knot made by tying a ribbon or string into two loops.
meanings.example: She tied her shoelaces in a neat bow before running outside to play.
meanings.example_cn: 她出门玩耍前把鞋带系成了一个整齐的蝴蝶结。

meanings.definition: A curved weapon used to shoot arrows.
meanings.example: The archer carefully aimed his bow and shot an arrow at the target during practice.
meanings.example_cn: 练习时，射手小心地瞄准他的弓，向靶子射出一支箭。

meanings.definition: To bend your body forward, often to show respect or say thank you.
meanings.example: The actors bow to the audience after the show.
meanings.example_cn: 演出结束后，演员们向观众鞠躬。

meanings.definition: A round, deep dish used for holding food or liquid.
meanings.example: She filled her bowl with strawberries and cream.
meanings.example_cn: 她把草莓和奶油装满了碗。

meanings.definition: To play a game of bowling by rolling a ball to knock down pins.
meanings.example: We love to bowl at the alley on Saturdays.
meanings.example_cn: 我们周六喜欢去保龄球馆打保龄球。

meanings.definition: A container with flat sides, usually used for holding or storing things.
meanings.example: I found my old toys in a big cardboard box.
meanings.example_cn: 我在一个大纸板箱里找到了我以前的玩具。

meanings.definition: To fight using your fists, like in boxing.
meanings.example: They put on gloves and learned how to box in gym class.
meanings.example_cn: 两位朋友戴着手套在拳击台进行拳击。

meanings.definition: To put something inside a box.
meanings.example: Let’s box up the toys before we clean the room.
meanings.example_cn: 打扫房间前，咱们先把玩具装进盒子里。

meanings.definition: A male child or young person.
meanings.example: The boy with the blue hat jumped the highest.
meanings.example_cn: 那个戴蓝帽子的男孩跳得最高。

meanings.definition: The organ inside your head that helps you think and feel.
meanings.example: The brain helps us solve puzzles and learn new things.
meanings.example_cn: 大脑帮助我们解谜和学习新事物。

meanings.definition: Not afraid to do something difficult or scary.
meanings.example: The brave firefighter rescued a kitten from the tall tree.
meanings.example_cn: 勇敢的消防员从高树上救下了一只小猫。

meanings.definition: To face a challenge or danger without being afraid.
meanings.definition_cn: 勇敢地面对（挑战或危险）
meanings.example: He braved the cold wind to finish the race with his friends.
meanings.example_cn: 他顶着寒风和朋友们一起完成了比赛。

meanings.definition: Food made from flour and water that is baked and often sliced.
meanings.example: We baked fresh bread that smells delicious.
meanings.example_cn: 我们烤了新鲜的面包，闻起来很香。

meanings.definition: To split or crack something into pieces.
meanings.example: Be careful with that glass, don’t drop it or it might break.
meanings.example_cn: 小心那个玻璃杯，别摔了，不然会碎的。

meanings.definition: A short time when you stop what you are doing to rest.
meanings.example: We have a short break after math class to rest.
meanings.example_cn: 数学课之后我们有一小段休息时间。

meanings.definition: A hard block used for building.
meanings.example: The workers built a new wall with red bricks.
meanings.example_cn: 工人们用红砖砌了一面新墙。

meanings.definition: A woman getting married.
meanings.example: The bride wore a lovely white dress and carried a bunch of pink flowers.
meanings.example_cn: 新娘穿着漂亮的白裙子，手里拿着一束粉色的花。

meanings.definition: A structure built over water or a gap so people and cars can go across.
meanings.example: We crossed a long bridge over the river.
meanings.example_cn: 我们走过一座横跨河流的长桥。

meanings.definition: To connect or join two things together.
meanings.example: We used a plank to bridge the gap between the rocks.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用一块厚木板搭在岩石之间，填平缝隙。

meanings.definition: To make the gap or difference between two things smaller.
meanings.example: The teacher tried to bridge the gap between the new students and the rest of the class by having everyone play a game together.
meanings.example_cn: 老师让全班一起玩游戏，想缩小新同学与其他同学之间的距离。

meanings.definition: Giving off a lot of light.
meanings.example: The bright sun made the playground sparkle.
meanings.example_cn: 明亮的太阳让操场闪闪发光。

meanings.definition: Very clever or quick to learn.
meanings.example: She's a bright student who always asks thoughtful questions.
meanings.example_cn: 她是个聪明的学生，总是问一些有深度的问题。

meanings.definition: To carry something or someone to another place.
meanings.example: Please bring your favourite book to share with the class.
meanings.example_cn: 请带一本你最喜欢的书来和全班分享。

meanings.definition: A tool with a long handle for sweeping.
meanings.example: Grab the broom and help me sweep up all the crumbs off the kitchen floor.
meanings.example_cn: 拿扫帚来，帮我把厨房地板上的碎屑都扫干净。

meanings.definition: The colour of chocolate.
meanings.example: Our table is made of strong brown wood.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的桌子是用结实的棕色木头做的。

meanings.definition: To clean with a brush.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to brush your teeth before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 睡觉前别忘了刷牙。

meanings.definition: A tool with bristles that you use for cleaning or painting.
meanings.example: He used a brush to paint colourful pictures on the paper.
meanings.example_cn: 他用画笔在纸上画彩色的画。

meanings.definition: A tool that you use for fixing your hair.
meanings.example: I use a brush every morning to make my hair neat before school.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天早上用梳子把头发梳整齐再去上学。

meanings.definition: A small insect.
meanings.example: Look, a little bug is crawling slowly over the green leaf of the rose bush.
meanings.example_cn: 看，一只小虫子正慢慢地爬过玫瑰丛的绿叶。

meanings.definition: To annoy or bother someone.
meanings.example: It will bug me if you keep tapping your pencil on the desk.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你一直用铅笔敲桌子，我会很烦的。

meanings.definition: To make something by putting parts together.
meanings.example: Let’s build a sandcastle at the beach!
meanings.example_cn: 我们在海滩上搭个沙堡吧！

meanings.definition: The way something has been constructed.
meanings.example: The build of the new bridge is very strong and can hold many cars at once.
meanings.example_cn: 这座新桥的结构十分坚固，可以同时承载很多汽车。

meanings.definition: The shape, size, or structure of a person’s or animal’s body.
meanings.example: Even though she is short, Mia has a strong build and can run very fast.
meanings.example_cn: 米娅个子虽然不高，但体格健壮，可以跑得很快。

meanings.definition: The round glass part of a light.
meanings.example: The lamp stopped working because its old light bulb burned out last night.
meanings.example_cn: 灯不亮了，因为昨晚旧灯泡烧坏了。

meanings.definition: The round, underground part of a plant that stores food and helps the plant grow.
meanings.definition_cn: 洋葱、大蒜这类植物长在地下的圆球状根茎
meanings.example: The chef chopped up the bulb of garlic to add flavour to the soup.
meanings.example_cn: 厨师把大蒜鳞茎切碎，给汤增添风味。

meanings.definition: A male cow.
meanings.example: The big brown bull stood quietly in the field beside the other cows.
meanings.example_cn: 那只棕色的大公牛安静地站在田野里，旁边是其他的奶牛。

meanings.definition: A group of things tied together.
meanings.example: Grandma bought a bunch of bananas for us to share.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶买了一串香蕉给我们分着吃。

meanings.definition: To be on fire.
meanings.example: They used sticks to burn the marshmallows over the campfire.
meanings.example_cn: 他们用小木棍在营火上烤棉花糖。

meanings.definition: An injury you get when your skin is hurt by something hot like fire.
meanings.example: Be careful—touching the stove can give you a burn.
meanings.example_cn: 小心——碰炉子会烫伤的。

meanings.definition: To put something under the ground.
meanings.example: Let’s bury our treasure in the sandbox and make a map.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把宝藏埋在沙坑里，然后画一张地图吧。

meanings.definition: A large vehicle that carries many people on the road.
meanings.example: The bus picked us up right in front of our house.
meanings.example_cn: 公共汽车就在我们家门前接我们。

meanings.definition: A short, thick plant.
meanings.example: We found a nest with tiny bird eggs hidden deep inside the thick bush.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在茂密的灌木丛深处发现了一个鸟窝，里面有小小的鸟蛋。

meanings.definition: A company or work that involves buying and selling things.
meanings.example: My aunt started a small business that sells homemade cookies at the market.
meanings.example_cn: 我姑姑开了一家小生意，在市场上卖自制的饼干。

meanings.definition: Something that is only your concern, not anyone else’s.
meanings.example: When my brother reads my diary, I remind him that it's my business, not his.
meanings.example_cn: 我哥哥读我的日记时，我提醒他那是我的事，不是他的。

meanings.definition: Having a lot to do.
meanings.example: My mom was so busy making dinner that she didn’t hear the doorbell ring.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈忙着做晚饭，都没听见门铃响。

meanings.definition: When a place is full of people or activity.
meanings.example: The playground is always busy after school ends.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后操场总是很热闹。

meanings.definition: A word used to show something is different or in contrast.
meanings.example: I wanted to play outside, but it started to rain.
meanings.example_cn: 我想出去玩，但开始下雨了。

meanings.definition: A soft, yellow food made from milk, often spread on bread.
meanings.example: Spread some butter on your warm toast.
meanings.example_cn: 在热吐司上抹一些黄油。

meanings.definition: To spread butter on something, like bread.
meanings.example: I like to butter my toast in the morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我早上喜欢给吐司抹上黄油。

meanings.definition: An insect with large, colourful wings that flies in the day.
meanings.example: I saw a colourful butterfly land on a flower.
meanings.example_cn: 我看见一只彩色的蝴蝶落在一朵花上。

meanings.definition: To agree with something that someone says or suggests.
meanings.example: When my brother said he finished his homework in five minutes, I didn’t buy his story.
meanings.example_cn: 我哥说他五分钟就写完了作业，我才不信他的话呢。

meanings.definition: To get something by paying for it.
meanings.example: The buyer paid for the car and took it home.
meanings.example_cn: 买车的人付了钱，把车开回了家。

meanings.definition: Something you got by paying money.
meanings.example: This new toy was my favourite buy at the store.
meanings.example_cn: 这个新玩具是我在商店里买的最喜欢的东西。

meanings.definition: Someone who buys things.
meanings.example: The buyer of our old bike came this morning to take it home.
meanings.example_cn: 买我们旧自行车的人今天早上来把车骑走了。

meanings.definition: A low, humming sound.
meanings.example: I heard the buzz of a bee near the flowers.
meanings.example_cn: 我听到花旁边有蜜蜂嗡嗡的声音。

meanings.definition: To make a humming sound like a bee does.
meanings.example: The bees will buzz around the flowers in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 蜜蜂会在花园的花丛周围嗡嗡地飞。

meanings.definition: Right next to something or very close to it.
meanings.example: The cat sat quietly by the window.
meanings.example_cn: 猫安静地坐在窗边。

meanings.definition: Used to show who did something.
meanings.example: This picture was painted by my sister.
meanings.example_cn: 这幅画是我姐姐画的。

meanings.definition: To show how something was done.
meanings.example: The door opened by pushing the button.
meanings.example_cn: 按下按钮，门就开了。

meanings.definition: A taxi.
meanings.example: When it started pouring rain, we called a cab to get to the station.
meanings.example_cn: 下起倾盆大雨的时候，我们叫了一辆出租车去车站。

meanings.definition: A round, leafy green vegetable that people eat in salads or cooked meals.
meanings.example: We grew cabbage in our garden last year.
meanings.example_cn: 去年我们在菜园里种了卷心菜。

meanings.definition: A small wooden house.
meanings.example: We stayed in a cozy cabin in the woods during our vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 假期里我们住在森林里一间温馨的小木屋里。

meanings.definition: A small restaurant where people can buy drinks like coffee, tea, or juice, and simple foods such as sandwiches, pastries, or snacks.
meanings.example: Mom and I had hot chocolate at a little cafe on Main Street.
meanings.example_cn: 我和妈妈在主街的一家小咖啡馆喝了热巧克力。

meanings.definition: A box with bars to keep animals in.
meanings.example: Our pet hamster stays in its cage at night to keep it safe from cats.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的宠物仓鼠晚上待在笼子里，这样猫就伤不到它。

meanings.definition: To put an animal or person inside a cage.
meanings.example: We have to cage the hamster at night so he doesn’t run away.
meanings.example_cn: 晚上我们得把仓鼠关起来，不然它会跑掉。

meanings.definition: A sweet, baked treat made from flour, sugar, and eggs, often eaten for birthdays.
meanings.example: I blew out the candles on my birthday cake.
meanings.example_cn: 我吹灭了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。

meanings.definition: To figure out using numbers.
meanings.example: I need to calculate how many apples we have if we add three more.
meanings.example_cn: 我得算一算，如果再加三个苹果，我们一共有多少个。

meanings.definition: A chart that shows the days, weeks, and months of the year.
meanings.example: Mark your birthday on the calendar with a star.
meanings.example_cn: 在日历上用星号标出你的生日。

meanings.definition: To use a phone to talk to someone.
meanings.example: I will call Grandma to tell her about my day.
meanings.example_cn: 我会打电话给奶奶，告诉她我的一天。

meanings.definition: To give a name to someone or something.
meanings.example: We decided to call our new kitten Whiskers.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定给我们的小猫取名毛毛。

meanings.definition: To use your voice to get someone’s attention.
meanings.example: I will call your name when it’s your turn.
meanings.example_cn: 轮到你时，我会叫你的名字。

meanings.definition: Quiet and peaceful, with no loud noises or excitement.
meanings.example: The lake was calm and still in the early morning.
meanings.example_cn: 清晨的湖面平静而安详。

meanings.definition: To make something or someone peaceful and quiet.
meanings.example: Mom helped calm me down when I was nervous about my test.
meanings.example_cn: 我在考试前紧张时，妈妈帮我平静下来。

meanings.definition: A time or feeling when everything is peaceful and quiet.
meanings.example: There was a calm in the classroom after everyone finished talking.
meanings.example_cn: 大家说完话之后，教室里安静了下来。

meanings.definition: An animal with a hump that lives in the desert.
meanings.example: At the zoo, I saw a camel with two big humps on its back.
meanings.example_cn: 在动物园里，我看到一只背上有两个大驼峰的骆驼。

meanings.definition: To sleep outside in a tent.
meanings.example: We plan to camp by the lake and roast marshmallows over the campfire.
meanings.example_cn: 我们打算在湖边露营，在篝火上烤棉花糖。

meanings.definition: A place where people stay, often in tents or cabins, for fun or adventure.
meanings.example: We went to summer camp and slept in cabins with our friends.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去了夏令营，和朋友们一起住在小木屋里。

meanings.definition: To be able to do something.
meanings.example: I can ride my bike with no training wheels.
meanings.example_cn: 我能不用辅助轮骑自行车了。

meanings.definition: To be allowed to do something or have permission.
meanings.example: You can have an extra cookie after dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭后你可以再吃一块饼干。

meanings.definition: A metal container used to hold food, drinks, or other things.
meanings.example: I drank a can of orange juice at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭时我喝了一罐橙汁。

meanings.definition: To stop something from happening.
meanings.example: They had to cancel the sports day because heavy rain flooded the field.
meanings.example_cn: 因为大雨淹没了操场，他们不得不取消了运动会。

meanings.definition: Sweet food made mostly of sugar, like lollies or chocolates.
meanings.example: I got a piece of candy for helping clean up.
meanings.example_cn: 因为帮忙打扫，我得到了一块糖果。

meanings.definition: A walking stick.
meanings.example: Grandpa uses a cane to help him walk when he’s tired.
meanings.example_cn: 爷爷累的时候就用拐杖帮着走路。

meanings.definition: A long, thin, and strong stem or stick from a plant like bamboo or sugarcane.
meanings.example: The gardener used a bamboo cane to support the tall tomato plants.
meanings.example_cn: 园丁用一根竹竿把高高的番茄苗撑住。

meanings.definition: A deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often with a river at the bottom.
meanings.example: We saw a deep canyon during our road trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在公路旅行中看到了一个深深的峡谷。

meanings.definition: A soft hat.
meanings.example: Jake wore his favourite cap to keep the sun out of his eyes.
meanings.example_cn: 杰克戴上他最喜欢的帽子，挡住刺眼的阳光，不让阳光照到眼睛。

meanings.definition: To put a cover on the top of something.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to cap your marker so it doesn’t dry out.
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了给马克笔盖上笔帽，不然会干的。

meanings.definition: To put a limit on something.
meanings.example: The teacher will cap the number of students in the club at twenty.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会把社团人数限制在二十人。

meanings.definition: A sleeveless piece of clothing that hangs loosely from the shoulders, like a short cloak.
meanings.example: For her costume, she wore a red cape that flowed behind her when she ran.
meanings.example_cn: 她穿戏服时披了一件红色斗篷，跑起来的时候斗篷在身后飘。

meanings.definition: A piece of land that sticks out into the water from the coastline.
meanings.example: We saw lots of birds while walking along the rocky cape by the sea.
meanings.example_cn: 我们沿着海边那片多岩石的海岬散步时，看见了许多鸟儿。

meanings.definition: A vehicle with four wheels that people drive on roads.
meanings.example: Dad washed the family car on Saturday morning.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸周六早上洗了家里的车。

meanings.definition: A thick piece of paper or cardboard.
meanings.example: I drew colourful stars and hearts on a birthday card for my grandma.
meanings.example_cn: 我在给奶奶的生日贺卡上画了彩色的星星和爱心。

meanings.definition: To feel concern or interest.
meanings.example: I care about my friends and always listen when they need to talk.
meanings.example_cn: 我很在乎我的朋友们，他们需要说话的时候我总是会听。

meanings.definition: Paying a lot of attention to someone or something.
meanings.example: She showed care by helping her friend who fell on the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 她朋友在操场上摔倒了，她去帮忙，表现出了关心。

meanings.definition: Paying close attention so you don’t make mistakes or get hurt.
meanings.example: Be careful not to touch the hot stove.
meanings.example_cn: 小心别碰到热炉子。

meanings.definition: Not paying attention, which can lead to mistakes or accidents.
meanings.example: It was careless to leave the door open in the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨时开着门真是粗心。

meanings.definition: Someone who helps people who are sick or need help.
meanings.example: My gran’s carer comes each morning to help her get dressed and make tea.
meanings.example_cn: 我奶奶的护工每天早上来帮她穿衣服、泡茶。

meanings.definition: A long, orange vegetable that grows underground and is crunchy to eat.
meanings.example: The rabbit munched on a crunchy carrot.
meanings.example_cn: 兔子嘎吱嘎吱地啃着一根胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: To hold something and take it from one place to another.
meanings.example: Could you carry this heavy bag for me, please?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我提这个很重的包吗？

meanings.definition: To keep something with you wherever you go.
meanings.definition_cn: 无论去哪里，都把某物带在身边
meanings.example: I carry my favourite toy in my backpack every day.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天都把我最喜欢的玩具放在背包里随身带着。

meanings.definition: To help someone or a group succeed or do well, especially by giving support or doing important work.
meanings.example: The star player helped carry the team to victory.
meanings.example_cn: 这位明星球员帮助球队走向胜利。

meanings.definition: A particular situation, example, or event.
meanings.example: In this case, it's better to ask for help if you don't understand the homework.
meanings.example_cn: 在这种情况下，如果不懂作业，最好请求帮助。

meanings.definition: A box or container that holds or protects something.
meanings.example: I keep my coloured pencils in a bright red case so I don't lose them.
meanings.example_cn: 我把彩笔放在一个鲜红色的盒子里，这样就不会弄丢了。

meanings.definition: Money in coins or bills.
meanings.example: Dad used cash to buy us ice cream from the little shop on the corner.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸用现金在街角的小店里给我们买了冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: To turn a cheque into money.
meanings.example: Dad went to the bank to cash a cheque.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸去银行兑现支票了。

meanings.definition: A large, strong building that kings, queens, or nobles lived in long ago.
meanings.example: We visited an old stone castle on vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 假期我们参观了一座古老的石头城堡。

meanings.definition: A small animal with soft fur, whiskers, and a tail, often kept as a pet.
meanings.example: The cat chased a ball of yarn around the room.
meanings.example_cn: 猫在房间里追着一个毛线球跑。

meanings.definition: To grab or hold something that is moving, like a ball.
meanings.definition_cn: 抓住；接住（移动中的东西）
meanings.example: Try to catch the ball when I throw it to you.
meanings.example_cn: 我把球扔给你时，试着接住它。

meanings.definition: Something that is caught, or the act of catching something.
meanings.example: That was an amazing catch you made during the baseball game!
meanings.example_cn: 你在棒球比赛里那记接球太厉害了！

meanings.definition: Something that makes something else happen.
meanings.example: The heavy storm was the cause of all the fallen branches in our garden.
meanings.example_cn: 大暴雨是我们花园里树枝掉一地的原因。

meanings.definition: To make something happen.
meanings.example: Eating too much candy can cause a stomach ache.
meanings.example_cn: 糖吃太多会导致肚子疼。

meanings.definition: A large hole or space in the side of a hill or mountain.
meanings.example: We explored a dark cave with our flashlights.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用手电筒探索了一个黑暗的洞穴。

meanings.definition: The top inside part of a room, above your head.
meanings.example: The balloon floated up to the ceiling and got stuck.
meanings.example_cn: 气球飘到天花板卡住了。

meanings.definition: To do something special for a happy event.
meanings.example: We will celebrate my little sister’s birthday with cake and party games.
meanings.example_cn: 我们会用蛋糕和派对游戏来庆祝小妹妹的生日。

meanings.definition: Food made from grains, often eaten with milk for breakfast.
meanings.example: I have crunchy cereal with cold milk every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天早上都吃脆麦片加冷牛奶。

meanings.definition: A piece of furniture with a seat, back, and legs for one person to sit on.
meanings.example: Pull up a chair and join us at the table.
meanings.example_cn: 拉过一把椅子，和我们一起坐到桌边。

meanings.definition: To lead or be in charge of a meeting.
meanings.example: Mrs. Lee will chair the class meeting today.
meanings.example_cn: 李老师今天将主持班会。

meanings.definition: A soft white rock for writing or drawing.
meanings.example: We drew colourful pictures on the sidewalk with chalk.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用粉笔在人行道上画彩色的画。

meanings.definition: To write or draw with a stick of chalk.
meanings.example: Let’s chalk our names on the sidewalk outside.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在外面的人行道上用粉笔写名字吧。

meanings.definition: Something hard to do.
meanings.example: Finishing this tough puzzle is quite a fun challenge for us both.
meanings.example_cn: 拼完这个难拼的拼图对我们俩来说是个挺好玩的挑战。

meanings.definition: To dare or invite someone to try something difficult.
meanings.example: I challenge you to a race to the big tree!
meanings.example_cn: 我跟你比一比，看谁先跑到那棵大树那儿！

meanings.definition: The person or team that wins first place in a contest or game.
meanings.example: She became the champion by winning every race.
meanings.example_cn: 她赢了每一场比赛，成为了冠军。

meanings.definition: To make something become different from how it was before.
meanings.example: The leaves change colour in the fall.
meanings.example_cn: 秋天树叶会变色。

meanings.definition: To exchange one thing for another.
meanings.example: Let’s change seats so everyone can see the board.
meanings.example_cn: 我们换个座位，这样每个人都能看到黑板。

meanings.definition: The small coins you get back after paying for something.
meanings.example: I got change back after I bought candy.
meanings.example_cn: 买完糖果后，我拿到了找零。

meanings.definition: A water path for boats.
meanings.example: The boat sailed down the channel between the two islands.
meanings.example_cn: 船沿着两座岛之间的水道航行。

meanings.definition: To send or direct something toward a certain goal or place.
meanings.example: The teacher asked us to channel our energy into learning.
meanings.example_cn: 老师让我们把精力集中到学习上。

meanings.definition: A station or frequency for television or radio programmes.
meanings.example: My favourite cartoon is on channel five.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的动画片在五频道。

meanings.definition: Something that makes people like you.
meanings.example: Her big warm smile is one of her greatest charms.
meanings.example_cn: 她那大大的、暖暖的笑容是她最迷人的地方之一。

meanings.definition: To make someone like you by being nice or friendly.
meanings.example: The puppy will charm everyone with its cute little face.
meanings.example_cn: 这只小狗会用它可爱的小脸迷倒所有人。

meanings.definition: To run after someone or something to catch it.
meanings.example: The puppy loves to chase the bouncing tennis ball.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗喜欢追那个弹跳的网球。

meanings.definition: The act of running after someone or something.
meanings.example: The chase was exciting as we tried to catch the butterfly.
meanings.example_cn: 我们试图捉住蝴蝶时，追捕过程很刺激。

meanings.definition: To talk in a friendly way.
meanings.example: We chat happily about our favourite cartoons while we walk home from school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学走回家的路上，我们开心地聊最喜欢的动画片。

meanings.definition: A friendly talk or conversation.
meanings.example: Let’s have a chat after school about the project.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我们聊一聊这个项目吧。

meanings.definition: Not costing much money.
meanings.example: These pencils were cheap, so I bought a whole box.
meanings.example_cn: 这些铅笔很便宜，所以我买了一整盒。

meanings.definition: To describe someone who doesn’t like to spend their money, even when it would be nice or fair to do so.
meanings.example: Even though he had lots of money, Max was cheap and never wanted to buy snacks for his friends.
meanings.example_cn: 马克斯虽然有很多钱，却很小气，从来不愿意给朋友们买零食。

meanings.definition: To act dishonestly.
meanings.example: Never cheat in a board game; it’s much more fun when everyone plays fairly.
meanings.example_cn: 桌游的时候千万别作弊；大家公平地玩才更有意思。

meanings.definition: A person who acts dishonestly to win or get something.
meanings.example: No one likes a cheat in games because it isn’t fair.
meanings.example_cn: 游戏里没人喜欢作弊的人，因为不公平。

meanings.definition: The act of cheating or breaking the rules to get something unfairly.
meanings.example: Getting the answers from someone else during a test is a cheat.
meanings.example_cn: 考试时从别人那里获取答案，就是作弊。

meanings.definition: To look at something to make sure.
meanings.example: Let’s check if we have any milk left in the fridge.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看看冰箱里还有没有牛奶。

meanings.definition: The act of looking at something.
meanings.example: Mom did a quick check to make sure I packed my lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈快速检查了一下，确认我带了午饭。

meanings.definition: A small mark (✓) used to show that something is correct, finished, or chosen.
meanings.example: Put a check next to your name when you arrive.
meanings.example_cn: 到了之后在你名字旁边打个勾。

meanings.definition: The side of your face below the eye.
meanings.example: My mum gave me a soft kiss on my cheek before I left for school.
meanings.example_cn: 我去上学之前，妈妈在我脸上轻轻亲了一下。

meanings.definition: To shout with joy or encouragement.
meanings.example: Let's cheer for our team at the soccer game!
meanings.example_cn: 让我们在足球赛上为我们的队伍加油！

meanings.definition: A happy or loud shout to show support or joy.
meanings.example: A loud cheer went up when the magician finished his trick.
meanings.example_cn: 魔术师完成表演时响起了一阵响亮的欢呼声。

meanings.definition: A food made from milk that can be soft or hard and comes in many flavours.
meanings.example: I love cheese melted on my pizza.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢披萨上融化的奶酪。

meanings.definition: A large, wild cat with spots that runs very fast.
meanings.example: The cheetah is the fastest animal in the world.
meanings.example_cn: 猎豹是世界上跑得最快的动物。

meanings.definition: A skilled cook.
meanings.example: The chef in the restaurant wears a tall white hat.
meanings.example_cn: 餐厅里的厨师戴着高高的白帽子。

meanings.definition: A small, round fruit that is usually red or dark purple, sweet or sour, and has a hard pit inside.
meanings.example: I put a sweet cherry on top of my ice cream sundae.
meanings.example_cn: 我把一颗甜甜的樱桃放在冰淇淋圣代上。

meanings.definition: A game played on a board with special pieces.
meanings.example: Grandad loves to play chess with me and teaches me smart new moves.
meanings.example_cn: 爷爷喜欢和我下国际象棋，还教我厉害的新走法。

meanings.definition: The upper front part of your body.
meanings.example: He wore a medal proudly on his chest during the assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 在集会上他骄傲地把奖牌戴在胸前。

meanings.definition: A large box for storing things.
meanings.example: We keep old family photos in a wooden chest in the attic.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把旧的家庭照片放在阁楼的一个木箱里。

meanings.definition: To crush food with your teeth.
meanings.example: Remember to chew your food slowly so you don’t choke.
meanings.example_cn: 记得慢慢嚼食物，不然会噎着。

meanings.definition: A farm bird kept for its eggs and meat.
meanings.example: We raise chickens and collect fresh eggs every day.
meanings.example_cn: 我们养鸡，每天收集新鲜的鸡蛋。

meanings.definition: A young person who is not yet an adult.
meanings.example: Every child in the class got a sticker for good work.
meanings.example_cn: 班里每个孩子都因为表现好得到了一张贴纸。

meanings.definition: A cold feeling.
meanings.example: I felt a chill when I forgot my jacket on a cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷的时候我忘了穿外套，感到一阵冷。

meanings.definition: To relax.
meanings.example: Let’s chill on the couch and watch a movie after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我们瘫在沙发上看个电影吧。

meanings.definition: To make something cold.
meanings.example: Put the juice in the fridge to chill before we drink it.
meanings.example_cn: 把果汁放进冰箱冰一下再喝。

meanings.definition: The part of the face below the mouth.
meanings.example: She rested her chin on her hands while she listened to the story.
meanings.example_cn: 她双手托着下巴听故事。

meanings.definition: A small piece broken off something.
meanings.example: A small chip of pottery was found buried in the soil of the old garden.
meanings.example_cn: 在老花园的泥土里发现了一小块陶器碎片。

meanings.definition: To break off a small piece.
meanings.example: Be careful not to chip your tooth when eating hard candy.
meanings.example_cn: 吃硬糖的时候小心别崩了牙。

meanings.definition: A thin, crispy slice of potato that is fried or baked until crunchy and usually sprinkled with salt or other flavours.
meanings.example: Sam grabbed a potato chip from the bowl and crunched it loudly.
meanings.example_cn: 萨姆从碗里拿起一片薯片，咔嚓咔嚓大声咬着。

meanings.definition: A sweet brown treat made from cocoa beans.
meanings.example: I love chocolate ice cream on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 天热时我喜欢吃巧克力冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: The act of picking one thing or option from a group.
meanings.example: You have a choice between juice and milk.
meanings.example_cn: 你可以在果汁和牛奶之间做选择。

meanings.definition: To cut something with a quick blow.
meanings.example: Dad asked me to help him chop the carrots for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸让我帮他切晚饭用的胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: The act of cutting with a quick blow.
meanings.example: With one chop, Dad split the log for our campfire.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸一斧子就把木柴劈好了，给我们的篝火用。

meanings.definition: A small piece of meat.
