meanings.example: Mom bought a lamb chop for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈买了一块羊排当晚饭。

meanings.definition: A building where Christians gather to pray and worship.
meanings.example: We sang songs at church on Sunday morning.
meanings.example_cn: 周日上午我们在教堂唱歌。

meanings.definition: A large town with many buildings and people.
meanings.example: The city lights sparkle at night like stars.
meanings.example_cn: 夜晚的城市灯光像星星一样闪烁。

meanings.definition: To hit your hands together to make a sound, often to show you liked something.
meanings.example: Everyone began to clap after the play was over.
meanings.example_cn: 演出结束后，所有人都开始鼓掌。

meanings.definition: The sound you make when you quickly hit your hands together.
meanings.example: The audience gave a loud clap when the magician finished his trick.
meanings.example_cn: 魔术师表演完戏法时，观众们大声鼓掌。

meanings.definition: A group of students who learn together.
meanings.example: Our class learned about planets in science today.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班今天在科学课上学习了行星。

meanings.definition: A lesson at school.
meanings.example: Our science class learned about planets today.
meanings.example_cn: 我们今天在科学课上学到了行星相关内容。

meanings.definition: A sharp nail on an animal.
meanings.example: The cat stretched out its paw and showed its sharp claws.
meanings.example_cn: 猫伸出爪子，露出尖尖的指甲。

meanings.definition: To scratch or tear with claws.
meanings.example: The kitten tried to claw the couch with her sharp nails.
meanings.example_cn: 小猫想用她尖尖的爪子抓沙发。

meanings.definition: Soft earth used to make pots.
meanings.example: We can mould wet clay into little animal figures in our art lesson today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天美术课上我们可以把湿黏土捏成小动物的形状。

meanings.definition: To remove dirt so something is not dirty.
meanings.example: Please clean your room before your friends come over.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友来之前请打扫你的房间。

meanings.definition: Not dirty or having no mess.
meanings.example: My shoes are clean because I wiped them on the mat.
meanings.example_cn: 我的鞋很干净，因为我在垫子上擦了擦。

meanings.definition: Easy to see.
meanings.example: The water in the glass was so clear I could see right through it.
meanings.example_cn: 杯子里的水清澈极了，我一眼就能看穿。

meanings.definition: To remove things so a space is empty or neat.
meanings.example: Please clear your desk before the test begins.
meanings.example_cn: 考试开始前请把你的桌面收拾干净。

meanings.definition: Easy to understand.
meanings.example: The teacher gave clear instructions so everyone knew what to do.
meanings.example_cn: 老师给出清晰的指示，让每个人都知道该做什么。

meanings.definition: To press a button on a computer mouse or device.
meanings.example: Please click the blue button to open the next page.
meanings.example_cn: 请点击蓝色按钮打开下一页。

meanings.definition: A short, sharp sound, like when you press a button or mouse.
meanings.example: I heard a click when I turned on the lamp.
meanings.example_cn: 我开灯的时候听到咔哒一声。

meanings.definition: To make a short, sharp sound.
meanings.example: She clicked her pen open before starting to write.
meanings.example_cn: 她写字前按开了按动钢笔。

meanings.definition: A steep, high rock face, often by the sea.
meanings.example: We stood safely away from the edge of the high cliff.
meanings.example_cn: 我们安全地站在高耸悬崖的边缘之外。

meanings.definition: The usual type of weather in a place over a long time.
meanings.example: The climate here is warm and sunny in summer.
meanings.example_cn: 这里的气候夏天温暖晴朗。

meanings.definition: To go up something, like a tree or ladder.
meanings.example: We will climb the tall tree to see the view from above.
meanings.example_cn: 我们要爬上那棵高大的树，从上面看风景。

meanings.definition: The act of going up something, like a hill, mountain, or ladder.
meanings.example: The climb up the mountain was very exciting.
meanings.example_cn: 攀登这座山的过程特别刺激。

meanings.definition: A small medical centre where people go to see a doctor or nurse.
meanings.example: I had to visit the clinic when I had a sore throat.
meanings.example_cn: 我喉咙疼时去了诊所。

meanings.definition: A small object to hold things together.
meanings.example: I used a bright hair clip to hold my fringe back from my eyes.
meanings.example_cn: 我用一个亮色的发夹把刘海别到眼睛后面。

meanings.definition: To fasten with a clip.
meanings.example: Clip the papers together so they don’t get lost.
meanings.example_cn: 把文件用夹子夹在一起，免得弄丢。

meanings.definition: A loose coat.
meanings.example: The magician wore a long, black cloak that flowed behind him.
meanings.example_cn: 魔术师穿着一件长长的黑斗篷，在身后飘着。

meanings.definition: A device that shows what time it is.
meanings.example: The clock on the wall shows it’s almost lunchtime.
meanings.example_cn: 墙上的钟显示快到午饭时间了。

meanings.definition: To measure or record how much time something takes.
meanings.example: The coach clocked my running time at practice.
meanings.example_cn: 训练的时候教练记录下了我的跑步用时。

meanings.definition: To keep track of time when starting or finishing work.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to clock in when you get to work.
meanings.example_cn: 到岗时别忘了打卡。

meanings.definition: To shut something, like a door or window.
meanings.example: Please close the window if you feel chilly.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你觉得冷，请关上窗户。

meanings.definition: To bring something to an end or finish it.
meanings.example: The store will close at 8 p.m. tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 这家商店今晚八点关门。

meanings.definition: Not far away in distance or time.
meanings.example: The library is close to my house.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆离我家很近。

meanings.definition: Material made by weaving threads together.
meanings.example: Use this soft cloth to wipe mud off your shoes before stepping inside.
meanings.example_cn: 进屋前用这块软布把鞋上的泥擦掉。

meanings.definition: A white or grey shape in the sky made of tiny drops of water.
meanings.example: A fluffy cloud drifted slowly across the blue sky.
meanings.example_cn: 一团蓬松的云缓缓飘过蓝天。

meanings.definition: To become cloudy.
meanings.example: The smoke from the campfire began to cloud the sky.
meanings.example_cn: 篝火升起的浓烟开始遮蔽天空。

meanings.definition: To make something harder to see or understand.
meanings.example: The fog began to cloud the view outside.
meanings.example_cn: 雾气开始遮蔽外面的景色。

meanings.definition: A funny performer at a circus.
meanings.example: The silly clown juggled colourful balls and made all the children laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑抛接彩色的球，把所有孩子都逗笑了。

meanings.definition: A group of people who meet for a reason.
meanings.example: After school, I go to the art club to paint with my friends.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我去美术社团和朋友们一起画画。

meanings.definition: A special stick or bat that players use to hit a ball in sports.
meanings.example: The golfer swung his club and hit the ball across the field.
meanings.example_cn: 高尔夫球手挥起球杆，把球打过了球场。

meanings.definition: To hit with a heavy stick or club.
meanings.example: In stories, cavemen would club things to hunt for food.
meanings.example_cn: 故事里，穴居人会用棍子打东西来捕猎找吃的。

meanings.definition: Something that helps solve a problem or mystery.
meanings.example: The footprint in the mud was a helpful clue for solving our treasure hunt.
meanings.example_cn: 泥地上的脚印是我们寻宝游戏里一个有用的线索。

meanings.definition: To give a hint or information to help solve something.
meanings.example: The teacher will clue us in if we need help solving the puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我们解谜需要帮忙，老师会给我们提示的。

meanings.definition: A large bus for many people.
meanings.example: We all rode the coach to the museum for our class field trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我们全班乘大巴去博物馆郊游。

meanings.definition: A person who trains and helps a team or person to do better.
meanings.example: Our soccer coach taught us how to work together as a team.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的足球教练教我们如何作为一个团队合作。

meanings.definition: To teach or help someone get better at a skill or sport.
meanings.example: My mom will coach our soccer team this year.
meanings.example_cn: 今年我妈妈会当咱们足球队的教练。

meanings.definition: The land next to the sea.
meanings.example: We walked along the coast and collected seashells.
meanings.example_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步捡贝壳。

meanings.definition: A piece of clothing you wear over your clothes to keep warm.
meanings.example: Don’t forget your warm coat when it’s chilly outside.
meanings.example_cn: 外面冷时别忘了穿厚外套。

meanings.definition: To cover something with a thin layer of something
meanings.example: Please coat the cake with chocolate icing.
meanings.example_cn: 请给蛋糕抹上巧克力糖霜。

meanings.definition: A round piece of metal money.
meanings.example: I dropped a shiny silver coin into my piggy bank to save for a new toy.
meanings.example_cn: 我把一枚闪亮的银币扔进存钱罐，攒钱买新玩具。

meanings.definition: Not warm, so it has a low temperature.
meanings.example: The water in the pool was very cold this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 今天早上游泳池里的水很冷。

meanings.definition: Not caring about other people’s feelings, being unfriendly or mean.
meanings.example: His cold words made everyone feel sad.
meanings.example_cn: 他冷冰冰的话语让所有人都感到难过。

meanings.definition: A sickness that makes your nose run or your throat sore.
meanings.example: I caught a cold and had to stay home from school.
meanings.example_cn: 我感冒了，只好请假待在家里。

meanings.definition: Having lots of bright and different colours.
meanings.definition_cn: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
meanings.example: She wore a colourful bracelet with blue and green beads.
meanings.example_cn: 她戴着一串有蓝绿珠子的彩色手链。

meanings.definition: Things or people arranged in a straight line vertically.
meanings.example: We stood in a column while waiting for the school bus.
meanings.example_cn: 等校车时我们站成一竖列。

meanings.definition: A tool for brushing hair.
meanings.example: Take your comb and gently untangle the knots in your long hair.
meanings.example_cn: 拿梳子把你长头发上的结轻轻梳开。

meanings.definition: To untangle or smooth hair with a comb.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to comb your hair before school.
meanings.example_cn: 上学前别忘了梳头。

meanings.definition: To move towards the place where you are or someone else is.
meanings.example: Please come to the kitchen for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 请到厨房来吃晚饭。

meanings.definition: To arrive at a place or event.
meanings.example: The train will come at exactly five o'clock.
meanings.example_cn: 火车会在整五点到达。

meanings.definition: A bright object in space with a tail.
meanings.example: We stayed up late to spot the bright comet streaking across the night sky.
meanings.example_cn: 我们熬夜等着看那颗明亮的彗星划过夜空。

meanings.definition: A feeling of being safe and relaxed.
meanings.example: My favourite blanket gives me comfort when I feel scared at night.
meanings.example_cn: 晚上我害怕的时候，我最喜欢的毯子会给我安慰。

meanings.definition: To make someone feel better when they are sad or upset.
meanings.example: Mom will comfort you when you feel sad or scared.
meanings.example_cn: 你难过或害怕的时候，妈妈会安慰你的。

meanings.definition: Something funny.
meanings.example: The comic play made everyone giggle loudly in the school hall.
meanings.example_cn: 那出搞笑的戏剧把学校礼堂里的所有人都逗得哈哈大笑。

meanings.definition: A magazine or book that tells a story using pictures and words, often in little boxes called panels.
meanings.example: Liam loves to read a comic every night before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 利亚姆每晚睡觉前都喜欢看漫画。

meanings.definition: To tell someone what to do by giving an order.
meanings.example: The captain will command the crew to get ready to sail.
meanings.example_cn: 船长会命令船员准备好起航。

meanings.definition: An order telling someone what to do.
meanings.example: The dog followed the command to sit and wait for a treat.
meanings.example_cn: 狗听从了坐下等待的命令，等着零食。

meanings.definition: A remark or statement.
meanings.example: She raised her hand to make a comment about the story.
meanings.example_cn: 她举手想对故事发表看法。

meanings.definition: To say what you think or give an opinion.
meanings.example: Please comment on what you liked about the story.
meanings.example_cn: 请说说你喜欢这个故事的哪些地方。

meanings.definition: To look for similarities and differences.
meanings.example: Let’s compare our drawings to see what’s different.
meanings.example_cn: 我们比比看谁的画有什么不一样。

meanings.definition: To say that something is wrong or you are not happy about it.
meanings.example: Please don’t complain about the chores; we all help out.
meanings.example_cn: 请不要抱怨家务，我们都要帮忙。

meanings.definition: Something that goes well with another thing.
meanings.example: Peanut butter is the perfect complement to jelly on my sandwich.
meanings.example_cn: 花生酱和果冻在我的三明治里是绝配。

meanings.definition: To go well with something or make it better.
meanings.example: The red scarf will complement your blue jacket nicely.
meanings.example_cn: 红围巾配你的蓝外套会很好看。

meanings.definition: Finished.
meanings.example: Our art project is complete, so we can hand it in to the teacher this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的手工作品做完了，今天早上可以交给老师了。

meanings.definition: To finish or make something whole.
meanings.example: I need to complete my homework before I can play.
meanings.example_cn: 我得先把作业做完才能玩。

meanings.definition: Having everything needed and nothing is missing.
meanings.example: My puzzle is complete now that I found the last piece.
meanings.example_cn: 我找到了最后一块拼图，我的拼图就完整了。

meanings.definition: Hard to understand because it has many parts.
meanings.example: The maths puzzle was complex but fun to solve.
meanings.example_cn: 这道数学题很复杂，但解起来很有趣。

meanings.definition: To give full attention.
meanings.example: Please concentrate on your reading so you do not miss any important parts of the story.
meanings.example_cn: 请专心读书，这样你就不会漏掉故事里的重要部分。

meanings.definition: To show that something is true.
meanings.example: Mum will confirm with the teacher whether our picnic is still on this Saturday.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈会跟老师确认一下我们这周六的野餐还去不去。

meanings.definition: To make something unclear.
meanings.example: The tricky puzzle confused me, so I asked for help.
meanings.example_cn: 这个很难的谜题把我难住了，所以我找人求助。

meanings.definition: To think about something carefully.
meanings.example: Please consider everyone’s ideas before making a decision.
meanings.example_cn: 做决定之前请考虑大家的想法。

meanings.definition: To keep going.
meanings.example: Even though it started to rain, we continued our soccer game.
meanings.example_cn: 虽然开始下雨了，我们还是继续踢足球。

meanings.definition: To have power over something.
meanings.example: Use the remote to control the TV.
meanings.example_cn: 用遥控器来控制电视。

meanings.definition: The power to make decisions or direct something.
meanings.example: He lost control of his bike and fell over.
meanings.example_cn: 他控制不住自行车，摔倒了。

meanings.definition: To make someone believe something.
meanings.example: I tried to convince my little brother that carrots are tasty, but he still said no.
meanings.example_cn: 我试着说服我弟弟胡萝卜很好吃，但他还是不要。

meanings.definition: To make food by heating it.
meanings.example: My sister wants to learn how to cook chocolate chip cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 我妹妹想要学习如何烤巧克力豆曲奇饼干。

meanings.definition: A person whose job is making food.
meanings.example: The cook in the cafeteria makes the best spaghetti in school.
meanings.example_cn: 食堂的厨师做的意大利面是全校最好吃的。

meanings.definition: A small, sweet baked treat.
meanings.example: I baked a big chocolate chip cookie for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 我烤了一块大大的巧克力曲奇当甜点。

meanings.definition: A little cold, but not too cold.
meanings.example: The cool breeze felt nice on my face.
meanings.example_cn: 凉爽的微风拂过我的脸，很舒服。

meanings.definition: To become or make something less hot
meanings.example: Let the cookies cool before you eat them.
meanings.example_cn: 饼干放凉之后再吃。

meanings.definition: To work together.
meanings.example: We must cooperate if we want to finish building the puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 我们想拼完拼图就必须合作。

meanings.definition: A police officer.
meanings.example: The cop helped the lost child find her parents in the busy park.
meanings.example_cn: 警察在热闹的公园里帮迷路的小女孩找到了爸爸妈妈。

meanings.definition: To make something just like another.
meanings.example: Please don’t copy my answers during the test.
meanings.example_cn: 考试的时候请不要抄我的答案。

meanings.definition: Something that is made to look exactly like another thing.
meanings.example: I made a copy of my drawing for my friend to keep.
meanings.example_cn: 我把我的画复印了一张给朋友留着。

meanings.definition: A hard, colourful substance from the sea.
meanings.example: Bright fish swim between the colourful coral under the clear blue sea.
meanings.example_cn: 在清澈的蓝色海底下，鲜艳的鱼儿在五颜六色的珊瑚之间游来游去。

meanings.definition: A tall plant with yellow seeds that people and animals eat.
meanings.example: We ate sweet corn on the cob at the picnic.
meanings.example_cn: 野餐时我们吃了玉米棒子上的甜玉米。

meanings.definition: Free from mistakes and completely right.
meanings.example: All your answers on the maths worksheet are correct, great work!
meanings.example_cn: 你数学练习册上所有答案都对，做得好！

meanings.definition: To fix a mistake or make something right.
meanings.example: I will correct my mistakes on the test before turning it in.
meanings.example_cn: 交卷之前我会把试卷上的错误改过来。

meanings.definition: The amount of money needed to buy something.
meanings.example: The cost of this colourful notebook is two pounds.
meanings.example_cn: 这本彩色笔记本的价格是两英镑。

meanings.definition: To have a price or need money to buy.
meanings.example: How much does it cost to buy this toy?
meanings.example_cn: 买这个玩具要花多少钱？

meanings.definition: A small, simple bed.
meanings.example: When we went camping, I slept on a small cot in the tent.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去露营的时候，我睡在帐篷里的一张小折叠床上。

meanings.definition: To force air out of your lungs with a loud sound, usually when you’re sick.
meanings.example: Cover your mouth when you cough to keep others healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 咳嗽时捂住嘴，让大家保持健康。

meanings.definition: An illness that makes you cough.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school because I had a bad cough.
meanings.example_cn: 我咳嗽得很厉害，所以待在家里没去上学。

meanings.definition: The past tense of "can," showing you were able to do something before.
meanings.example: When I was five, I could already ride my bike without training wheels.
meanings.example_cn: 我五岁时就已经能不用辅助轮骑自行车了。

meanings.definition: Used to ask for something politely.
meanings.example: Could you please pass me the blue crayon so I can finish my drawing?
meanings.example_cn: 你能把蓝色的蜡笔递给我吗？我好完成我的画。

meanings.definition: To matter or be important.
meanings.example: It’s not who wins or loses that counts, but how you play the game.
meanings.example_cn: 重要的不是输赢，而是你比赛时的态度。

meanings.definition: To find out how many things there are.
meanings.example: Let’s count how many cookies are on the plate.
meanings.example_cn: 我们来数一数盘子里有多少块饼干吧。

meanings.definition: The total number of things that have been counted.
meanings.example: The count of apples in the basket was twelve.
meanings.example_cn: 篮子里苹果的数量是十二个。

meanings.definition: A long flat surface in a store or kitchen.
meanings.example: Put your fruit and snacks on the shop counter while the shopkeeper adds them up.
meanings.example_cn: 把水果和零食放到商店柜台上，等店主算钱。

meanings.definition: To act against something.
meanings.example: She tried to counter his argument with a good reason.
meanings.example_cn: 她想用一个好理由来反驳他的观点。

meanings.definition: A nation with its own land and people.
meanings.example: France is a country in Europe.
meanings.example_cn: 法国是欧洲的一个国家。

meanings.definition: Land outside of cities and towns, the countryside.
meanings.example: We spent the weekend in the country, surrounded by fields.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在乡下度过了周末，周围都是田野。

meanings.definition: A path to follow.
meanings.example: The running course went through the forest and around the lake.
meanings.example_cn: 跑步路线穿过森林，绕着湖跑。

meanings.definition: A series of lessons on one subject.
meanings.example: I signed up for a painting course so I can learn how to make beautiful art.
meanings.example_cn: 我报名参加了一门绘画课，学习如何创作美丽的画。

meanings.definition: A place where some sports are played.
meanings.example: We played basketball on the new school court.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在学校新建的篮球场上打篮球。

meanings.definition: A place where judges work.
meanings.example: The judge listened to everyone’s stories in the court before making a decision.
meanings.example_cn: 法官在做决定前听了法庭上每个人的陈述。

meanings.definition: To put something over or on top.
meanings.example: Cover your mouth when you sneeze so you don’t spread germs.
meanings.example_cn: 打喷嚏的时候捂住嘴，这样就不会传播细菌。

meanings.definition: Something that goes over or hides something.
meanings.example: Put a cover on your book to keep it clean.
meanings.example_cn: 给书包上书皮，保持干净。

meanings.definition: A large farm animal that gives milk.
meanings.example: We saw a cow grazing in the field on our walk.
meanings.example_cn: 我们散步时看见一头牛在田野里吃草。

meanings.definition: Warm and comfortable.
meanings.example: Our small reading corner feels so cozy with soft blankets and warm lamplight.
meanings.example_cn: 我们小小的阅读角铺着软毯子、透着暖黄的灯光，感觉特别温馨。

meanings.definition: A sea animal with a hard shell and two big claws.
meanings.example: The crab scuttled sideways along the sandy shore.
meanings.example_cn: 螃蟹在沙岸边横着爬行。

meanings.definition: A thin break or split.
meanings.example: A tiny crack appeared in my favourite cup.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的杯子上出现了一道小裂纹。

meanings.definition: To break something so that it has lines but does not separate.
meanings.example: Be careful not to crack the egg when you put it in the bowl.
meanings.example_cn: 把鸡蛋打进碗里的时候小心别弄裂了。

meanings.definition: Skill at making things by hand.
meanings.example: Ann has wonderful craft; she can make lovely little dolls from old fabric.
meanings.example_cn: 安的手工特别好，她能用旧布料做出可爱的小娃娃。

meanings.definition: To make something by hand.
meanings.example: We will craft paper flowers for Mother’s Day.
meanings.example_cn: 我们要为母亲节做纸花。

meanings.definition: A loud, violent accident.
meanings.example: We heard a loud crash from the garden when the flower pot fell off the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 花盆从墙上掉下来的时候，我们听到花园里传来很大的一声响声。

meanings.definition: To hit something hard.
meanings.example: The two cars might crash if they don’t stop at the light.
meanings.example_cn: 两辆车如果看到红灯不停下来，可能会撞在一起。

meanings.definition: To want something very much.
meanings.example: I always crave cold watermelon on hot sunny summer afternoons.
meanings.example_cn: 在炎热晴朗的夏日午后，我总是特别想吃冰西瓜。

meanings.definition: To move slowly along the ground, often on hands and knees.
meanings.example: The baby started to crawl across the carpet.
meanings.example_cn: 宝宝开始在地毯上爬。

meanings.definition: A very slow pace.
meanings.example: The snail moved at a slow crawl across the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 蜗牛在花园里缓缓爬行。

meanings.definition: Very silly or wild.
meanings.example: We made crazy faces and laughed until our tummies hurt.
meanings.example_cn: 我们做鬼脸，笑得肚子都疼了。

meanings.definition: Not making sense or very strange.
meanings.example: That’s a crazy idea—building a house out of candy!
meanings.example_cn: 用糖果来盖房子，这想法太离谱啦！

meanings.definition: Very enthusiastic or excited about something.
meanings.example: He’s crazy about dinosaurs and knows all their names.
meanings.example_cn: 他特别喜欢恐龙，所有恐龙的名字他都知道。

meanings.definition: The thick, rich part of milk used in cooking or desserts.
meanings.example: I put whipped cream on top of my pie.
meanings.example_cn: 我在馅饼上放了鲜奶油。

meanings.definition: To make something new.
meanings.example: Let’s use these blocks to create a castle together.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用这些积木一起搭一座城堡吧。

meanings.definition: To move quietly and slowly so no one notices.
meanings.example: The cat likes to creep quietly around the house at night.
meanings.example_cn: 猫喜欢在夜里悄悄地在屋子里走动。

meanings.definition: Slow, quiet movement.
meanings.definition_cn: 缓慢而悄无声息的移动
meanings.example: The mouse moved in a slow creep across the floor.
meanings.example_cn: 老鼠悄无声息地慢慢爬过地板。

meanings.definition: A jumping insect.
meanings.example: I heard a cricket chirping outside my window at night.
meanings.example_cn: 夜里我听见窗外有蟋蟀在鸣叫。

meanings.definition: A game played with bats, a ball, and wickets.
meanings.example: We played cricket in the park after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我们在公园里打板球。

meanings.definition: Firm and crunchy.
meanings.example: The apple was so crisp it made a loud crunch when I bit it.
meanings.example_cn: 这个苹果特别脆，我咬下去的时候嘎嘣一声很响。

meanings.definition: A thin, crunchy slice of potato that has been fried or baked and is eaten as a snack.
meanings.example: She opened a bag of crisps and shared them with her friends at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 她打开一袋薯片，午饭时和朋友们一起分享。

meanings.definition: A large, dangerous reptile that lives in water and has a long mouth.
meanings.example: The crocodile swam slowly through the river.
meanings.example_cn: 鳄鱼慢慢地游过河流。

meanings.definition: A plant grown by farmers.
meanings.example: Wheat is an important crop that the farmer grows every year in his big field.
meanings.example_cn: 小麦是一种重要的农作物，农民每年都在他的大田里种。

meanings.definition: To cut short or harvest plants.
meanings.example: Farmers crop the wheat in the fields every summer.
meanings.example_cn: 农民每年夏天在田里收割小麦。

meanings.definition: To go from one side to the other.
meanings.example: Hold my hand when we cross the street.
meanings.example_cn: 我们过马路的时候牵着我的手。

meanings.definition: A shape with two lines that meet in the middle.
meanings.example: Draw a cross on your answer sheet to show your choice.
meanings.example_cn: 在你的答题纸上画个叉来表示你的选择。

meanings.definition: Angry or annoyed.
meanings.example: Mum was cross when I forgot my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我忘了作业，妈妈很生气。

meanings.definition: A large group of people.
meanings.example: A big crowd gathered in the park to watch the parade and colourful floats.
meanings.example_cn: 一大群人聚在公园里看游行和五颜六色的花车。

meanings.definition: To gather closely together in a group.
meanings.example: Let’s not crowd around the table; everyone will get a turn.
meanings.example_cn: 我们别挤在桌子旁边，每个人都会轮到的。

meanings.definition: A royal headpiece.
meanings.example: The king wore a shiny gold crown on his head.
meanings.example_cn: 国王头上戴着闪亮的金王冠。

meanings.definition: To make someone a king or queen.
meanings.example: At the school play, they will crown Lily as the queen on stage.
meanings.example_cn: 在学校戏剧里，他们会在舞台上把莉莉加冕为女王。

meanings.definition: Mean and enjoying hurting others.
meanings.definition_cn: 残忍的；以伤害他人为乐的
meanings.example: It’s cruel to tease someone about their feelings.
meanings.example_cn: 拿别人的感情开玩笑是残忍的。

meanings.definition: A tiny piece of bread or cake.
meanings.example: I found a crumb of cookie on my shirt after snack time.
meanings.example_cn: 吃完点心后，我在衬衫上发现了一粒饼干屑。

meanings.definition: The hard outside layer of something.
meanings.example: I like to eat the pizza crust first.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢先吃披萨边。

meanings.definition: To form a hard outer layer.
meanings.example: If you leave bread out, it will crust and become hard.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你把面包放在外面，它会结皮变硬。

meanings.definition: To shout loudly.
meanings.example: We all had to cry for help when our soccer ball got stuck in a tall tree.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的足球卡在高树上时，我们都不得不呼救。

meanings.definition: To weep or shed tears because you are sad or hurt.
meanings.example: The movie was so sad it made me cry, and I had tears in my eyes.
meanings.example_cn: 这部电影太悲伤了，让我哭了，眼里满是泪水。

meanings.definition: A loud shout or call.
meanings.example: I heard a cry for help on the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我在操场上听到了一声呼救。

meanings.definition: A solid shape with six equal square sides.
meanings.example: A dice is a cube, with six square faces and numbers on each side.
meanings.example_cn: 骰子是个立方体，有六个正方形的面，每个面上都有数字。

meanings.definition: To cut into square pieces.
meanings.example: Please cube the cheese for our snack.
meanings.example_cn: 请把奶酪切成小块当我们的零食。

meanings.definition: A small container with a handle for drinking from.
meanings.example: I drank a cup of warm cocoa after playing in the snow.
meanings.example_cn: 玩完雪后我喝了一杯热可可。

meanings.definition: To hold something with your hands shaped like a cup.
meanings.example: She cupped her hands to drink from the fountain.
meanings.example_cn: 她双手窝成杯状，从喷泉里喝水。

meanings.definition: A line that bends.
meanings.example: The road had a sharp curve, so we had to slow down.
meanings.example_cn: 路上有个急转弯，所以我们得减速。

meanings.definition: To bend in a smooth, rounded way.
meanings.example: The river will curve around the bend before it gets to the lake.
meanings.example_cn: 河流在到达湖泊之前会拐个弯。

meanings.definition: To divide something into pieces using something sharp, like a knife or scissors.
meanings.example: Please cut the paper into small squares for the project.
meanings.example_cn: 请把纸剪成小方块，用于这个项目。

meanings.definition: To make something smaller or reduce its amount.
meanings.example: We need to cut the sugar in the recipe to make it healthier.
meanings.example_cn: 我们需要减少食谱中的糖，让它更健康。

meanings.definition: A small opening or wound on the skin made by something sharp.
meanings.example: I have a small cut on my finger from the paper.
meanings.example_cn: 我的手指被纸划了一道小口子。

meanings.definition: Sweet and charming.
meanings.example: That fluffy baby rabbit looks really cute as it hops around the grass.
meanings.example_cn: 那只毛茸茸的小兔子在草地上跳来跳去，看起来真可爱。

meanings.definition: Something that repeats in the same order.
meanings.example: The seasons follow a cycle: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
meanings.example_cn: 四季循环：春、夏、秋、冬。

meanings.definition: To go through a repeating process.
meanings.example: The washing machine will cycle through rinse and spin before it’s done.
meanings.example_cn: 洗衣机会走完漂洗和脱水的程序，然后才结束。

meanings.definition: To ride a bicycle.
meanings.example: We cycle to school every morning together.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每天早上一起骑车去上学。

meanings.definition: A father.
meanings.example: My dad makes the best pancakes on Saturday mornings.
meanings.example_cn: 我爸爸周六早上做的煎饼最好吃。

meanings.definition: Foods that are made from milk, such as cream, butter, and cheese.
meanings.example: I like to eat dairy foods like cheese and yogurt with my lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 我午饭喜欢吃奶酪和酸奶这样的乳制品。

meanings.definition: A small white flower with a yellow centre.
meanings.example: I picked a daisy and put it in my hair.
meanings.example_cn: 我摘了一朵小雏菊，插在头发上。

meanings.definition: A wall built to hold back water in a river.
meanings.example: The strong stone dam holds back the river water to make a big lake.
meanings.example_cn: 坚固的石头大坝挡住河水，形成了一个大湖。

meanings.definition: To build a wall or barrier to stop or hold back water.
meanings.example: Beavers will dam the stream to make a pond.
meanings.example_cn: 海狸会在小溪上筑坝来造一个池塘。

meanings.definition: A little bit wet.
meanings.example: My socks got damp when I stepped in a puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 我踩进水坑的时候袜子湿了。

meanings.definition: To move your body to music.
meanings.example: We love to dance around the living room when our favourite song comes on.
meanings.example_cn: 最喜欢的歌响起的时候，我们喜欢在客厅里跳舞。

meanings.definition: A set of steps or movements done to music.
meanings.example: We learned a new dance in gym class today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天体育课上学了一个新舞蹈。

meanings.definition: Not safe and can cause harm or injury.
meanings.example: It’s dangerous to run into the street without looking.
meanings.example_cn: 不看路就冲进马路很危险。

meanings.definition: To be brave enough to do something that might be scary or hard.
meanings.example: I dare you to try the big slide at the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我向你挑战去试玩公园里那个大滑梯。

meanings.definition: A challenge to do something brave or risky
meanings.example: My friend gave me a dare to jump over the puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 我朋友激我跳过那个水坑。

meanings.definition: Having very little or no light, making it hard to see.
meanings.example: It gets very dark outside when there are no streetlights.
meanings.example_cn: 没有路灯时外面会变得很黑。

meanings.definition: When there is no light, darkness.
meanings.example: I use a nightlight because I don’t like the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 我开小夜灯，因为我怕黑。

meanings.definition: To run or move very quickly.
meanings.example: As soon as the school bell rang, we all dashed outside to play in the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 下课铃一响，我们全都冲到外面去操场上玩耍。

meanings.definition: A short, fast run from one place to another, usually because you’re in a hurry.
meanings.example: After lunch, we had a quick dash across the playground to get to our next lesson on time.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后，我们飞快地穿过操场，准时赶去上下一节课。

meanings.definition: A dash is a straight line (–) used in writing to show a pause or to separate parts of a sentence.
meanings.example: Put a dash between the two numbers, like 5–7.
meanings.example_cn: 在两个数字中间加一个破折号，例如 5–7。

meanings.definition: A day on the calendar.
meanings.example: Circle your birthday on the calendar so we remember the date.
meanings.example_cn: 在日历上把你的生日圈出来，这样我们就记得日期了。

meanings.definition: To spend time with someone in a special way because you like them.
meanings.example: My parents like to date by going to dinner together.
meanings.example_cn: 我爸妈喜欢一起出去吃饭约会。

meanings.definition: The time when the sun first rises in the morning.
meanings.example: We woke up at dawn to watch the sun slowly rise over the hills.
meanings.example_cn: 我们天没亮就起来了，看太阳慢慢从山后面升起来。

meanings.definition: To suddenly start to understand something.
meanings.example: It began to dawn on me that I forgot my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我突然意识到我忘了写作业。

meanings.definition: The time from when the sun comes up until it goes down.
meanings.example: We spent the whole day playing at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在海滩上玩了一整天。

meanings.definition: A period of 24 hours from midnight to midnight.
meanings.example: There are seven days in a week.
meanings.example_cn: 一周有七天。

meanings.definition: Not alive anymore.
meanings.example: The plant looked dead because it hadn’t been watered in a long time.
meanings.example_cn: 那植物看起来已经死了，因为很久没浇水了。

meanings.definition: Not able to hear.
meanings.example: The deaf girl uses sign language to chat happily with her friends at school.
meanings.example_cn: 那个失聪的女孩用手语在学校和朋友们开心地聊天。

meanings.definition: An agreement between people.
meanings.example: We made a deal to clean our room before playing outside.
meanings.example_cn: 我们说好，出去玩之前先把房间收拾干净。

meanings.definition: To take care of a problem or situation.
meanings.example: Let’s deal with the mess before we start a new activity.
meanings.example_cn: 我们先把这堆乱七八糟的收拾好，再开始新活动。

meanings.definition: Someone loved very much.
meanings.example: This old teddy bear is very dear to me; I have had it since I was a baby.
meanings.example_cn: 这只旧泰迪熊对我来说很珍贵，我从小就抱着它。

meanings.definition: The end of life.
meanings.example: The old tree’s death made the forest feel different.
meanings.example_cn: 老树死了之后，森林感觉不一样了。

meanings.definition: The twelfth and last month of the year.
meanings.example: December is fun because of all the holidays.
meanings.example_cn: 十二月因为各种节日而很有趣。

meanings.definition: To choose what to do.
meanings.example: It is hard to decide whether I want vanilla or strawberry ice cream today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天我想吃香草味还是草莓味冰淇淋，好难决定啊。

meanings.definition: The choice you make after thinking about something.
meanings.example: After thinking about it, Mia made a decision to eat the chocolate ice cream instead of the vanilla.
meanings.example_cn: 仔细考虑之后，米娅决定选巧克力冰淇淋，而不是香草味的。

meanings.definition: The floor or platform on a ship.
meanings.example: We sat on the deck and watched the sunset over the water.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐在甲板上，看水面上的日落。

meanings.definition: To decorate or cover something to make it look nice.
meanings.example: We will deck the classroom with colourful paper chains for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们要用彩色纸链装饰教室，准备派对。

meanings.definition: A complete set of playing cards used for card games.
meanings.example: Before we started the game, I shuffled the deck and dealt the cards to everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 开始游戏之前，我把牌洗了洗，发给每个人。

meanings.definition: To make something look nicer.
meanings.example: We will decorate our Christmas tree with shiny baubles and twinkly lights.
meanings.example_cn: 我们会用闪亮的装饰球和闪烁的小灯来装饰圣诞树。

meanings.definition: Something important that someone does.
meanings.example: Helping an elderly neighbour carry shopping is a kind and thoughtful deed.
meanings.example_cn: 帮年迈的邻居拎东西是一件善良又贴心的好事。

meanings.definition: Going far down from the top or surface.
meanings.example: The lake near our house is very deep in the middle.
meanings.example_cn: 我们家附近的湖中央很深。

meanings.definition: A unit used to measure things like temperature or angles.
meanings.example: The thermometer showed a high degree of heat on the hot summer day.
meanings.example_cn: 在这个炎热的夏日，温度计显示温度很高。

meanings.definition: How much or how strong something is.
meanings.example: The puppy showed a great degree of happiness when it saw its owner come home.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗看到主人回家时，显得格外开心。

meanings.definition: A special paper or award you get after finishing college or university.
meanings.example: My aunt earned a degree in science.
meanings.example_cn: 我姑姑获得了理学学位。

meanings.definition: To make happen later than planned.
meanings.example: Heavy snow will delay our school bus, so we might arrive a little late.
meanings.example_cn: 大雪会耽误我们的校车，所以我们可能会晚到一会儿。

meanings.definition: A time when something is late or does not happen as planned.
meanings.example: There was a delay in the bus coming this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 今天早上公交车晚点了。

meanings.definition: To take something to a person or a place.
meanings.example: The mail carrier will deliver our letters this afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 邮递员今天下午会把我们的信送到。

meanings.definition: A cozy place where wild animals, like bears or foxes, live and sleep.
meanings.example: The bear slept in its den during the winter.
meanings.example_cn: 这只熊冬天待在洞穴里睡觉。

meanings.definition: A doctor who takes care of people’s teeth.
meanings.example: The dentist checked my teeth and said they were healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，说它们很健康。

meanings.definition: To leave a place.
meanings.example: Our train will depart from platform three in five minutes, so hurry up!
meanings.example_cn: 我们的火车五分钟后从三号站台出发，快点！

meanings.definition: To make someone feel sad.
meanings.example: Grey rainy days can sometimes depress me and make me feel quiet and sad.
meanings.example_cn: 灰蒙蒙的下雨天有时候会让我心情低落，变得安安静静的、闷闷不乐。

meanings.definition: The distance from the top to the bottom.
meanings.example: The pool has different depths, so be careful where you jump in.
meanings.example_cn: 游泳池深浅不一，所以你跳下去的时候要小心。

meanings.definition: To tell what someone or something is like.
meanings.example: Can you describe what the puppy looks like for me?
meanings.example_cn: 你能给我描述一下这只小狗长什么样吗？

meanings.definition: To leave someone or something alone.
meanings.example: It is not kind to desert a friend when they need your help.
meanings.example_cn: 在朋友需要帮助时抛弃他们是不善良的。

meanings.definition: A dry, sandy area with very little rain or plants.
meanings.example: The camel walked across the hot, sandy desert for days.
meanings.example_cn: 骆驼在炎热多沙的沙漠里走了好几天。

meanings.definition: To plan how something will look.
meanings.example: We get to design our own T-shirts for the class trip.
meanings.example_cn: 班级旅行的时候我们可以自己设计T恤。

meanings.definition: A drawing or plan that shows how something will be made.
meanings.example: Mia drew a design for her dream treehouse on a piece of paper.
meanings.example_cn: 米娅在纸上画出了她梦想中的树屋设计图。

meanings.definition: The specific arrangement of shapes, colours, or decorations on something.
meanings.example: I like the design on your new backpack.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢你新背包上的图案。

meanings.definition: Something that you want very much.
meanings.example: Her biggest desire is to travel to another country.
meanings.example_cn: 她最大的愿望是去另一个国家旅行。

meanings.definition: To want something very much.
meanings.example: I desire to win the art contest this year.
meanings.example_cn: 我渴望今年赢得艺术比赛。

meanings.definition: A table where you sit to write, read, or work.
meanings.example: My desk is neat and has all my school supplies.
meanings.example_cn: 我的书桌很整洁，放着所有的学习用品。

meanings.definition: The sweet food you eat at the end of a meal.
meanings.example: My favourite dessert is strawberry ice cream.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的甜点是草莓冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: Tiny drops of water on cool things in the morning.
meanings.example: In the morning, there was dew on the grass that made my shoes wet.
meanings.example_cn: 早上草地上有露水，把我的鞋弄湿了。

meanings.definition: A book where you write about what happens each day.
meanings.example: I write about my adventures in my diary every night.
meanings.example_cn: 我每晚都在日记里写下我的冒险经历。

meanings.definition: Small cubes with dots used in games.
meanings.example: Roll the dice and move your game piece forward by that number of spaces.
meanings.example_cn: 掷骰子，然后按点数把你的棋子向前走相应的步数。

meanings.definition: To cut food into small square pieces.
meanings.example: Dice the carrots into tiny cubes for the soup.
meanings.example_cn: 把胡萝卜切成小丁来做汤。

meanings.definition: To stop living.
meanings.example: If we forget to water the small plant, it will slowly die.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我们忘了给小植物浇水，它会慢慢枯死。

meanings.definition: The food that a person eats.
meanings.example: My pet rabbit’s diet is mostly carrots and lettuce.
meanings.example_cn: 我宠物兔子的食物主要是胡萝卜和生菜。

meanings.definition: To eat less or choose special foods to be healthy.
meanings.example: Some people diet to feel healthy and strong.
meanings.example_cn: 有些人通过节食来让自己感觉健康强壮。

meanings.definition: Not the same as something or someone else.
meanings.example: My shoes are different colours today!
meanings.example_cn: 我今天穿了两只不同颜色的鞋！

meanings.definition: Made of many various kinds.
meanings.example: We tried different flavours of ice cream at the shop.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在店里尝了不同口味的冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: Hard to do or understand.
meanings.example: Some maths problems are difficult, but I keep trying.
meanings.example_cn: 有些数学题很难，但我一直在尝试。

meanings.definition: To make a hole in the ground.
meanings.example: We plan to dig a small hole in the garden to plant our sunflower seed.
meanings.example_cn: 我们打算在花园里挖个小洞，种下向日葵种子。

meanings.definition: A poke.
meanings.example: He gave me a gentle dig with his elbow to get my attention.
meanings.example_cn: 他用手肘轻轻碰了我一下，好让我注意他。

meanings.definition: A strong push with something.
meanings.example: During the soccer game, he gave the ball a hard dig with his foot to send it across the field.
meanings.example_cn: 足球比赛中，他用脚用力把球踢过了球场。

meanings.definition: A number.
meanings.example: The number 7 is a digit you can find on the clock.
meanings.example_cn: 数字7是你在时钟上能找到的一个数字。

meanings.definition: A finger or toe.
meanings.example: You have ten digits on your hands.
meanings.example_cn: 你两只手上一共有十根手指。

meanings.definition: Difficult to see because it is not bright.
meanings.example: The room grew dim once the sun went down behind the tall trees.
meanings.example_cn: 太阳落到高树后面之后，房间变暗了。

meanings.definition: To make something less bright or to become less bright.
meanings.example: Mom dimmed the lights in the living room so it would feel cozy.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈调暗客厅的灯光，让环境变得温馨舒适。

meanings.definition: To have a meal.
meanings.example: We will dine at my aunt’s house and eat homemade pasta for dinner tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 今晚我们要去姑姑家吃晚饭，吃自制的意面。

meanings.definition: A certificate you get when you finish a course or school.
meanings.example: She received a diploma for finishing kindergarten.
meanings.example_cn: 她拿到了幼儿园毕业证书。

meanings.definition: The loose soil or earth on the ground that you can dig, play in, or get on your hands when you’re outside.
meanings.example: I washed the dirt off my hands after playing outside.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完后，我洗掉了手上的泥土。

meanings.definition: Anything that makes things not clean.
meanings.example: After playing outside, there was dirt all over my hands and clothes.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完后，我的手上和衣服上都是泥土。

meanings.definition: Not clean, so it is covered with dust, mud, or mess.
meanings.example: My hands got dirty after playing in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 在花园里玩完后我的手弄脏了。

meanings.definition: To have a different idea or opinion from someone else.
meanings.example: It’s okay to disagree, but we should still be kind.
meanings.example_cn: 意见不同没关系，但我们仍然要友善。

meanings.definition: To go away so no one can see you.
meanings.example: The sunlight made the snow disappear from the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 阳光把院子里的雪晒化了。

meanings.definition: Feeling sad because something didn’t happen the way you wanted.
meanings.example: I was disappointed when the picnic was cancelled because of rain.
meanings.example_cn: 野餐因下雨取消时，我很失望。

meanings.definition: Something didn’t turn out as good or fun as you wanted, and it makes you feel a little sad or upset.
meanings.example: The magic show was disappointing; the tricks were not amazing at all.
meanings.example_cn: 这场魔术表演令人失望，那些戏法一点都不精彩。

meanings.definition: Teaching people to follow rules.
meanings.example: Good discipline helps everyone listen and learn in class.
meanings.example_cn: 好的纪律能帮大家在课堂上认真听讲、好好学习。

meanings.definition: To teach or train someone to follow rules.
meanings.example: It’s important to discipline yourself to finish your homework every day.
meanings.example_cn: 每天督促自己完成作业很重要。

meanings.definition: A lower price than usual.
meanings.example: We bought our new backpack at a big discount during the sale.
meanings.example_cn: 大促销的时候我们打了很大折扣买了新背包。

meanings.definition: To lower the price of something.
meanings.example: The store will discount all toys after the holidays.
meanings.example_cn: 假期过后商店会给所有玩具打折。

meanings.definition: To find something for the first time.
meanings.example: You might discover tiny bugs and snails if you look carefully under the log.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你仔细看木头下面，可能会发现小虫子和蜗牛。

meanings.definition: An illness that makes people, animals, or plants sick.
meanings.example: Washing your hands helps prevent disease and keeps you healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 洗手有助于预防疾病，让你保持健康。

meanings.definition: A bowl or plate for food.
meanings.example: I put my spaghetti in a big dish so I wouldn’t spill any.
meanings.example_cn: 我把意面盛在一个大盘子里，这样就不会洒出来。

meanings.definition: To put food onto plates and serve it.
meanings.example: Let’s dish out the ice cream into bowls for everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把冰淇淋分到每个碗里给大家。

meanings.definition: Not telling the truth or cheating.
meanings.example: It is dishonest to take something without asking.
meanings.example_cn: 没问就拿别人的东西是不诚实的。

meanings.definition: How far it is between two things.
meanings.example: The distance between my house and the park is two blocks.
meanings.example_cn: 我家到公园的距离是两个街区。

meanings.definition: To take attention away from something.
meanings.example: The loud music distracted me while I was trying to do my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我做作业的时候，大声的音乐让我分心了。

meanings.definition: Not believing or not having confidence that someone or something is honest, safe, or reliable.
meanings.example: There was distrust between the two teams because they thought the other might cheat.
meanings.example_cn: 两队之间互不信任，因为他们觉得对方可能会作弊。

meanings.definition: To not trust someone or something.
meanings.example: It’s hard to be friends if you distrust each other.
meanings.example_cn: 如果互相不信任，就很难做朋友。

meanings.definition: To bother or interrupt someone.
meanings.example: Please don’t disturb me while I’m doing my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我做作业的时候请不要打扰我。

meanings.definition: To jump headfirst into water.
meanings.example: At the pool, I love to dive off the board and make a big splash!
meanings.example_cn: 在游泳池里，我喜欢从跳台上跳下去，溅起大水花！

meanings.definition: A jump or leap into water.
meanings.example: That was a great dive off the diving board!
meanings.example_cn: 从跳台上跳下去的那一下真棒！

meanings.definition: To separate into parts.
meanings.example: We can divide the pizza so everyone gets a fair share.
meanings.example_cn: 我们可以分披萨，这样每个人都能公平地分到一份。

meanings.definition: To perform an action or activity.
meanings.example: We do our chores every Saturday morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每个周六早上做家务。

meanings.definition: Used when asking or answering questions (like “Do you want cake?”).
meanings.definition_cn: （用于提问或回答，如“Do you want cake?”）
meanings.example: Do you want to join us for the game?
meanings.example_cn: 你想和我们一起玩游戏吗？

meanings.definition: A person whose job is to help people get better when they are sick or hurt.
meanings.example: The doctor checked my throat and gave me medicine.
meanings.example_cn: 医生检查了我的喉咙，给我开了药。

meanings.definition: A person who has studied a subject for a long time and knows a lot about it.
meanings.example: Dr. Lee is not a medical doctor, but she is called “Doctor” because she earned a doctorate in history from the university.
meanings.example_cn: 李博士不是执业医师，但大家称呼她为 “博士”，因为她在这所大学取得了历史学博士学位。

meanings.definition: To move quickly to avoid something.
meanings.example: You have to dodge the ball if you don’t want to get out in dodgeball.
meanings.example_cn: 在躲避球游戏里，你不想被淘汰就得躲开球。

meanings.definition: A quick move to the side to avoid something.
meanings.example: During dodgeball, Lisa made a quick dodge to avoid getting hit by the ball.
meanings.example_cn: 躲避球比赛中，莉萨快速一闪躲开了球。

meanings.definition: A furry animal that barks and is often kept as a pet.
meanings.example: Our dog loves to chase his tail in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的狗喜欢在后院追自己的尾巴。

meanings.definition: A toy shaped like a person, used for playing.
meanings.example: She brushed her doll’s hair and dressed it in a new dress.
meanings.example_cn: 她给洋娃娃梳了头发，并给它穿上了新衣服。

meanings.definition: A smart sea animal that swims and jumps and often looks like it’s smiling.
meanings.example: The dolphin leaped high above the waves at the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 海豚在水族馆里高高跃出海浪。

meanings.definition: To give something to help others.
meanings.example: We donate our old clothes to help people in need.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把旧衣服捐出去，帮助有需要的人。

meanings.definition: Finished or all completed.
meanings.example: I am done with my homework and ready to play.
meanings.example_cn: 我做完作业了，可以玩了。

meanings.definition: The thing you open and close to go in or out of a room or building.
meanings.example: Please close the door quietly so you don’t wake the baby.
meanings.example_cn: 请轻轻关上门，别吵醒宝宝。

meanings.definition: A small round mark or spot.
meanings.example: She put a red dot on her drawing for the ladybug’s spot.
meanings.example_cn: 她在画上点了一个红点，当作瓢虫的斑点。

meanings.definition: To make small spots or marks.
meanings.example: Lucy likes to dot her drawings with colourful spots to make them look fun.
meanings.example_cn: 露西喜欢在画上点上彩色的点点，让画看起来好玩。

meanings.definition: To not be sure about something.
meanings.example: I doubt it will rain today because the sky is so clear.
meanings.example_cn: 我觉得今天不会下雨，因为天空这么晴朗。

meanings.definition: A feeling when you are not sure about something.
meanings.example: I have a doubt about whether I locked the front door, so I’m going to check.
meanings.example_cn: 我不确定有没有锁前门，所以我要去检查一下。

meanings.definition: Moving to a lower place or position.
meanings.example: The ball rolled down the hill and into the grass.
meanings.example_cn: 球滚下山坡，滚进了草丛里。

meanings.definition: In a lower place or position.
meanings.example: The basement is down the stairs and on the left.
meanings.example_cn: 地下室在楼梯下面，左手边。

meanings.definition: Twelve of something.
meanings.example: Dad brought home a dozen donuts for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸带了一打甜甜圈回家当早餐。

meanings.definition: A story acted out on stage or in a movie.
meanings.example: Our school is putting on a drama about superheroes next week.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学校下周要演一出关于超级英雄的戏剧。

meanings.definition: A situation where there is a lot of excitement, strong feelings, or people arguing.
meanings.example: There was so much drama when the cat knocked over the fishbowl and everyone started yelling.
meanings.example_cn: 猫把鱼缸打翻的时候闹得不可开交，大家都开始大喊。

meanings.definition: To hang something loosely over another thing.
meanings.example: Let’s drape the blanket over the couch to keep it clean.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把毯子搭在沙发上，保持沙发干净。

meanings.definition: To make a picture with a pencil or pen.
meanings.example: I like to draw pictures of animals in my sketchbook after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我喜欢在速写本上画动物。

meanings.definition: A game where both sides have the same score and nobody wins.
meanings.example: The soccer match ended in a draw because both teams scored two goals each.
meanings.example_cn: 足球比赛以平局结束，因为两队都进了两个球。

meanings.definition: To pick or select something at random, especially from a group.
meanings.example: At the party, we will draw names out of a hat to see who gives gifts to whom.
meanings.example_cn: 派对上我们会从帽子里抽签，看谁给谁送礼物。

meanings.definition: A picture made with pencils, pens, or crayons.
meanings.example: His drawing of a robot won first prize in the contest.
meanings.example_cn: 他画的机器人在比赛中获得了一等奖。

meanings.definition: A strong feeling of fear about something.
meanings.example: My biggest dread is forgetting my lines in the school play.
meanings.example_cn: 我最害怕的就是在学校戏剧里忘词。

meanings.definition: To feel very afraid of something that might happen.
meanings.example: Sam dreads going to the dentist because he’s afraid it might hurt.
meanings.example_cn: 萨姆很怕去看牙医，因为他担心会疼。

meanings.definition: Pictures, thoughts, or stories in your mind when you are sleeping.
meanings.example: Last night I had a dream about flying over mountains and rivers.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚我做了一个飞越山川河流的梦。

meanings.definition: To see pictures or stories in your mind while you sleep.
meanings.example: Some people dream of becoming astronauts and exploring space.
meanings.example_cn: 有些人梦想成为宇航员去探索太空。

meanings.definition: A piece of clothing for girls or women that covers the body and hangs down.
meanings.example: She twirled around in her new blue dress at the party.
meanings.example_cn: 她在派对上穿着新蓝裙子转圈。

meanings.definition: To put clothes on yourself or someone else.
meanings.example: Please dress warmly before you go out in the snow.
meanings.example_cn: 出门下雪前请穿暖和些。

meanings.definition: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
meanings.example: Remember to drink plenty of water after running outside.
meanings.example_cn: 在户外跑完后，记得多喝水。

meanings.definition: A liquid that you can drink.
meanings.example: My favourite drink on a hot day is cold lemonade.
meanings.example_cn: 大热天我最喜欢的饮料是冰柠檬水。

meanings.definition: To make a car or vehicle go.
meanings.example: When I grow up, I want to learn how to drive a car.
meanings.example_cn: 我长大了想学开车。

meanings.definition: A ride or trip in a car.
meanings.example: We went for a drive in the countryside to see the autumn leaves.
meanings.example_cn: 我们开车去乡下看秋天的树叶。

meanings.definition: A strong desire or motivation to do something.
meanings.example: She worked hard to finish the project because she had a strong drive to do her best.
meanings.example_cn: 她很努力地完成项目，因为她有一股想做到最好的动力。

meanings.definition: To let something fall, or when something falls by itself.
meanings.example: Don’t drop your ice cream, or it will melt on the ground.
meanings.example_cn: 别让你的冰淇淋掉下来，不然会化在地上。

meanings.definition: A little bit of liquid that looks like a tiny ball, such as a drop of water or a drop of juice.
meanings.example: A drop of rain landed on my nose.
meanings.example_cn: 一滴雨落在了我的鼻子上。

meanings.definition: Medicine.
meanings.example: The doctor gave me a drug to help my cough go away.
meanings.example_cn: 医生给我开了一种药来帮我止咳。

meanings.definition: To give someone medicine or a drug.
meanings.example: The vet had to drug the puppy a little so he wouldn’t feel pain during the checkup.
meanings.example_cn: 兽医不得不给小狗用了点药，这样检查的时候它就不会疼。

meanings.definition: A musical instrument you hit to make sound.
meanings.example: My brother bangs on his drum when he listens to music.
meanings.example_cn: 我哥哥听音乐的时候会敲他的鼓。

meanings.definition: To hit something again and again like playing a drum.
meanings.example: I like to drum my fingers on the table when I’m waiting for my food.
meanings.example_cn: 等饭的时候我喜欢用手指在桌上敲。

meanings.definition: When someone has had too much alcohol and can’t think or walk properly.
meanings.example: The grownups said you should never drive if you are drunk.
meanings.example_cn: 大人说喝醉了绝不应该开车。

meanings.definition: Not wet, so there is no water or moisture.
meanings.example: My shoes are finally dry after getting soaked in the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 被雨淋湿后，我的鞋终于干了。

meanings.definition: To make something lose its wetness.
meanings.example: Hang your towel outside so it can dry in the sun.
meanings.example_cn: 把毛巾挂到外面，让它在太阳下晾干。

meanings.definition: A bird that swims, has a flat bill, and quacks.
meanings.example: The duck waddled across the pond, quacking loudly.
meanings.example_cn: 鸭子嘎嘎地叫着，摇摇摆摆地走过池塘。

meanings.definition: To bend down fast so you don’t get hit or so something doesn’t touch you.
meanings.example: I had to duck when the ball came flying toward me.
meanings.example_cn: 球朝我飞过来的时候，我不得不赶紧低头躲开。

meanings.definition: Not sharp.
meanings.example: My pencil was so dull that I had to sharpen it before writing my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我的铅笔太钝了，写作业前我得先削尖它。

meanings.definition: Not interesting or exciting, boring.
meanings.example: The rainy afternoon felt dull because we couldn't go outside to play.
meanings.example_cn: 那个下雨的下午很乏味，因为我们不能出去玩。

meanings.definition: All the way through a time or event.
meanings.example: Please stay quiet during the movie so everyone can enjoy it.
meanings.example_cn: 看电影时请保持安静，让大家都能享受。

meanings.definition: The time when the sun goes down and it gets dark.
meanings.example: We played outside until dusk, when the fireflies started to come out.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在外面玩到黄昏，萤火虫开始出来了。

meanings.definition: Tiny particles of dirt.
meanings.example: There was a layer of dust on the bookshelf that hadn’t been cleaned in weeks.
meanings.example_cn: 书架上积了一层灰尘，已经好几个星期没打扫了。

meanings.definition: To clean by wiping away dust.
meanings.example: Mom asked me to dust the shelves so they wouldn’t be so dirty.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈让我擦架子上的灰，这样就不会那么脏了。

meanings.definition: Covered with dust.
meanings.example: The old attic was so dusty that we all sneezed when we went inside.
meanings.example_cn: 旧阁楼灰尘太大了，我们一进去就都打喷嚏。

meanings.definition: Something you should do because it’s right.
meanings.example: It’s your duty to feed the dog every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 每天早上喂狗是你的责任。

meanings.definition: Every single one in a group, one by one.
meanings.example: Each student brought a different book to class.
meanings.example_cn: 每个学生都带了一本不同的书来上课。

meanings.definition: A large, strong bird.
meanings.example: An eagle soared high above us at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 在动物园里，一只鹰在我们头顶上高高翱翔。

meanings.definition: The part of your body you use to hear sounds.
meanings.example: I wore a hat that covered my ear on the windy day.
meanings.example_cn: 有风的那天我戴了一顶盖住耳朵的帽子。

meanings.definition: A pain inside your ear.
meanings.example: I had an earache, so Mom took me to the doctor.
meanings.example_cn: 我耳朵疼，所以妈妈带我去了医院。

meanings.definition: Before the usual or expected time.
meanings.example: We woke up early to watch the sunrise at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我们早早起床在海滩上看日出。

meanings.definition: The planet we live on.
meanings.example: The earth looks blue from space.
meanings.example_cn: 从太空看，地球是蓝色的。

meanings.definition: Soil or ground where plants grow.
meanings.example: Dig a hole in the earth to plant the tree.
meanings.example_cn: 在地上挖个洞来种树。

meanings.definition: The direction where the sun rises.
meanings.example: Every morning, I watch the sun rise in the east from my bedroom window.
meanings.example_cn: 每天早上我从卧室窗户看太阳从东方升起。

meanings.definition: Not hard to do.
meanings.example: The puzzle was easy and didn’t take long to finish.
meanings.example_cn: 这个拼图很简单，没花多久就完成了。

meanings.definition: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
meanings.example: I like to eat juicy apples as a snack.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢把多汁的苹果当零食吃。

meanings.definition: To have a meal.
meanings.example: Let's eat dinner together at the big table.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们在大餐桌上一起来吃晚饭。

meanings.definition: The border or side of something.
meanings.example: Be careful near the edge of the pool so you don’t fall in.
meanings.example_cn: 在泳池边要小心，别掉进去了。

meanings.definition: A small advantage that helps you do better than others.
meanings.example: Practising every day gave Mia an edge in the race.
meanings.example_cn: 每天练习让米娅在比赛里占了优势。

meanings.definition: To move slowly or carefully in a particular direction, often little by little.
meanings.example: The cat edged toward the bird, trying not to be seen.
meanings.example_cn: 那只猫慢慢靠近小鸟，尽量不被发现。

meanings.definition: A long, thin fish.
meanings.example: At the aquarium, I saw a slippery eel swimming through the rocks.
meanings.example_cn: 在水族馆里，我看到一条滑溜溜的鳗鱼在岩石间游。

meanings.definition: A round or oval object laid by birds, usually with a shell.
meanings.example: Mom made a scrambled egg for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈早餐做了炒鸡蛋。

meanings.definition: One or the other of two things.
meanings.example: You can have either an apple or an orange for a snack.
meanings.example_cn: 你可以选苹果或橙子当零食。

meanings.definition: The joint in the middle of your arm.
meanings.example: I accidentally bumped my elbow on the table and it felt funny.
meanings.example_cn: 我不小心把胳膊肘撞到桌子上，感觉怪怪的。

meanings.definition: To push someone or something with your elbow.
meanings.example: Sometimes people elbow their way to the front of the line at a concert.
meanings.example_cn: 音乐会的时候有时候人们会用手肘挤到队伍前面去。

meanings.definition: A huge animal with big ears, thick legs, and a long trunk.
meanings.example: The elephant sprayed water with its trunk at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 大象在动物园用鼻子喷水。

meanings.definition: A large deer with wide antlers.
meanings.example: We saw a huge elk with big antlers at the nature park.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在自然公园里看到一只长着大角的大麋鹿。

meanings.definition: Different to what was mentioned.
meanings.example: If you don’t want pizza, what else would you like for dinner?
meanings.example_cn: 如果你不想吃披萨，晚饭你还想吃点什么？

meanings.definition: In addition to what was mentioned.
meanings.example: Would you like to order anything else?
meanings.example_cn: 你还想点别的什么吗？

meanings.definition: A message sent by computer over the internet.
meanings.example: I sent my teacher an email with my homework attached.
meanings.example_cn: 我给老师发了一封邮件，附件是我的作业。

meanings.definition: To send a message to someone using a computer or phone.
meanings.example: I will email my homework to my teacher tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 今晚我会把作业用邮件发给老师。

meanings.definition: A strong feeling, like happiness, sadness, or anger.
meanings.example: Happiness is my favourite emotion because it makes me smile.
meanings.example_cn: 快乐是我最喜欢的情绪，因为它让我微笑。

meanings.definition: Having nothing inside.
meanings.example: My glass was empty so I filled it with water.
meanings.example_cn: 我的杯子空了，所以我装满了水。

meanings.definition: To remove all the contents from something
meanings.example: Please empty your backpack before you leave the classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 离开教室前，请把你的背包腾空。

meanings.definition: To give support or confidence.
meanings.example: My coach likes to encourage us by cheering from the sidelines.
meanings.example_cn: 我的教练喜欢在场边为我们加油打气。

meanings.definition: The last part of something.
meanings.example: At the end of the movie, everyone cheered.
meanings.example_cn: 电影结束时，大家都欢呼起来。

meanings.definition: To finish or bring something to a stop.
meanings.example: Let’s end the game when the timer rings.
meanings.example_cn: 计时器响时，让我们结束游戏。

meanings.definition: Someone who wants to hurt or fight you.
meanings.example: In the video game, you have to defeat the enemy to win the level.
meanings.example_cn: 在电子游戏里，你得打败敌人才能过关。

meanings.definition: To get pleasure from something.
meanings.example: I really enjoy reading comics before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我很喜欢睡前看漫画。

meanings.definition: Having as much or as many as you need.
meanings.example: Do you have enough glue for your craft?
meanings.example_cn: 你的手工有足够的胶水吗？

meanings.definition: Having as much as is needed, sufficiently.
meanings.example: She practiced enough to perform the song perfectly.
meanings.example_cn: 她练习得足够多，能完美地唱出这首歌。

meanings.definition: To make people have fun.
meanings.example: My little sister likes to entertain us by putting on a puppet show.
meanings.example_cn: 我妹妹喜欢演木偶戏来逗大家开心。

meanings.definition: The same in amount or value.
meanings.example: We made sure everyone got an equal slice of cake.
meanings.example_cn: 我们确保每个人都分到一样大的一块蛋糕。

meanings.definition: A mistake.
meanings.example: I made an error on my math test, but the teacher helped me fix it.
meanings.example_cn: 我数学考试出错了，但老师帮我改过来了。

meanings.definition: To get away from a place.
meanings.example: The puppy tried to escape from his bath by jumping out of the tub!
meanings.example_cn: 小狗想跳出浴缸，洗完澡就逃跑！

meanings.definition: Getting away from a place where you do not want to be.
meanings.example: The mouse made a quick escape from the cat by running under the couch.
meanings.example_cn: 老鼠从猫那儿快速逃走，钻到了沙发底下。

meanings.definition: To change from liquid to gas, like water turning into steam.
meanings.example: After it rained, the puddles started to evaporate in the sunshine.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨过后，水坑在阳光下开始蒸发。

meanings.definition: Used to show something is surprising or more than expected.
meanings.example: Even my little brother can tie his shoes now!
meanings.example_cn: 连我弟弟现在都会系鞋带了！

meanings.definition: Being equal or level with something else.
meanings.example: The two teams had an even score at halftime.
meanings.example_cn: 中场休息时两队比分持平。

meanings.definition: Something that happens, especially something important.
meanings.example: The school talent show is the big event of the week.
meanings.example_cn: 学校的才艺表演是这周的大事。

meanings.definition: At any time.
meanings.example: Have you ever seen a rainbow at night?
meanings.example_cn: 你在晚上见过彩虹吗？

meanings.definition: All the people or things in a group.
meanings.example: Every morning, we feed our pet fish together.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每天早上一起喂宠物鱼。

meanings.definition: All the people or everyone.
meanings.example: Everybody cheered when the team scored a goal.
meanings.example_cn: 队伍进球时大家都欢呼起来。

meanings.definition: Every person.
meanings.example: Everyone brought a different book for reading day.
meanings.example_cn: 读书日每个人都带了一本不同的书。

meanings.definition: All the things or the whole group.
meanings.example: Everything in the store is on sale today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天店里所有东西都在打折。

meanings.definition: In all places.
meanings.example: We looked everywhere for my missing shoe.
meanings.example_cn: 我们到处找我丢失的那只鞋。

meanings.definition: A test to see how much you know.
meanings.example: I studied hard so I could do well on my maths exam.
meanings.example_cn: 我努力学习，好在数学考试中取得好成绩。

meanings.definition: Something that shows what a rule is like.
meanings.example: The teacher gave an example to show us how to solve the problem.
meanings.example_cn: 老师举了个例子来教我们怎么解题。

meanings.definition: Something that shows what others can do or copy.
meanings.example: His older brother sets a positive example by always helping others.
meanings.example_cn: 他的哥哥总是乐于助人，树立了好榜样。

meanings.definition: A way out.
meanings.example: The exit sign shows you where to leave the building.
meanings.example_cn: 出口标志告诉你从哪里离开大楼。

meanings.definition: To leave or go out of a place.
meanings.example: Please exit the classroom quietly when the bell rings.
meanings.example_cn: 铃响后请安静地走出教室。

meanings.definition: Something that happens to you.
meanings.example: It was an amazing experience to ride a horse for the first time.
meanings.example_cn: 第一次骑马是一次很棒的经历。

meanings.definition: To live through something.
meanings.example: During the thunderstorm, we experienced a power outage and had to use flashlights until the lights came back on.
meanings.example_cn: 雷暴期间我们遇到了停电，不得不用手电筒，直到电恢复。

meanings.definition: Knowledge or skill you get from doing things.
meanings.example: Her experience in baking helped her make the perfect cake for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 她有烘焙的经验，帮她做出了适合派对的完美蛋糕。

meanings.definition: A test done to learn or discover something.
meanings.example: We did a science experiment to see which seeds grow the fastest.
meanings.example_cn: 我们做了一个科学实验，看看哪些种子长得最快。

meanings.definition: To try something new to see what will happen.
meanings.example: Let's experiment with different colours to make a new kind of painting.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们用不同的颜色做实验，创造出一种新的画。

meanings.definition: To make something clear.
meanings.example: Can you explain how this game works so I can play too?
meanings.example_cn: 你能给我讲讲这个游戏怎么玩吗，这样我也能一起玩？

meanings.definition: To travel and learn about a place.
meanings.example: Let’s explore the woods behind our house and look for cool bugs.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去房子后面的树林里探险，找找酷虫子吧。

meanings.definition: More than what is usual.
meanings.example: I brought an extra snack in case anyone gets hungry later.
meanings.example_cn: 我多带了一份零食，以防有人待会儿饿了。

meanings.definition: The part of your body you see with.
meanings.example: I got a little soap in my eye during my bath.
meanings.example_cn: 洗澡时一点肥皂弄进了我的眼睛。

meanings.definition: To look at someone or something with interest or curiosity.
meanings.example: The puppy eyed the treat on the table, hoping to get a bite.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗盯着桌上的零食，盼着能咬上一口。

meanings.definition: To look at someone or something carefully.
meanings.example: The cat likes to eye the fish swimming in the tank.
meanings.example_cn: 猫喜欢盯着鱼缸里游来游去的鱼。

meanings.definition: The front part of your head that has your eyes, nose, and mouth.
meanings.example: He had a big smile on his face after winning the game.
meanings.example_cn: 赢得比赛后，他脸上露出灿烂的笑容。

meanings.definition: To look towards something or someone directly.
meanings.example: Please face the board while I explain the lesson.
meanings.example_cn: 我讲解功课时，请面向黑板。

meanings.definition: To deal with a problem or a difficult situation bravely.
meanings.example: She had to face her fear of heights on the climbing wall.
meanings.example_cn: 在攀岩墙上，她不得不直面自己的恐高心理。

meanings.definition: Something that is true and can be proven.
meanings.example: It’s a fact that the sun rises in the east.
meanings.example_cn: 太阳从东方升起，这是一个事实。

meanings.definition: To not succeed.
meanings.example: It’s okay to fail sometimes because that’s how we learn.
meanings.example_cn: 有时候失败没关系，因为我们就是这样学习的。

meanings.definition: A result that means you did not succeed or did not pass.
meanings.example: I studied hard because I didn’t want another fail on my spelling test.
meanings.example_cn: 我努力学习，因为我不想拼写考试再不及格了。

meanings.definition: Treating everyone the same way.
meanings.example: The teacher made sure everyone got a fair turn during the game.
meanings.example_cn: 老师确保大家在游戏里都能轮到机会，人人公平。

meanings.definition: A big event with games, rides, or things to buy and see.
meanings.example: We went to the fair and rode the Ferris wheel and ate cotton candy.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去了游园会，坐了摩天轮，吃了棉花糖。

meanings.definition: A tiny magical being in stories.
meanings.example: In the story, a tiny fairy sprinkled magic dust and made the flowers bloom.
meanings.example_cn: 故事里，一个小仙女撒了魔法粉末，让花儿都开了。

meanings.definition: Complete trust or belief in someone or something.
meanings.example: I have faith that you’ll do well on your test.
meanings.example_cn: 我相信你考试一定会考好的。

meanings.definition: Always loyal and true to someone or something.
meanings.example: My dog is a faithful friend who always waits for me.
meanings.example_cn: 我的狗是忠诚的朋友，总是等我。

meanings.definition: Made to appear real but actually not genuine.
meanings.example: The toy snake looked real, but it was actually fake and made of rubber.
meanings.example_cn: 那条玩具蛇看起来像真的，其实是假的，是用橡胶做的。

meanings.definition: To move down from a higher place.
meanings.example: Watch your step so you don’t fall off the swing.
meanings.example_cn: 小心脚下，别从秋千上摔下来。

meanings.definition: The season that comes after summer when leaves change colour.
meanings.example: In the fall, we jump into big piles of crunchy leaves.
meanings.example_cn: 秋天的时候，我们会跳进一大堆脆脆的落叶里。

meanings.definition: The state of being known by many people.
meanings.example: The singer’s fame makes her face appear on lots of posters.
meanings.example_cn: 这位歌手名气很大，她的脸出现在好多海报上。

meanings.definition: Parents and children who live together or are related.
meanings.example: My family loves to play board games on weekends.
meanings.example_cn: 我的家人喜欢在周末玩桌游。

meanings.definition: A group of related things or people, like animals in the same group.
meanings.example: A lion is part of the cat family of animals.
meanings.example_cn: 狮子属于猫科动物。

meanings.definition: Someone who really likes and follows a sport, team, or celebrity.
meanings.example: I’m a huge fan of the soccer team and watch every game.
meanings.example_cn: 我是这支足球队的超级粉丝，每场比赛都看。

meanings.definition: To move air and make someone or something cooler by waving something.
meanings.example: Dad used a piece of cardboard to fan the smoke away from the barbecue.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸用一块硬纸板把烧烤架的烟扇走。

meanings.definition: A tool or machine that moves air to make you feel cool.
meanings.example: We turned on the fan to cool down the room on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 天气热的时候，我们打开风扇让房间凉快下来。

meanings.definition: Not plain, so it has decorations or looks special.
meanings.example: She wore a fancy dress with sparkles for the school party.
meanings.example_cn: 她穿着带亮片的花哨裙子参加学校派对。

meanings.definition: To like or want something.
meanings.example: I fancy having a big slice of chocolate cake for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 我想吃一大块巧克力蛋糕当甜点。

meanings.definition: A long, sharp tooth.
meanings.example: The snake showed its sharp fang when it opened its mouth.
meanings.example_cn: 蛇张开嘴时露出了尖尖的毒牙。

meanings.definition: A long way from where you are.
meanings.example: My grandparents live far from our city.
meanings.example_cn: 我的祖父母住得离我们的城市很远。

meanings.definition: A large amount or to a great degree.
meanings.example: He is far better at maths since he started practicing every day.
meanings.example_cn: 自从他每天开始练习后，数学进步了很多。

meanings.definition: The money you pay to travel somewhere.
meanings.example: We paid the bus fare before sitting down for the ride to school.
meanings.example_cn: 我们付了公交车费，然后坐下坐车去学校。

meanings.definition: A place where people grow crops or keep animals.
meanings.example: We visited a farm and fed the baby goats.
meanings.example_cn: 我们参观了一个农场，喂了刚出生的小山羊。

meanings.definition: To work on land by planting vegetables or taking care of animals so people can have food.
meanings.example: Every day, Mr. Green farms by planting seeds and feeding his cows.
meanings.example_cn: 格林先生每天务农，播种并喂养他的奶牛。

meanings.definition: A person whose job is to work on a farm and take care of crops or animals.
meanings.example: The farmer grows fresh vegetables on his big farm.
meanings.example_cn: 农民在他的大农场里种新鲜的蔬菜。

meanings.definition: The popular style of clothes.
meanings.example: Polka dot dresses are really in fashion this year.
meanings.example_cn: 波点连衣裙今年特别流行。

meanings.definition: A popular way of doing things.
meanings.example: It’s the fashion at our school to decorate your locker with colourful stickers.
meanings.example_cn: 在我们学校，大家喜欢用彩色贴纸装饰自己的储物柜。

meanings.definition: Moving quickly or happening in a short time.
meanings.example: That cheetah can run very fast across the plain.
meanings.example_cn: 那只猎豹能飞快地跑过平原。

meanings.definition: To eat no food for a period of time
meanings.example: Some people fast during the day for special reasons.
meanings.example_cn: 有些人会因为特殊原因在白天禁食。

meanings.definition: To close or attach something so it stays shut or together.
meanings.example: Please fasten your seatbelt before the car starts moving.
meanings.example_cn: 汽车开动前，请系好安全带。

meanings.definition: A natural oily part of the body.
meanings.example: The chef trimmed the fat off the meat before cooking it.
meanings.example_cn: 厨师烹饪前把肉上多余的肥肉切掉。

meanings.definition: Having excessive flesh on the body and not thin.
meanings.example: The cat is so fat that it can’t fit through the small door.
meanings.example_cn: 这只猫太胖了，连小门都钻不过去。

meanings.definition: A male parent, or your dad.
meanings.example: My father helps me fix my broken toys.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸帮我修坏了的玩具。

meanings.definition: When someone makes a mistake or does something wrong.
meanings.example: I made a fault on my math test by adding the numbers wrong.
meanings.example_cn: 我数学考试算错数字，出了一处差错。

meanings.definition: Being the one to blame for something bad that happened.
meanings.example: The teacher said it wasn’t anyone’s fault that the project didn’t work out.
meanings.example_cn: 老师说这个项目没能成功，不是任何人的错。

meanings.definition: The feeling of being afraid.
meanings.example: My biggest fear is speaking in front of a big crowd.
meanings.example_cn: 我最怕在一大群人面前讲话。

meanings.definition: To feel scared or worried about something.
meanings.example: Some kids fear the dark, but I just turn on my night light.
meanings.example_cn: 有些孩子怕黑，但我只要打开小夜灯就好了。

meanings.definition: A very big meal.
meanings.example: We had a feast with turkey and pie on Thanksgiving.
meanings.example_cn: 感恩节那天，我们吃了有火鸡和馅饼的大餐。

meanings.definition: To eat a lot of food, usually for a special event.
meanings.example: We feasted on pizza and cake at my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我的生日聚会上，我们大吃了披萨和蛋糕。

meanings.definition: The second month of the year.
meanings.example: February is the shortest month of the year.
meanings.example_cn: 二月是一年中最短的月份。

meanings.definition: To give food to someone or something.
meanings.example: Every morning, I help my mom feed the cat her breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 每天早上，我帮妈妈喂猫吃早餐。

meanings.definition: To sense something by touching or experiencing an emotion.
meanings.example: Feel the soft fur of this kitten—it's like a little cloud!
meanings.example_cn: 摸摸这只小猫柔软的毛——它就像一朵小云！

meanings.definition: A feeling or emotion you have inside.
meanings.example: I have a happy feel when I'm playing with my friends.
meanings.example_cn: 和朋友一起玩时，我心里很愉快。

meanings.definition: A barrier made of wood or wire.
meanings.example: Our dog can’t run away because there’s a fence around the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的狗跑不掉，因为院子四周有围栏。

meanings.definition: To put up a fence around a place.
meanings.example: We fenced the backyard so the puppy couldn’t run away.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在后院围上栅栏，这样小狗就跑不掉了。

meanings.definition: A boat that carries people or things across water.
meanings.example: We took a ferry across the river to visit the island.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐渡轮过河去参观那座小岛。

meanings.definition: To carry people or things across water in a boat.
meanings.example: The boat will ferry us across the river to the other side.
meanings.example_cn: 这艘船会载我们过河到对岸去。

meanings.definition: To go and get something and bring it back.
meanings.example: The dog loves to fetch the ball and bring it back.
meanings.example_cn: 狗喜欢去捡球，然后把球带回来。

meanings.definition: A  game you play with a dog, where you throw something, and the dog runs to get it and brings it back to you.
meanings.example: The puppy loves playing fetch in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 这只小狗喜欢在后院玩捡东西的游戏。

meanings.definition: When your body temperature is higher than normal because you are sick.
meanings.example: Mom took my temperature to check if I have a fever.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈量了我的体温，看看我是否发烧。

meanings.definition: When people have “fever” for something, it means everyone is very excited or interested in it.
meanings.example: There was football fever at school when the big game was coming up.
meanings.example_cn: 大赛即将来临，校园里掀起了足球热潮。

meanings.definition: A small number, but more than one.
meanings.example: Few cookies were left on the plate after the party.
meanings.example_cn: 派对结束后，盘子里剩下的饼干寥寥无几。

meanings.definition: A thin thread or strand.
meanings.example: A spider’s web is made from a strong, thin fibre.
meanings.example_cn: 蜘蛛网是由又细又结实的丝做成的。

meanings.definition: Stories that are made up and not real.
meanings.example: I love reading fiction books about dragons and adventures.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢读关于龙和冒险的虚构故事书。
