meanings.definition: An open area of land, often used for growing plants or playing sports.
meanings.example: We played soccer in the big green field after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我们在大片绿茵场上踢足球。

meanings.definition: A particular area of study, work, or interest.
meanings.example: My aunt works in the field of medicine as a nurse.
meanings.example_cn: 我的姑姑从事医学领域的工作，她是一名护士。

meanings.definition: To use force to try to win against someone.
meanings.example: The two superheroes had to fight the villain to save the city.
meanings.example_cn: 两位超级英雄必须和坏蛋战斗，才能拯救城市。

meanings.definition: A situation where people or groups try to win against each other.
meanings.example: The soccer match turned into a tough fight as both teams tried hard to win.
meanings.example_cn: 两支球队都拼命想赢，这场足球赛变成了一场激烈的争夺。

meanings.definition: An argument or conflict between people or groups.
meanings.example: My brother and I had a silly fight about who got the last cookie.
meanings.example_cn: 我和弟弟为了谁吃最后一块饼干吵了一架，真无聊。

meanings.definition: A number.
meanings.example: The number “7” is my favourite figure because it’s lucky.
meanings.example_cn: 数字“7”是我最喜欢的数字，因为它代表幸运。

meanings.definition: To think about something and find an answer or understand it.
meanings.example: I couldn’t figure out the puzzle, so I asked for help.
meanings.example_cn: 我想不出这个谜题怎么解，就去求助了。

meanings.definition: The shape of a person’s body.
meanings.example: The dancer’s figure moved gracefully across the stage.
meanings.example_cn: 舞者的身影在舞台上优雅地移动。

meanings.definition: A folder or box for keeping papers in order.
meanings.example: Please put your finished drawings in the file on the teacher’s desk.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你画好的画放进老师桌上的文件夹里。

meanings.definition: To organise and put documents or papers into folders or drawers so they are easy to find later.
meanings.example: After finishing her homework, Anna filed her papers neatly in her school folder.
meanings.example_cn: 安娜做完作业后，把文件整齐地放进了她的书包里。

meanings.definition: A movie.
meanings.example: We watched a funny film at the movie theatre.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在电影院看了一部搞笑的电影。

meanings.definition: To record a video or make a movie.
meanings.example: We want to film our science experiment and share the video with the class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们想把科学实验拍下来，把视频分享给全班同学。

meanings.definition: The last part of something.
meanings.example: The final chapter of the book was the most exciting part.
meanings.example_cn: 这本书的最后一章是最精彩的部分。

meanings.definition: The last game in a contest or tournament.
meanings.example: Our team won the final and took home the trophy.
meanings.example_cn: 我们队赢了决赛，捧回了奖杯。

meanings.definition: To get back something that was lost or hidden.
meanings.example: I can't wait to find hidden eggs during the hunt.
meanings.example_cn: 我迫不及待想在寻宝中找出隐藏的蛋。

meanings.definition: To discover something that was not known before.
meanings.example: In science class, we find out how plants grow by doing experiments.
meanings.example_cn: 在科学课上，我们通过做实验来了解植物如何生长。

meanings.definition: To think or feel a certain way about something.
meanings.example: I find this book really interesting.
meanings.example_cn: 我觉得这本书非常有趣。

meanings.definition: Very good quality.
meanings.example: The weather was fine for flying kites in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 天气很好，适合在公园里放风筝。

meanings.definition: Money you must pay as a punishment when you break a rule or law.
meanings.example: I got a library fine because I returned my book late.
meanings.example_cn: 我因为还书晚了，被图书馆罚了款。

meanings.definition: One of the five long parts on each of your hands.
meanings.example: I wore a colourful ring on my finger today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天我手指上戴了一枚彩色的戒指。

meanings.definition: To complete something.
meanings.example: I want to finish my book before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我想在睡觉前把这本书看完。

meanings.definition: The time or place when something ends.
meanings.example: Everyone cheered as I crossed the finish of the race.
meanings.example_cn: 我冲过比赛终点线时，大家都欢呼起来。

meanings.definition: The hot, bright flames that give heat and can burn things.
meanings.example: The campers sat around the fire, roasting marshmallows and telling stories.
meanings.example_cn: 露营者围坐在篝火旁，烤棉花糖、讲故事。

meanings.definition: To set something on fire or make it burn.
meanings.example: Never try to fire dry leaves in the backyard without an adult.
meanings.example_cn: 永远不要在没有大人的情况下在后院点燃干树叶。

meanings.definition: A small insect that can make its body glow in the dark.
meanings.example: I caught a firefly and watched it glow in the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 我捉到一只萤火虫，看着它在黑暗中发光。

meanings.definition: Hard and solid, not soft.
meanings.example: This chair is firm, so it's easy to sit up straight.
meanings.example_cn: 这把椅子很结实，坐直很容易。

meanings.definition: A company or business.
meanings.example: My aunt works at a firm that designs tall buildings.
meanings.example_cn: 我姑姑在一家设计高楼的公司工作。

meanings.definition: Coming before all others in time or order.
meanings.example: I was the first to finish the race at school.
meanings.example_cn: 我是学校里第一个跑完比赛的。

meanings.definition: At the beginning of something or before others.
meanings.example: First, we wash our hands, then we eat dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 首先我们洗手，然后吃晚饭。

meanings.definition: An animal that lives in water and breathes with gills.
meanings.example: We saw a rainbow fish swimming in the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在水族馆看到一条彩色鱼在游。

meanings.definition: To catch or try to catch fish
meanings.example: We like to fish at the lake on weekends.
meanings.example_cn: 我们周末喜欢去湖边钓鱼。

meanings.definition: A hand with the fingers curled in tightly.
meanings.example: He made a fist to knock on the door loudly.
meanings.example_cn: 他攥紧拳头，用力敲门。

meanings.definition: To repair something.
meanings.example: Dad will fix my broken bike this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸这个周末会把我坏掉的自行车修好。

meanings.definition: A quick way to repair or solve a problem.
meanings.example: Dad had a quick fix for my broken toy.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸有个快速修好我坏掉玩具的办法。

meanings.definition: A piece of coloured cloth used as a symbol.
meanings.example: We raised the flag before singing the national anthem at school.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在学校唱国歌之前先升了旗。

meanings.definition: To signal someone to stop, usually by waving.
meanings.example: The crossing guard will flag the cars to stop so we can cross the street safely.
meanings.example_cn: 交通协管员会示意车辆停下，好让我们安全过马路。

meanings.definition: To point out or warn people about something that could be bad or unsafe.
meanings.example: The lifeguard flagged a threat in the water by raising a red flag to warn everyone to stay out.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员发现水里有危险，举起红旗警示所有人不要下水。

meanings.definition: The bright, hot part of a fire.
meanings.example: The candle’s flame flickered when we sang happy birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我们唱生日歌时，蜡烛的火苗在轻轻跳动。

meanings.definition: A quick, bright light.
meanings.example: There was a bright flash of lightning during the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨中闪过一道明亮的闪电。

meanings.definition: To shine brightly for a very short time.
meanings.example: Lightning can flash across the sky during a storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨时，闪电会划过天空。

meanings.definition: A tiny jumping insect that bites.
meanings.example: My dog scratched a lot because he had a flea on his back.
meanings.example_cn: 我的狗背上有只跳蚤，所以它一直抓个不停。

meanings.definition: Able to bend easily without breaking.
meanings.example: Gymnasts are flexible and can do amazing splits.
meanings.example_cn: 体操运动员身体柔韧，能做惊人的劈叉。

meanings.definition: To stay on top of water or in the air.
meanings.example: The rubber duck can float on top of the water in the bathtub.
meanings.example_cn: 橡皮鸭能浮在浴缸的水面上。

meanings.definition: Something that stays on top of water.
meanings.example: My rubber duck is my favourite float in the bathtub.
meanings.example_cn: 我的橡皮鸭是浴缸里我最喜欢的漂浮玩具。

meanings.definition: A group of birds or sheep.
meanings.example: A flock of birds flew across the sky in a graceful V-shape.
meanings.example_cn: 一群鸟儿排成优美的 V 字形飞过天空。

meanings.definition: To come together in a group.
meanings.example: Fans flock to the stadium to watch their favourite team play.
meanings.example_cn: 粉丝们成群结队地涌向体育场，去看他们最喜欢的球队比赛。

meanings.definition: Too much water covering land.
meanings.example: After the heavy rain, there was a flood in the basement.
meanings.example_cn: 大雨过后，地下室被水淹了。

meanings.definition: To fill or cover an area with water.
meanings.example: Heavy rain can flood the playground and make big puddles everywhere.
meanings.example_cn: 大雨会淹没操场，到处都是大水坑。

meanings.definition: The flat part of a room that you walk on.
meanings.example: There are building blocks scattered all over the floor.
meanings.example_cn: 地板上散落着许多积木。

meanings.definition: Powder made from grain for baking.
meanings.example: We need flour to bake cookies for the class party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们需要面粉来烤班级派对吃的饼干。

meanings.definition: The colourful part of a plant that makes seeds or fruit.
meanings.example: We picked a bright yellow flower from the garden for the vase.
meanings.example_cn: 我们为花瓶从花园里摘了一朵明亮的黄花儿。

meanings.definition: To start producing flowers.
meanings.example: The cherry trees will flower in spring and look beautiful.
meanings.example_cn: 樱花树会在春天开花，看起来很漂亮。

meanings.definition: An illness like a cold, with fever, aches, and cough.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school when I had the flu.
meanings.example_cn: 我得了流感，就没去上学。

meanings.definition: To clean something by running water over it.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to flush the toilet after you use it.
meanings.example_cn: 用完马桶后，别忘了冲水。

meanings.definition: The rush of water that happens when you flush a toilet or pour water quickly.
meanings.example: The flush from the toilet was loud enough to hear from the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 马桶冲水的声音很大，在走廊都能听见。

meanings.definition: A musical instrument you blow into.
meanings.example: She played a pretty song on her flute during the concert.
meanings.example_cn: 音乐会上，她用长笛吹了一首好听的曲子。

meanings.definition: To move through the air, like a bird or an aeroplane.
meanings.example: The colourful kite can fly high in the sky.
meanings.example_cn: 那只彩色风筝能在天空中飞得很高。

meanings.definition: A small insect with wings that can buzz around and often lands on food or people.
meanings.example: A fly buzzed around the kitchen looking for crumbs.

meanings.definition: To pay close attention.
meanings.example: I need to focus on my homework so I can finish it quickly.
meanings.example_cn: 我需要专心做作业，这样才能快点做完。

meanings.definition: The main thing people are paying attention to.
meanings.example: The focus of today’s lesson is how plants grow.
meanings.example_cn: 今天这节课的重点是植物是怎么生长的。

meanings.definition: A thick, low cloud near the ground.
meanings.example: The morning fog made it hard to see the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 早晨的雾让人看不清操场。

meanings.definition: To cover something so it is hard to see, like with mist.
meanings.example: The cold air made my glasses fog up when I walked outside.
meanings.example_cn: 我走到外面时，冷空气让我的眼镜蒙上了一层雾。

meanings.definition: To bend something so one part covers another.
meanings.example: Please fold your clothes before putting them away.
meanings.example_cn: 收衣服前，请先把衣服叠好。

meanings.definition: A line or bend made when you double paper or cloth.
meanings.example: I made a neat fold in my paper to start an origami crane.
meanings.example_cn: 我在纸上折了一道整齐的折痕，开始折千纸鹤。

meanings.definition: To go behind someone.
meanings.example: The puppy will follow you wherever you go.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗会跟着你走到任何地方。

meanings.definition: To understand what someone is saying or doing.
meanings.example: I can follow the instructions if you read them slowly.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你慢慢读，我能听懂这些说明。

meanings.definition: To do what someone tells you or copy their actions.
meanings.example: Please follow the teacher’s instructions.
meanings.example_cn: 请听从老师的指示。

meanings.definition: Something people or animals eat.
meanings.example: Pizza is my favourite food for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 披萨是我晚餐最喜欢吃的食物。

meanings.definition: A silly or foolish person.
meanings.example: He acted like a fool by putting the bucket on his head and making us laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 他把水桶扣在头上逗我们笑，表现得像个傻瓜。

meanings.definition: To trick someone or make them believe something that is not true.
meanings.example: April Fool’s Day is a time when people try to fool their friends with silly tricks.
meanings.example_cn: 愚人节这天，大家会用小把戏捉弄自己的朋友。

meanings.definition: The part at the end of your leg that you stand or walk on.
meanings.example: I hurt my foot while running, but it’s better now.
meanings.example_cn: 我跑步时伤了脚，但现在好多了。

meanings.definition: Shows why or for what reason something is done.
meanings.example: I made a card for my friend's birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我为朋友的生日做了一张卡片。

meanings.definition: During a certain length of time.
meanings.example: We waited for two hours to see the parade.
meanings.example_cn: 我们等了两个小时看游行。

meanings.definition: Power or strength used to move or change something.
meanings.example: The force of the wind knocked over the garden fence.
meanings.example_cn: 风力把花园的栅栏吹倒了。

meanings.definition: To make someone do something even if they don’t want to.
meanings.example: Sometimes I have to force myself to finish my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 有时我得强迫自己完成作业。

meanings.definition: A large area filled with many trees and plants.
meanings.example: We spotted a deer in the quiet forest.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在安静的森林里看到了一头鹿。

meanings.definition: To not remember.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to bring your lunch to school!
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了带午饭去学校！

meanings.definition: To stop being angry with someone who has done something wrong.
meanings.example: It’s important to forgive your friends when they say sorry.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友道歉时原谅他们很重要。

meanings.definition: A tool with points, used for eating food.
meanings.example: I used a fork to eat my salad at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭时我用叉子吃沙拉。

meanings.definition: A shape or type of something.
meanings.example: Clouds can take the form of animals if you use your imagination.
meanings.example_cn: 发挥想象力的话，云可以变成各种动物的形状。

meanings.definition: To make or shape something.
meanings.example: Let’s form a circle and play a game together.
meanings.example_cn: 我们围成一圈，一起做游戏吧。

meanings.definition: Toward the front.
meanings.example: Please step forward when your name is called.
meanings.example_cn: 叫到你名字的时候，请往前走一步。

meanings.definition: At or toward the front.
meanings.example: Please move to the forward seats on the bus so everyone can get on.
meanings.example_cn: 请坐到公交车靠前的座位上，好让大家都能上车。

meanings.definition: To start or set up something, like a business or a city.
meanings.example: In 1919, people worked together to found the school where we study today.
meanings.example_cn: 1919 年，人们齐心协力创办了我们如今就读的这所学校。

meanings.definition: Not held, controlled, or stopped by anyone.
meanings.example: The puppy broke free from his leash and ran around the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗挣脱了牵引绳，在院子里跑来跑去。

meanings.definition: Not costing money.
meanings.example: The lemonade at the fair is free for everyone!
meanings.example_cn: 集市上的柠檬水对所有人免费！

meanings.definition: To let someone or something go.
meanings.example: The zookeeper will free the injured bird back into the wild.
meanings.example_cn: 动物园管理员会把这只受伤的鸟放归大自然。

meanings.definition: To turn into ice.
meanings.example: If you leave water outside in the winter, it will freeze into ice.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天把水放在外面，它会冻成冰。

meanings.definition: A time when the weather is very cold and things get icy.
meanings.example: After the freeze last night, the grass was covered in frost.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚冻过之后，草地上都结了霜。

meanings.definition: New, not old or stale.
meanings.example: We picked fresh strawberries from the garden this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 今天早上我们从花园里摘了新鲜的草莓。

meanings.definition: The sixth day of the week.
meanings.example: Friday is my favourite day because it’s the start of the weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 星期五是我最喜欢的一天，因为它是周末的开始。

meanings.definition: Someone you like and spend time with.
meanings.example: My best friend and I built a giant sandcastle together.
meanings.example_cn: 我最好的朋友和我一起堆了一座巨大的沙堡。

meanings.definition: Kind and easy to get along with.
meanings.example: The friendly cat rubbed against my legs and purred.
meanings.example_cn: 那只友好的猫蹭着我的腿，发出咕噜声。

meanings.definition: A sudden fear.
meanings.example: The loud thunder gave me a fright in the middle of the night.
meanings.example_cn: 半夜里响亮的雷声吓了我一跳。

meanings.definition: A small, green animal that jumps and lives near water.
meanings.example: A green frog jumped off the lily pad into the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 一只绿青蛙从睡莲叶上跳进了池塘。

meanings.definition: Shows where someone or something started or came from.
meanings.example: We walked from our house to the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我们从家走到操场。

meanings.definition: When you use “from” with time, it tells you when something begins.
meanings.example: The school play will run from 6 o’clock to 8 o’clock.
meanings.example_cn: 这场校园戏剧的演出时间为六点到八点。

meanings.definition: The part that faces forward.
meanings.example: The front of our house has a bright red door.
meanings.example_cn: 我们房子的正面有一扇鲜红的门。

meanings.definition: White ice crystals that form when it is very cold.
meanings.example: There was frost on the grass when I woke up today.
meanings.example_cn: 我今天早上醒来时，草地上有霜。

meanings.definition: To cover something with a thin layer of ice or sweet icing.
meanings.example: I love to frost cupcakes with chocolate icing.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢给小蛋糕抹上巧克力糖霜。

meanings.definition: To make your face look unhappy or angry by bringing your eyebrows together.
meanings.example: Anna began to frown when she saw her broken toy.
meanings.example_cn: 安娜看到她坏掉的玩具时，开始皱起眉头。

meanings.definition: The look on your face when you’re upset, confused, or not happy, and your mouth turns down and your eyebrows get close together.
meanings.example: A big frown appeared on Ben’s face when he lost his favourite pencil.
meanings.example_cn: 本弄丢了他最心爱的铅笔，脸上露出浓浓的愁容。

meanings.definition: The sweet part of a plant that you can eat, like an apple or banana.
meanings.example: Fruit salad is a sweet and healthy snack.
meanings.example_cn: 水果沙拉是香甜健康的零食。

meanings.definition: To cook in hot oil.
meanings.example: Let’s fry some eggs for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我们早餐煎几个鸡蛋吧。

meanings.definition: Material burned to make heat or energy.
meanings.example: Cars need fuel like gas to make them go.
meanings.example_cn: 汽车需要汽油这样的燃料才能跑起来。

meanings.definition: To give power or energy to something, like a car or a fire.
meanings.example: We need to fuel the car before our road trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我们公路旅行前需要给车加油。

meanings.definition: Holding as much as possible, so nothing more can fit.
meanings.example: The basket was full of shiny apples from the orchard.
meanings.example_cn: 篮子里装满了果园里闪亮的苹果。

meanings.definition: You have eaten enough and can’t eat any more food.
meanings.example: After eating a big lunch, I was so full I couldn’t eat dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 吃完丰盛的午饭后，我太饱了，吃不下甜点。

meanings.definition: Something that is enjoyable or playful.
meanings.example: We had so much fun playing tag at recess.
meanings.example_cn: 课间玩抓人游戏，我们玩得特别开心。

meanings.definition: Enjoyable and making you happy.
meanings.example: The water park is so fun that I never want to leave.
meanings.example_cn: 水上乐园太好玩了，我都不想走了。

meanings.definition: Makes you laugh.
meanings.example: That joke was so funny, I couldn’t stop giggling!
meanings.example_cn: 那个笑话太好笑了，我忍不住一直咯咯笑！

meanings.definition: Strange or unusual in a way that is not normal.
meanings.example: The milk tasted funny, so I didn’t drink it.
meanings.example_cn: 这牛奶味道怪怪的，所以我没喝。

meanings.definition: The soft hair on an animal.
meanings.example: The cat’s fur is soft and warm.
meanings.example_cn: 猫的毛又软又暖和。

meanings.definition: Covered with soft hair.
meanings.example: My teddy bear is the softest, most furry toy I have.
meanings.example_cn: 我的泰迪熊是我拥有的最软、毛最蓬松的玩具。

meanings.definition: More or to a greater degree.
meanings.example: If you want to learn further, you can read another book.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你想进一步学习，可以再读另一本书。

meanings.definition: At a longer distance away.
meanings.example: We walked further down the trail to find the waterfall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们沿着小路再走远一点，去找瀑布。

meanings.definition: An activity with rules that people play for fun or competition.
meanings.example: Our favourite game is hide-and-seek in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们最喜欢的游戏是在后院玩捉迷藏。

meanings.definition: An opening or space between two things.
meanings.example: Mind the gap between the train and the platform when you get on.
meanings.example_cn: 上车时，小心火车和站台之间的缝隙。

meanings.definition: A difference between people or things.
meanings.example: There is a gap between how the younger and older kids like to play at recess.
meanings.example_cn: 低年级和高年级小朋友课间玩耍的喜好不一样，存在差别。

meanings.definition: A piece of ground where flowers, vegetables, or plants are grown.
meanings.example: Grandma’s garden is full of colourful flowers and butterflies.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶的花园长满了彩色花朵和蝴蝶。

meanings.definition: To work in a garden, growing and caring for plants
meanings.example: Grandma loves to garden and grows tomatoes every summer.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶喜欢打理菜园，每年夏天都种西红柿。

meanings.definition: A substance like air.
meanings.example: We filled the balloon with gas so it could float up to the ceiling.
meanings.example_cn: 我们给气球充了气，它就能飘到天花板上。

meanings.definition: To fill something, like a car, with fuel.
meanings.example: We stopped at the station to gas up the car before heading home.
meanings.example_cn: 回家前我们在加油站停了一下，给车加满油。

meanings.definition: A door or entrance in a fence or wall.
meanings.example: Please close the gate so the puppy doesn’t run outside.
meanings.example_cn: 请关上大门，别让小狗跑到外面去。

meanings.definition: An entrance at an airport or station.
meanings.example: We waited at the airport gate until it was time to board our plane.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在机场登机口等候，直到可以登机。

meanings.definition: To come together.
meanings.example: Let’s gather around the table for story time.
meanings.example_cn: 我们围到桌子旁边来听故事吧。

meanings.definition: To collect things or bring them together.
meanings.example: Let’s gather all the blocks and put them back in the box.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把所有积木收集起来，放回箱子里吧。

meanings.definition: A small lizard that can climb walls.
meanings.example: A tiny gecko climbed up the wall in our classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 教室里有一只小壁虎爬上了墙。

meanings.definition: Happy to give or share with others.
meanings.example: She is generous and always shares her snacks with others.
meanings.example_cn: 她很大方，总是和别人分享她的零食。

meanings.definition: A kind or type of art, music, or book.
meanings.example: My favourite genre of movie is adventure because it’s exciting.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的电影类型是冒险片，因为很刺激。

meanings.definition: Kind and careful not to hurt anyone or anything.
meanings.example: He was gentle with the tiny kitten.
meanings.example_cn: 他对那只小猫很温柔。

meanings.definition: Soft or light in the way you act or touch.
meanings.example: The gentle breeze felt nice on my face.
meanings.example_cn: 和煦的微风拂过我的脸，很舒服。

meanings.definition: A tiny living thing that can cause illness.
meanings.example: Washing your hands helps get rid of germs that can make you sick.
meanings.example_cn: 洗手能帮你赶走让你生病的细菌。

meanings.definition: To receive, obtain, or come to have something.
meanings.example: I hope to get a new book for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望生日时能得到一本新书。

meanings.definition: To become a certain way or start to be something.
meanings.example: If you stay outside too long, you'll get cold.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你在外面待太久，会着凉的。

meanings.definition: The spirit of a dead person.
meanings.example: We told a spooky ghost story at the sleepover.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在过夜聚会上讲了一个吓人的鬼故事。

meanings.definition: A person or thing that is much bigger than normal.
meanings.example: An elephant is a giant compared to a mouse.
meanings.example_cn: 和老鼠比起来，大象就是个庞然大物。

meanings.definition: Very large in size.
meanings.example: We saw a giant pumpkin at the fair that was bigger than a chair!
meanings.example_cn: 我们在集市上看到一个比椅子还大的巨型南瓜！

meanings.definition: Something given to someone, often for a special reason.
meanings.example: I gave my friend a gift for her birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我送了一份礼物给朋友过生日。

meanings.definition: A natural talent or special ability someone has.
meanings.example: He has a gift for playing the violin beautifully.
meanings.example_cn: 他有演奏小提琴的天赋，拉得非常好听。

meanings.definition: A tall animal with a very long neck and spots, found in Africa.
meanings.example: The giraffe’s long neck helps it reach tall trees.
meanings.example_cn: 长颈鹿的长脖子帮它够到高处的树叶。

meanings.definition: A female child or young person.
meanings.example: The girl with the braids won the art contest.
meanings.example_cn: 那个扎辫子的女孩赢得了艺术比赛。

meanings.definition: To hand something to someone else.
meanings.example: Please give this note to your teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 请把这张纸条交给你的老师。

meanings.definition: To provide something so another person can have it.
meanings.example: The library will give us new books every month.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆每个月都会给我们新书。

meanings.definition: Happy or pleased.
meanings.example: I was so glad when my friend came to my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我的朋友来参加我的生日聚会，我特别高兴。

meanings.definition: A hard, clear material.
meanings.example: The windows are made of strong glass so we can see outside.
meanings.example_cn: 窗户用结实的玻璃做成，这样我们能看见外面。

meanings.definition: A cup or container made out of glass that you drink from.
meanings.example: I poured myself a glass of milk before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 睡觉前我给自己倒了一杯牛奶。

meanings.definition: To move smoothly and easily, often without much effort or noise.
meanings.example: The swan glided smoothly across the calm lake.
meanings.example_cn: 天鹅平稳地在平静的湖面上滑翔。

meanings.definition: A smooth and easy movement, often through the air or over a surface, without sudden stops or starts.
meanings.example: The skater’s glide across the ice was graceful and quiet.
meanings.example_cn: 滑冰选手在冰面上的滑行姿态优美又安静。

meanings.definition: A round model of the Earth showing continents, oceans, and countries.
meanings.example: We spun the globe to find where Australia is.
meanings.example_cn: 我们转动地球仪，找澳大利亚在哪里。

meanings.definition: Clothing you wear on your hand to keep it warm or safe.
meanings.example: Dad wears a glove when he works in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸在花园干活时戴着手套。

meanings.definition: To shine with a soft light.
meanings.example: The fireflies glow in the dark when we go camping.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去露营时，萤火虫在黑暗中发光。

meanings.definition: A soft, gentle light.
meanings.example: There was a gentle glow from the nightlight in my room.
meanings.example_cn: 我房间里的小夜灯发出柔和的光。

meanings.definition: A sticky substance used to stick things together.
meanings.example: Use glue to stick the pieces of your craft project together.
meanings.example_cn: 用胶水把你手工课作品的各部分粘起来。

meanings.definition: To stick things together using glue.
meanings.example: Please glue the pieces of your project together and let them dry.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你作品的各部分粘在一起，然后晾干。

meanings.definition: To move from one place to another.
meanings.example: We will go to the museum after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们要去博物馆。

meanings.definition: To leave a place or move away.
meanings.example: It's getting late, so we should go now.
meanings.example_cn: 天晚了，我们现在该走了。

meanings.definition: Something you try to achieve.
meanings.example: My goal is to read ten books this summer.
meanings.example_cn: 我的目标是这个夏天读十本书。

meanings.definition: The place where you score points in a game.
meanings.example: She kicked the ball straight into the goal and scored a point.
meanings.example_cn: 她一脚把球踢进球门，得了一分。

meanings.definition: An animal with horns and a beard.
meanings.example: The goat at the petting zoo tried to nibble my shoelaces!
meanings.example_cn: 亲子动物园里的那只山羊总想啃我的鞋带！

meanings.definition: A being that people worship.
meanings.example: Many people pray to God in their own special way.
meanings.example_cn: 很多人会用自己特别的方式向神祈祷。

meanings.definition: A shiny, yellow metal that is valuable.
meanings.example: The crown in the museum was made of shiny gold.
meanings.example_cn: 博物馆里的王冠是用闪亮的黄金做的。

meanings.definition: Made from the valuable yellow metal called gold.
meanings.example: Grandma gave me a gold necklace for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶送了我一条金项链作为生日礼物。

meanings.definition: A game played by hitting a ball into holes with clubs.
meanings.example: Dad likes to play golf on the weekends with his friends.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸周末喜欢和朋友们一起打高尔夫。

meanings.definition: Not here anymore because someone or something has left.
meanings.example: My ice cream was gone before I even finished my sandwich.
meanings.example_cn: 我还没吃完三明治，我的冰淇淋就已经没了。

meanings.definition: Of high quality.
meanings.example: She got a good grade on her spelling test.
meanings.example_cn: 她拼写测验得了好成绩。

meanings.definition: Being kind, caring, or helpful.
meanings.example: It was good of you to help your friend clean up.
meanings.example_cn: 你帮助朋友打扫卫生真是太好了。

meanings.definition: A word you say when you leave someone.
meanings.example: I waved goodbye to my friends after the party.
meanings.example_cn: 派对结束后我向朋友们挥手告别。

meanings.definition: A large water bird.
meanings.example: We saw a goose and her babies swimming at the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在池塘边看到一只鹅带着小鹅在游泳。

meanings.definition: The group of people who make rules and run a country.
meanings.example: The government helps keep our city clean and safe.
meanings.example_cn: 政府帮助我们的城市保持清洁和安全。

meanings.definition: To take something quickly and suddenly.
meanings.example: Please grab your backpack before we leave the house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们出门前请拿起你的背包。

meanings.definition: A sudden, rough snatch or attempt to seize
meanings.example: With one quick grab, he caught the bouncing ball.
meanings.example_cn: 他迅速一抓，接住了弹起来的球。

meanings.definition: A mark or score that shows how well you did at something.
meanings.example: I got a good grade on my maths test.
meanings.example_cn: 我数学考试得了好成绩。

meanings.definition: To give a score or mark for how well something was done.
meanings.example: The teacher will grade our science projects this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会在周末给我们科学项目打分。

meanings.definition: A small seed from plants like wheat or rice.
meanings.example: We learned that bread is made from grain like wheat.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学到面包是用小麦这样的谷物做的。

meanings.definition: A small unit used to measure weight.
meanings.example: A paperclip weighs about one gram.
meanings.example_cn: 一个回形针大约重一克。

meanings.definition: Very big and impressive.
meanings.example: The castle looked grand with its tall towers and golden gates.
meanings.example_cn: 这座城堡有高高的塔楼和金色的大门，看起来很气派。

meanings.definition: A small, round, sweet fruit that grows in bunches.
meanings.example: I packed a handful of grapes in my lunchbox.
meanings.example_cn: 我在饭盒里装了一把葡萄。

meanings.definition: A large, round, citrus fruit that is yellow or pink inside.
meanings.example: Grapefruit tastes sour but is very healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 西柚尝起来很酸，但很健康。

meanings.definition: A drawing that shows numbers or amounts.
meanings.example: We made a graph to show how many apples each student likes.
meanings.example_cn: 我们画了一张图，展示每个同学喜欢吃多少苹果。

meanings.definition: To draw a picture that shows numbers or information.
meanings.example: We learned how to graph the results of our science experiment.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学了怎么用图表展示科学实验的结果。

meanings.definition: The green plants that cover the ground in fields and gardens.
meanings.example: We lay on the soft grass to watch the clouds.
meanings.example_cn: 我们躺在柔软的草地上看云。

meanings.definition: A green insect that jumps and makes a chirping sound.
meanings.example: The grasshopper leaped into the tall grass.
meanings.example_cn: 蚱蜢跳进了高高的草丛里。

meanings.definition: Feeling thankful for something someone has done.
meanings.example: I am grateful for my family and friends every day.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天都很感激我的家人和朋友。

meanings.definition: Something is excellent, wonderful, or much better than usual.
meanings.definition_cn: 极好的；远超平常水平的
meanings.example: We had a great time at the amusement park.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在游乐园玩得很开心。

meanings.definition: Something or someone has a lot of importance, power, or influence.
meanings.example: It’s a great honour to carry the school flag.
meanings.example_cn: 举校旗是一种莫大的荣誉。

meanings.definition: Much bigger, higher, or more than usual.
meanings.example: The elephant is a great animal because it is so big.
meanings.example_cn: 大象是一种庞大的动物，因为它太大了。

meanings.definition: The colour of grass or leaves.
meanings.example: The grass in the park is bright green after it rains.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨后公园里的草是鲜绿色的。

meanings.definition: To say hello to someone.
meanings.example: We greet our teacher every morning with a smile.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每天早上面带微笑向老师问好。

meanings.definition: The colour between black and white, like clouds.
meanings.example: The sky turned grey before it started to rain.
meanings.example_cn: 开始下雨前天空变成了灰色。

meanings.definition: A metal rack for cooking over heat.
meanings.example: We cooked hamburgers on the grill at the family picnic.
meanings.example_cn: 家庭野餐时，我们在烤架上烤汉堡包。

meanings.definition: To cook food over direct heat, like on a barbecue.
meanings.example: My dad likes to grill hamburgers outside in the summer.
meanings.example_cn: 我爸爸夏天喜欢在外面烤汉堡包。

meanings.definition: To smile with your mouth wide open.
meanings.example: She couldn't help but grin when she saw her birthday cake.
meanings.example_cn: 看到生日蛋糕时，她忍不住咧嘴笑了。

meanings.definition: A wide, happy smile that shows your teeth.
meanings.example: A big grin spread across his face after he won the race.
meanings.example_cn: 赢得比赛后，他脸上漾开一个大大的笑容。

meanings.definition: Tiny pieces of sand or stone.
meanings.example: Tiny bits of grit got in my shoes when I walked on the sandy path.
meanings.example_cn: 我走在沙地上时，细小的沙砾钻进了鞋里。

meanings.definition: To press your teeth together, usually because you are angry or in pain.
meanings.example: I had to grit my teeth when the doctor gave me a shot.
meanings.example_cn: 医生给我打针时，我不得不咬紧牙关。

meanings.definition: Courage or strength to keep going, even when it’s hard.
meanings.example: It takes a lot of grit to keep practising even when things get hard.
meanings.example_cn: 就算事情变难了，也要继续练习，这需要很大的毅力。

meanings.definition: The surface of the earth.
meanings.example: We sat on the ground to have our picnic lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐在地上吃野餐午餐。

meanings.definition: To punish someone by not letting them go out.
meanings.example: Mom will ground me if I don’t finish my homework on time.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我不准时完成作业，妈妈就会罚我不许出门。

meanings.definition: A number of people or things that are together.
meanings.example: Our group finished the project before the deadline.
meanings.example_cn: 我们小组在截止日期前完成了项目。

meanings.definition: To gather things or people together in one place.
meanings.example: Let’s group the blocks by colour.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们按颜色把积木分组。

meanings.definition: To get bigger or older.
meanings.example: The puppy will grow into a big dog someday.
meanings.example_cn: 这只小狗将来会长成一只大狗。

meanings.definition: To help plants get bigger.
meanings.example: If you water your plant every day, it will grow tall and green.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你每天给植物浇水，它就会长得又高又绿。

meanings.definition: To change over time.
meanings.example: A small idea can grow into a big project over time.
meanings.example_cn: 一个小小的想法，久而久之会变成一个大项目。

meanings.definition: To try to answer without being sure.
meanings.example: Can you guess what’s inside the wrapped box?
meanings.example_cn: 你能猜出这个包装好的盒子里是什么吗？

meanings.definition: An answer you choose when you are not sure.
meanings.example: My guess is that there are twenty candies in the jar.
meanings.example_cn: 我猜罐子里有二十颗糖果。

meanings.definition: Someone invited to visit or stay.
meanings.example: We had a special guest visit our class and read us a story.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班来了一位特别的客人，给我们读了一个故事。

meanings.definition: A person who shows others the way.
meanings.example: Our guide pointed out interesting animals during the nature walk.
meanings.example_cn: 向导在大自然漫步中指出有趣的动物。

meanings.definition: To show or lead the way for someone.
meanings.example: Let me guide you through the steps of this science experiment.
meanings.example_cn: 让我带你一步步完成这个科学实验。

meanings.definition: A chewy sweet or candy.
meanings.example: Chewing bubble gum can make a really big bubble.
meanings.example_cn: 嚼泡泡糖能吹出很大的泡泡。

meanings.definition: The pink soft part in your mouth around your teeth.
meanings.example: The dentist checks your gum to make sure it’s healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 牙医会检查你的牙龈，确保它是健康的。

meanings.definition: A weapon that shoots bullets.
meanings.example: The police officer showed us that a gun is not a toy and should never be touched.
meanings.example_cn: 警察叔叔告诉我们枪不是玩具，绝对不能碰。

meanings.definition: Another word for a man or boy.
meanings.example: The guy who lives next door has a cool bicycle.
meanings.example_cn: 住在隔壁的那个人有一辆很酷的自行车。

meanings.definition: A room or building with equipment for exercise or sports.
meanings.example: We have gym class every Wednesday at school.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学校每周三都有体育课。

meanings.definition: Something you do over and over again, like brushing your teeth every day.
meanings.example: Brushing your teeth twice a day is a good habit.
meanings.example_cn: 每天刷两次牙是个好习惯。

meanings.definition: The thin strands that grow on your head and sometimes on your body.
meanings.example: She braided her long hair before going to school.
meanings.example_cn: 上学前她把长头发编成了辫子。

meanings.definition: One of two equal parts when something is divided into two.
meanings.example: I ate half of my sandwich and saved the rest for later.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了半个三明治，剩下的留着晚点吃。

meanings.definition: Being one of the two equal parts of something.
meanings.example: The pizza was half cheese and half pepperoni.
meanings.example_cn: 这个披萨一半是奶酪，一半是意大利辣香肠。

meanings.definition: A big room or building where people meet for parties or events.
meanings.example: We all met in the school hall for the assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 我们都在学校礼堂集合参加集会。

meanings.definition: A tool you use to hit nails into wood.
meanings.example: Dad used a hammer to hang a picture on the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸用锤子把一幅画挂到墙上。

meanings.definition: To hit something using a hammer.
meanings.example: Let’s hammer the nails into this piece of wood.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把钉子敲进这块木头里吧。

meanings.definition: The part at the end of your arm that you use to hold things, with fingers and a thumb.
meanings.example: She wore a bracelet on her left hand.
meanings.example_cn: 她左手戴着一条手链。

meanings.definition: To give something to someone by passing it to them.
meanings.example: Please hand this note to your teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 请把这张纸条交给你的老师。

meanings.definition: The part of something that you hold onto.
meanings.example: Please hold the bucket by the handle so it doesn’t spill.
meanings.example_cn: 提桶时请握住把手，别让水洒出来。

meanings.definition: To take care of a problem or situation.
meanings.example: Mom will handle the problem if the computer stops working.
meanings.example_cn: 如果电脑坏了，妈妈会来处理这个问题。

meanings.definition: Very useful.
meanings.example: A flashlight is handy to have when the power goes out.
meanings.example_cn: 停电的时候，手电筒派上大用场。

meanings.definition: Good at fixing things or making things work.
meanings.example: Uncle Jim is so handy, he can fix almost anything.
meanings.example_cn: 吉姆叔叔手很巧，几乎什么都能修。

meanings.definition: To attach something at the top so it dangles or swings.
meanings.example: Let’s hang the decorations from the ceiling for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把装饰品挂在天花板上，准备开派对。

meanings.definition: To spend time with people or in a place.
meanings.example: After school, I like to hang with my friends at the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后，我喜欢和小伙伴在游乐场一起玩。

meanings.definition: To take place or occur when something comes about.
meanings.example: What will happen if it rains during the picnic?
meanings.example_cn: 野餐时下雨了会发生什么？

meanings.definition: Feeling pleased, glad, or joyful.
meanings.example: I felt happy when my friends came over to play.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友们过来玩时我感到很开心。

meanings.definition: Not soft, so it is firm or difficult to press.
meanings.example: This chair feels hard, but it’s sturdy.
meanings.example_cn: 这把椅子摸起来很硬，但很结实。

meanings.definition: Needing a lot of effort, not easy to do.
meanings.example: That was a hard puzzle, but you solved it!
meanings.example_cn: 那是个很难的拼图，但你解出来了！

meanings.definition: Done with a lot of effort or strength, not easy.
meanings.example: She worked hard to finish her project on time.
meanings.example_cn: 她非常努力，以便按时完成自己的项目。

meanings.definition: Always trying your best and never giving up because you work a lot.
meanings.example: The hardworking ant carried a crumb back to its nest.
meanings.example_cn: 勤劳的蚂蚁衔着一块面包屑回巢。

meanings.definition: Damage to someone’s body or feelings.
meanings.example: Running with scissors can cause harm, so be careful.
meanings.example_cn: 拿着剪刀跑会伤人，所以要小心。

meanings.definition: To hurt someone or something.
meanings.example: Never harm animals; always be gentle and kind to them.
meanings.example_cn: 绝对不要伤害动物，永远要温柔、友善地对待它们。

meanings.definition: Very mean, rough, or not gentle.
meanings.example: The harsh wind made it hard to walk outside.
meanings.example_cn: 刺骨的风让人很难在外面行走。

meanings.definition: The fruits or vegetables that are picked at the end of the growing season.
meanings.example: We picked apples during the fall harvest.
meanings.example_cn: 秋天收获的时候，我们摘了苹果。

meanings.definition: To gather crops or plants when they are ready.
meanings.example: We harvest apples from the orchard every fall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每年秋天从果园里收苹果。

meanings.definition: The form of “have” used with he, she, or it.
meanings.definition_cn: 有（have的第三人称单数形式）
meanings.example: She has a beautiful new backpack for school.
meanings.example_cn: 她有一个漂亮的新书包上学用。

meanings.definition: Doing something very quickly.
meanings.example: In his haste to finish, he spilled juice on his paper.
meanings.example_cn: 他急着做完，结果把果汁洒在了纸上。

meanings.definition: Something you wear on your head to keep warm or for style.
meanings.example: I wore a funny hat to the costume party.
meanings.example_cn: 我戴着一顶有趣的帽子参加化装派对。

meanings.definition: To really, really not like something or someone.
meanings.example: I hate getting up early on cold mornings.
meanings.example_cn: 我讨厌在寒冷的早上早起。

meanings.definition: A very strong feeling of not liking something or someone.
meanings.example: He felt hate for broccoli until he tried it with cheese.
meanings.example_cn: 他本来讨厌西兰花，直到他配着奶酪尝了一口。

meanings.definition: A bird with sharp claws and a hooked beak that hunts other animals.
meanings.example: A hawk soared high in the sky looking for food.
meanings.example_cn: 一只鹰在高空中翱翔，寻找食物。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about a boy or a man.
meanings.example: He wore his new shoes to school today.
meanings.example_cn: 他今天穿着新鞋去上学。

meanings.definition: The top part of your body with your face, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
meanings.example: He wore a red cap on his head in the sun.
meanings.example_cn: 他头上戴着一顶红帽子遮太阳。

meanings.definition: The top or highest part of something.
meanings.example: The title is written at the head of the page.
meanings.example_cn: 标题写在页面的顶部。

meanings.definition: To go in a certain direction.
meanings.example: We will head to the park after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们会去公园。

meanings.definition: A pain inside your head.
meanings.example: I got a headache after reading in the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 在黑暗里看书后我头疼了。

meanings.definition: The condition of your body and mind being well, not sick.
meanings.example: Eating fruit and veggies is good for your health.
meanings.example_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜对你的健康有益。

meanings.definition: To use your ears to notice sounds.
meanings.example: Did you hear the birds singing outside the window?
meanings.example_cn: 你听见窗外鸟儿在唱歌吗？

meanings.definition: To learn about something by being told or hearing it.
meanings.example: I hear there's going to be a school play next month.
meanings.example_cn: 我听说下个月学校要演话剧。

meanings.definition: The organ in your chest that pumps blood all around your body.
meanings.example: Your heart beats faster when you run really quickly.
meanings.example_cn: 你跑得很快时，心脏会跳得更快。

meanings.definition: The centre of your feelings or emotions.
meanings.example: She has a kind heart and always helps her friends.
meanings.example_cn: 她心地善良，总是帮助朋友。

meanings.definition: A shape with two curves at the top and a point at the bottom, used to show love or care.
meanings.example: She drew a heart on her card to show love.
meanings.example_cn: 她在卡片上画了一颗爱心来表达爱意。

meanings.definition: How hot something is.
meanings.example: The heat from the sun made the sand too hot to walk on.
meanings.example_cn: 太阳的热度把沙子晒得太烫，没法在上面走。

meanings.definition: To make something warmer or hot.
meanings.example: Can you heat my soup in the microwave, please?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我用微波炉热一下汤吗？

meanings.definition: Hard to lift because it weighs a lot.
meanings.example: The box was too heavy for me to lift alone.
meanings.example_cn: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

meanings.definition: A row of bushes planted close together like a fence.
meanings.example: A green hedge grows along the edge of our yard.
meanings.example_cn: 一排绿色的树篱沿着我们院子的边缘长着。

meanings.definition: The back part of your foot.
meanings.example: My new shoes hurt the heel of my foot.
meanings.example_cn: 我的新鞋磨脚后跟。

meanings.definition: The back part of the shoe, underneath your foot, that is thicker or raised.
meanings.example: The heel of Sarah’s shoe made her a little taller when she wore them to the party.
meanings.example_cn: 萨拉鞋子的鞋跟让她穿上去参加派对时，个子显得高了一点。

meanings.definition: A word you say to greet someone.
meanings.example: I always say hello to my neighbours when I see them.
meanings.example_cn: 我看到邻居时总是向他们问好。

meanings.definition: To make things easier for someone or do something for them.
meanings.example: Can you help me tie my shoes?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我系鞋带吗？

meanings.definition: Aid or something that makes things easier.
meanings.example: Thank you for your help with my math homework.
meanings.example_cn: 谢谢你辅导我的数学作业。

meanings.definition: To make a difficult or painful situation better, easier, or less painful.
meanings.example: Putting ice on my sore knee helped the pain go away faster.
meanings.example_cn: 给我疼的膝盖敷冰，帮助疼痛更快消失。

meanings.definition: A grown-up female chicken.
meanings.example: The brown hen laid three eggs this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 那只棕色的母鸡今天早上下了三个蛋。

meanings.definition: Used when talking about a girl or woman as the object in a sentence.
meanings.example: I saw her at the library reading a big book.
meanings.example_cn: 我在图书馆看到她在读一本大书。

meanings.definition: Belonging to a girl or woman.
meanings.example: Her backpack is decorated with bright stickers.
meanings.example_cn: 她的背包上贴满了明亮的贴纸。

meanings.definition: A plant used in cooking to give food flavour.
meanings.example: We planted a basil herb in our kitchen garden.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在厨房小菜园里种了罗勒香草。

meanings.definition: A group of cows or other animals that move together.
meanings.example: We watched a herd of cows grazing in the field.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看到一群牛在田野里吃草。

meanings.definition: To gather animals together into a group.
meanings.example: The farmer will herd the cows into the barn at sunset.
meanings.example_cn: 日落时，农民会把牛赶回牛棚。

meanings.definition: In this place.
meanings.example: Come here and look at this funny photo!
meanings.example_cn: 过来看看这张有趣的照片！

meanings.definition: At this point.
meanings.example: Here is where the story gets exciting.
meanings.example_cn: 这里就是故事变得精彩的地方。

meanings.definition: A brave person who helps or saves others.
meanings.example: The firefighter was a hero for saving the puppy from the fire.
meanings.example_cn: 这位消防员从火里救出了小狗，是个英雄。

meanings.definition: Belongs to a girl or woman.
meanings.example: That pink backpack is hers, not mine.
meanings.example_cn: 那个粉色的背包是她的，不是我的。

meanings.definition: Used to show that the girl or woman is doing something to or for herself.
meanings.example: She made herself a peanut butter sandwich.
meanings.example_cn: 她给自己做了一个花生酱三明治。

meanings.definition: To put something where no one can see it.
meanings.example: Let’s hide the birthday present under the bed so no one finds it.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把生日礼物藏到床底下，这样没人能找到。

meanings.definition: The skin of an animal, usually after it has been removed.
meanings.example: The cowboy wore boots made from snake hide.
meanings.example_cn: 这个牛仔穿的靴子是用蛇皮做的。

meanings.definition: Tall or far above the ground.
meanings.example: The flag is flying high on the pole.
meanings.example_cn: 旗子高高地飘在旗杆上。

meanings.definition: A great amount or level.
meanings.example: He scored a high number of points in the game.
meanings.example_cn: 他在游戏中得了很多分。

meanings.definition: To go for a long walk, usually in nature.
meanings.example: On Saturday, we will hike up the mountain trail with our family.
meanings.example_cn: 星期六，我们会和家人一起沿山路徒步。

meanings.definition: A long walk, usually for fun or exercise.
meanings.example: We went on a hike through the woods to see the waterfall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们徒步穿过树林，去看瀑布。

meanings.definition: A piece of land that rises higher than the land around it, but is smaller than a mountain.
meanings.example: We rolled down the grassy hill and laughed a lot.
meanings.example_cn: 我们从长满草的山坡上滚下来，笑得很开心。

meanings.definition: Used when talking about a boy or man as the object in a sentence.
meanings.example: Give him the blue cup because it’s his favourite.
meanings.example_cn: 把蓝色的杯子给他，因为那是他最喜欢的。

meanings.definition: Used to show that the boy or man is doing something to or for himself.
meanings.example: He taught himself to play the guitar.
meanings.example_cn: 他自学了弹吉他。

meanings.definition: A small clue to help someone figure something out.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a hint about where she hid the cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈给了我一点提示，告诉我她把饼干藏哪儿了。

meanings.definition: To suggest something in a gentle or indirect way.
meanings.example: Dad will hint at what my birthday present is, but he won’t tell me.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会暗示我的生日礼物是什么，但不会直接告诉我。

meanings.definition: The part of your body below your waist on each side.
meanings.example: She wore a belt around her hip to hold up her pants.
meanings.example_cn: 她在髋部系了一条腰带，把裤子提住。

meanings.definition: A large animal from Africa with thick skin and a big mouth.
meanings.example: At the zoo, the hippo splashed water with its big mouth.
meanings.example_cn: 在动物园里，河马用它的大嘴把水溅得到处都是。

meanings.definition: Belonging to a boy or man.
meanings.example: Max forgot his blue backpack at school yesterday.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天马克把他的蓝色背包忘在学校了。

meanings.definition: To make a sharp sound like a snake.
meanings.example: The snake will hiss if it feels scared or angry.
meanings.example_cn: 蛇感到害怕或生气时会发出嘶嘶声。

meanings.definition: A sharp sound, like air escaping or a snake.
meanings.example: The snake made a loud hiss when it was scared.
meanings.example_cn: 蛇害怕时发出很响的嘶嘶声。

meanings.definition: Things that happened in the past.
meanings.example: We learned about ancient Egypt in history class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在历史课上学了古埃及。

meanings.definition: To touch someone or something quickly and with force.
meanings.example: Don’t hit the drum too loudly during music class.
meanings.example_cn: 音乐课上别把鼓敲得太响。

meanings.definition: To cause harm, trouble, or difficulty for someone or something.
meanings.example: The storm hit the town hard and many homes lost power.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨猛烈袭击了小镇，许多家庭断电了。

meanings.definition: To accomplish a goal or reach a target.
meanings.example: He hit his goal and finished the puzzle all by himself.
meanings.example_cn: 他达成了目标，独自拼完了拼图。

meanings.definition: Something you like to do for fun in your free time.
meanings.example: Drawing pictures is my favourite hobby after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后画画是我最喜欢的爱好。

meanings.definition: To keep something in your hand or arms.
meanings.example: Please hold my hand when we cross the street.
meanings.example_cn: 过马路时请牵着我的手。

meanings.definition: A firm grip or grasp on something
meanings.example: The gymnast kept a strong hold on the bar.
meanings.example_cn: 体操运动员紧紧握住单杠。

meanings.definition: An empty space or opening in something solid.
meanings.example: There was a hole in my sock, so my toe stuck out.
meanings.example_cn: 我的袜子上有个洞，脚趾露出来了。

meanings.definition: The place where you live and feel safe.
meanings.example: I feel safe and happy at home with my family.
meanings.example_cn: 在家和家人在一起，我感到安全又快乐。

meanings.definition: To or at your house, or the place you live.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school because I wasn't feeling well.
meanings.example_cn: 因为我感觉不舒服，就没去上学。

meanings.definition: Schoolwork that you do at home.
meanings.example: I finished my homework before dinner so I could relax.
meanings.example_cn: 我在晚饭前完成了作业，这样就能放松了。

meanings.definition: Always telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
meanings.example: It’s always best to be honest and tell the truth.
meanings.example_cn: 诚实、说真话永远是最好的。

meanings.definition: The thick, sweet food made by bees.
meanings.example: Bees make sweet honey from flowers.
meanings.example_cn: 蜜蜂用花朵酿出甜甜的蜂蜜。

meanings.definition: A tool with a curved end for hanging or catching things.
meanings.example: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
meanings.example_cn: 把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

meanings.definition: To catch or grab something with a hook.
meanings.example: I tried to hook my backpack onto the chair, but it kept falling off.
meanings.example_cn: 我想把背包挂到椅子上，可它一直掉下来。

meanings.definition: To jump into the air, often using one foot.
meanings.example: The bunny likes to hop around the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 小兔子喜欢在花园里蹦蹦跳跳。

meanings.definition: A short jump, especially on one foot
meanings.example: The bunny made a big hop across the grass.
meanings.example_cn: 小兔子在草地上重重一跳。

meanings.definition: To want something good to happen.
meanings.example: I hope we can visit the zoo this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望这个周末我们能去动物园。

meanings.definition: A wish that something good will happen.
meanings.example: Her biggest hope is to become a great artist.
meanings.example_cn: 她最大的愿望是成为一名伟大的艺术家。

meanings.definition: Feeling sure or believing that something good will happen.
meanings.definition_cn: 抱有希望的；满怀希望的
meanings.example: I am hopeful that the sun will come out tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望明天太阳会出来。

meanings.definition: A large animal with four legs that people can ride.
meanings.example: The horse galloped across the open field.
meanings.example_cn: 马奔驰过开阔的田野。

meanings.definition: A long, bendy tube for moving water.
meanings.example: We used a hose to water the garden on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 天气热的时候，我们用水管浇花园。

meanings.definition: To spray water using a hose.
meanings.example: Let’s hose down the muddy dog before he comes inside.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用水管把这只满身泥的狗冲干净，再让它进屋。

meanings.definition: A place where doctors and nurses help people who are sick or hurt.
meanings.example: My sister was born in the hospital downtown.
meanings.example_cn: 我妹妹在市中心的一家医院出生。

meanings.definition: Having a very high temperature, so it feels warm when you touch it.
meanings.example: Be careful, the soup is hot!
meanings.example_cn: 小心，汤很烫！

meanings.definition: A place where people stay when they are away from home.
meanings.example: We stayed at a hotel by the beach during our vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 我们度假时住在海边的一家酒店里。

meanings.definition: A length of time that is sixty minutes long.
meanings.example: It takes about an hour to drive to grandma’s house.
meanings.example_cn: 开车去奶奶家大约要一个小时。

meanings.definition: A building where people live.
meanings.example: Our house has a bright red door and a big yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的房子有一扇鲜红色的门和一个大院子。

meanings.definition: To provide someone with a place to live.
meanings.example: The animal shelter will house the lost puppy until someone adopts it.
meanings.example_cn: 动物收容所会收留这只走失的小狗，直到有人领养它。

meanings.definition: To contain or store something.
meanings.example: The barn can house many animals during the winter.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天这座谷仓能容纳很多动物。

meanings.definition: Used when asking about the way something happens.
meanings.example: Can you show me how to tie my shoes?
meanings.example_cn: 你能教我怎么系鞋带吗？

meanings.definition: Used when asking about the amount of something.
meanings.example: How much ice cream do you want?
meanings.example_cn: 你想要多少冰淇淋？

meanings.definition: Used when asking about someone’s feelings.
meanings.example: How are you feeling after your first day at school?
meanings.example_cn: 上学第一天结束后，你感觉怎么样？

meanings.definition: A word used to show something different, like “but.”
meanings.example: I wanted to play outside; however, it started to rain.
meanings.example_cn: 我想出去玩；然而，开始下雨了。

meanings.definition: To put your arms around someone to show you care.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a big hug before I left for school.
meanings.example_cn: 我上学出门前，妈妈给了我一个大大的拥抱。

meanings.definition: A warm squeeze or embrace with your arms.
meanings.example: After I fell, Mom gave me a big hug to help me feel better.
meanings.example_cn: 我摔倒后，妈妈给了我一个大大的拥抱，让我感觉好一点。

meanings.definition: Very, very big.
meanings.example: There was a huge pumpkin at the county fair.
meanings.example_cn: 县集市上有一个巨大的南瓜。

meanings.definition: To make a low, steady sound, like buzzing.
meanings.example: She likes to hum her favourite songs while drawing.
meanings.example_cn: 她画画时喜欢哼自己最喜欢的歌。

meanings.definition: A low, steady sound that keeps going.
meanings.example: There was a soft hum from the refrigerator in the kitchen.
meanings.example_cn: 厨房里的冰箱发出轻轻的嗡嗡声。

meanings.definition: A person.
meanings.example: Every human needs food, water, and sleep to stay healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 每个人都需要食物、水和睡眠来保持健康。

meanings.definition: Not thinking you are better than other people.
meanings.example: Even though he won the race, he stayed humble and thanked his teammates.
meanings.example_cn: 虽然他赢了比赛，但他保持谦虚，感谢了队友。

meanings.definition: A number that is equal to ten groups of ten (100).
meanings.example: There are one hundred students in the whole primary 1.
meanings.example_cn: 整个一年级一共有一百名学生。

meanings.definition: To search for and try to catch or kill animals.
meanings.example: The cat likes to hunt for mice in the barn.
meanings.example_cn: 猫喜欢在谷仓里抓老鼠。

meanings.definition: The act of searching for or chasing animals.
meanings.example: The hunters prepared for the hunt early in the morning.
meanings.example_cn: 猎人们一大早就为这次狩猎做好准备。

meanings.definition: To look carefully for something you want to find.
meanings.example: The detectives hunt for clues to solve the mystery.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探们搜寻线索，解开这个谜团。

meanings.definition: To do something quickly because there isn’t much time.
meanings.example: Hurry or we'll miss the beginning of the movie!
meanings.example_cn: 快一点，否则我们会错过电影的开头！

meanings.definition: Fast movement because there isn’t much time.
meanings.example: In all the hurry to get ready, I forgot my lunchbox.
meanings.example_cn: 在匆忙准备中，我忘带了饭盒。

meanings.definition: To cause someone pain or injury.
meanings.example: Be careful not to hurt your finger when you close the door.
meanings.example_cn: 关门时小心别夹到手指。

meanings.definition: Feeling pain or having something that is painful.
meanings.example: She felt hurt when her friend forgot her birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友忘了她的生日，她感到很伤心。

meanings.definition: Pain or injury, either to your body or your feelings.
meanings.example: She felt a sharp hurt in her knee after falling.
meanings.example_cn: 她摔倒之后，膝盖一阵刺痛。

meanings.definition: A small, simple house.
meanings.example: We built a small hut out of sticks and leaves in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在后院用树枝和树叶搭了一个小棚子。

meanings.definition: A wild animal that looks like a dog and makes a laughing sound.
meanings.example: The hyena laughed as it played with its friends.
meanings.example_cn: 鬣狗和朋友们玩耍时发出笑声。

meanings.definition: The word you use when talking about yourself.
meanings.example: I really enjoy reading adventure stories at night.
meanings.example_cn: 我真的很喜欢晚上读冒险故事。

meanings.definition: Frozen water that is hard and cold.
meanings.example: The pond was covered with ice, so we went skating.
meanings.example_cn: 池塘结了冰，所以我们去滑冰了。

meanings.definition: To cover a cake with sweet icing.
meanings.example: Let’s ice the cupcakes with blue frosting for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们给纸杯蛋糕抹上蓝色糖霜，用来派对吧。

meanings.definition: Very cold and slippery, often covered with ice.
meanings.example: Be careful on the icy stairs so you don’t slip and fall.
meanings.example_cn: 结冰的楼梯上要小心，别滑倒摔跤。

meanings.definition: A thought, plan, or suggestion you think of.
meanings.example: I have an idea for our art project.
meanings.example_cn: 我对我们的艺术项目有个想法。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about something that might happen, depending on another thing.
meanings.example: If you finish your homework, we can play outside.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你完成作业，我们就可以出去玩。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about what will happen or might happen, depending on something else.
meanings.example: I don't know if it will rain tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我不知道明天会不会下雨。

meanings.definition: To deliberately pay no attention to someone or something.
meanings.example: Try to ignore the noise and finish your homework.
meanings.example_cn: 试着不理那些噪音，把作业做完。

meanings.definition: Feeling unwell or in poor health.
meanings.example: She stayed home from school because she felt ill.
meanings.example_cn: 她感觉不舒服，所以待在家里没去上学。

meanings.definition: A picture or drawing of something.
meanings.example: I drew an image of a castle for art class.
meanings.example_cn: 我为美术课画了一座城堡的图像。

meanings.definition: To picture something in your mind or think it could happen.
meanings.example: Imagine you could fly like a bird above the clouds!
meanings.example_cn: 想象一下你能像鸟一样在云层上面飞！

meanings.definition: Not wanting to wait and getting annoyed when things take too long.
meanings.example: I felt impatient waiting for my turn on the swing.
meanings.example_cn: 排队等荡秋千的时候，我等得不耐烦了。

meanings.definition: Something that matters a lot or needs attention.
meanings.example: It’s important to be kind to others every day.
meanings.example_cn: 每天善待他人很重要。

meanings.definition: Inside a space or place.
meanings.example: The puppy is sleeping in the soft basket.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗正睡在柔软的篮子里。

meanings.definition: Happening during a certain period of time.
meanings.example: We go swimming in the summer when it's hot.
meanings.example_cn: 夏天很热时我们去游泳。

meanings.definition: A small unit of length, about 2.5 centimetres.
meanings.example: The caterpillar was only an inch long as it crawled across the leaf.
meanings.example_cn: 毛毛虫在叶子上爬的时候，只有一英寸长。

meanings.definition: To move very slowly, just a little at a time.
meanings.example: The turtle began to inch closer to the lettuce, bit by bit.
meanings.example_cn: 乌龟一点点地向生菜挪近。

meanings.definition: When germs like bacteria or viruses get into your body and make you sick.
meanings.example: The doctor gave me medicine to help me get better from my ear infection.
meanings.example_cn: 医生给我开了药，帮我治好耳朵感染。

meanings.definition: To hurt or damage part of the body.
meanings.example: Be careful on the playground so you don’t injure your knee.
meanings.example_cn: 在操场上要小心，别伤到膝盖。

meanings.definition: Harm or damage to your body.
meanings.example: I got a small injury on my knee while playing soccer.
meanings.example_cn: 踢足球时我的膝盖受了点小伤。

meanings.definition: Coloured liquid used for writing or drawing.
meanings.example: I spilled blue ink all over my drawing by accident.
meanings.example_cn: 我不小心把蓝墨水洒得满画都是。

meanings.definition: To strongly say that something must happen or is true.
meanings.example: I insist that you try a piece of this delicious cake.
meanings.example_cn: 我坚持让你尝一块这块美味的蛋糕。

meanings.definition: To teach someone how to do something.
meanings.example: The dance teacher will instruct us on how to twirl.
meanings.example_cn: 舞蹈老师会教我们怎么转圈。

meanings.definition: To tell someone what to do or give an order.
meanings.example: The lifeguard instructed swimmers to stay in the shallow end of the pool.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员嘱咐游泳的人待在泳池的浅水区。

meanings.definition: Something you plan or mean to do.
meanings.example: My intention was to finish my project early.
meanings.example_cn: 我的打算是早点完成项目。

meanings.definition: Wanting to know or do something.
meanings.example: He has a strong interest in dinosaurs and can name many kinds.
meanings.example_cn: 他对恐龙有浓厚的兴趣，能说出好多种类。

meanings.definition: To make someone want to pay attention or learn more.
meanings.example: Dinosaur books really interest my little sister.
meanings.example_cn: 恐龙的书真的很吸引我的小妹妹。

meanings.definition: The extra money you pay when you borrow money.
meanings.example: If you borrow money from the bank, you have to pay interest on the loan.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你向银行借钱，就得为贷款付利息。

meanings.definition: Moving inside something.
meanings.example: The frog jumped into the cool, clear pond.
meanings.example_cn: 青蛙跳进了清凉清澈的池塘。

meanings.definition: Becoming part of it.
meanings.example: When I mixed blue and yellow paint, they turned into green.
meanings.example_cn: 我把蓝色和黄色颜料混合后，它们变成了绿色。

meanings.definition: To ask someone to come to your home or event.
meanings.example: I want to invite my friends to my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我想邀请我的朋友来参加我的生日派对。

meanings.definition: A request asking someone to come to an event.
meanings.example: I got an invite to Sam's birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我收到了山姆生日聚会的邀请。

meanings.definition: A strong, hard metal that is often used to make things.
meanings.example: The gate was made out of strong iron bars.
meanings.example_cn: 大门是用结实的铁条做的。

meanings.definition: To smooth out wrinkles in clothes using an iron.
meanings.example: I have to iron my shirt so it looks nice for the picture.
meanings.example_cn: 我得熨一下衬衫，拍照片时才好看。

meanings.definition: The form of “be” used with he, she, or it.
meanings.example: My favourite toy is a bright red car.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的玩具是一辆鲜红色的汽车。

meanings.definition: Land that is completely surrounded by water.
meanings.example: We visited a small island during our summer vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 暑假我们参观了一个小岛。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about a thing, animal, or idea already known.
meanings.example: I found a little turtle, and it was hiding under a leaf.
meanings.example_cn: 我找到一只小乌龟，它躲在一片叶子下面。

meanings.definition: Used when talking about something already mentioned or known.
meanings.example: I finished my project, and it was a lot of work.
meanings.example_cn: 我完成了我的项目，它花了很多功夫。

meanings.definition: Belonging to a thing or animal.
meanings.example: The turtle hid inside its hard shell.
meanings.example_cn: 乌龟躲在它坚硬的壳里。

meanings.definition: Used to show the thing or animal is doing something to or for itself.
meanings.example: The cat cleaned itself after eating lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 猫吃完午饭后给自己清洗了一番。

meanings.definition: A short coat you wear over your clothes to keep warm.
meanings.example: Don’t forget your jacket; it’s cold outside!
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了你的夹克，外面很冷！

meanings.definition: A sweet, thick food made from fruit and sugar, often spread on bread.
meanings.example: I spread sweet strawberry jam on my toast.
meanings.example_cn: 我在吐司上抹了甜甜的草莓果酱。

meanings.definition: To squeeze or pack tightly into a space.
meanings.example: We had to jam all our toys into the toy chest.
meanings.example_cn: 我们只好把所有玩具硬塞进玩具箱。

meanings.definition: To become stuck and not move.
meanings.example: The lid on the jar jammed and wouldn’t open.
meanings.example_cn: 罐子的盖子卡住了，怎么也打不开。

meanings.definition: The first month of the year.
meanings.example: January is the first month of the year.
meanings.example_cn: 一月是一年中的第一个月。

meanings.definition: A glass container.
meanings.example: We put cookies in a big glass jar on the counter.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把饼干放在台面上一个大玻璃罐里。

meanings.definition: Wanting what someone else has and feeling unhappy because of it.
meanings.example: I felt jealous when my friend got a new bike.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友得到一辆新自行车时我很嫉妒。

meanings.definition: Pants made from strong blue denim.
meanings.example: I wore my favourite blue jeans to the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我穿着最喜欢的蓝色牛仔裤去公园。

meanings.definition: A sweet, wobbly dessert made from fruit juice and sugar.
meanings.example: The wobbly red jelly on my plate looked like it might bounce right off!
meanings.example_cn: 我盘子里那摇晃的红色果冻，看起来好像马上就要弹出去了！

meanings.definition: A soft, sea animal with a round body and long, thin parts that float in water.
meanings.example: The jellyfish glowed under the blue lights at the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 水母在水族馆的蓝色灯光下发光。

meanings.definition: Work that people do to earn money.
meanings.example: Dad’s job is to fix cars at the garage.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸的工作是在修车厂修理汽车。

meanings.definition: A task that people do to help others.
meanings.example: The crossing guard’s job is to help kids cross the street safely.
meanings.example_cn: 交通协管员的工作是帮助孩子们安全过马路。

meanings.definition: To connect or link things together so they become one.
meanings.example: You can join the two pieces of paper with glue.
meanings.example_cn: 你可以用胶水把两张纸粘起来。

meanings.definition: To become part of a group or activity.
meanings.example: Would you like to join our game of tag?
meanings.example_cn: 你想加入我们的抓人游戏吗？

meanings.definition: Shared by two or more people.
meanings.example: We had a joint birthday party because our birthdays are close together.
meanings.example_cn: 因为我们的生日离得近，我们办了一场联合生日派对。

meanings.definition: A spot where two things are connected or meet.
meanings.example: My finger joint hurts when I bend it too far.
meanings.example_cn: 我把手指弯得太狠时，指关节就疼。

meanings.definition: Something said or done to make people laugh.
meanings.example: He told a funny joke that made everyone laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话，让大家都笑了。

meanings.definition: To say something funny.
meanings.example: He likes to joke and always makes us laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 他喜欢开玩笑，总能把我们逗笑。

meanings.definition: Great happiness and pleasure.
meanings.example: Winning the soccer game filled our team with joy.
meanings.example_cn: 赢了足球比赛，我们全队都充满喜悦。

meanings.definition: The liquid from fruits and vegetables.
meanings.example: I drank a glass of orange juice with my breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我早餐喝了一杯橙汁。

meanings.definition: To squeeze liquid out of fruit or vegetables.
meanings.example: Let’s juice these oranges to make fresh orange juice.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把这些橙子榨成新鲜橙汁吧。

meanings.definition: Containing a lot of juice and tasting moist.
meanings.example: The watermelon was so juicy that it dripped down my chin.
meanings.example_cn: 西瓜汁太多了，顺着我下巴往下滴。

meanings.definition: The seventh month of the year.
meanings.example: July is usually hot and perfect for swimming.
meanings.example_cn: 七月通常很热，最适合游泳。

meanings.definition: To push yourself off the ground into the air using your legs.
meanings.example: I can jump higher than I could last year.
meanings.example_cn: 我比去年跳得更高了。

meanings.definition: An act of jumping.
meanings.example: She made a long jump over the puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 她纵身一跃，跳过了水坑。

meanings.definition: A sudden increase or rise.
meanings.example: There was a big jump in the number of students this year.
meanings.example_cn: 今年学生人数大幅上升。

meanings.definition: The sixth month of the year.
meanings.example: School ends in June and summer vacation begins.
meanings.example_cn: 学校六月结束，暑假开始。

meanings.definition: Old things that are not useful anymore.
meanings.example: We cleaned the garage and threw away a lot of old junk.
meanings.example_cn: 我们打扫车库，扔掉了好多旧破烂。

meanings.definition: To throw something away because it is not needed.
meanings.example: We decided to junk the broken bike because it couldn’t be fixed.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定把坏了的自行车扔掉，因为修不好了。

meanings.definition: Only or no more than something.
meanings.example: I have just one piece of candy left.
meanings.example_cn: 我只剩一块糖果了。

meanings.definition: Happened a very short time ago, very recently.
meanings.example: I just finished my homework a minute ago.
meanings.example_cn: 我一分钟前刚做完作业。

meanings.definition: Exactly right or at the right time, no more and no less.
meanings.example: You arrived just in time for the movie to start.
meanings.example_cn: 你来得正好，电影刚好开演。

meanings.definition: Very eager and wanting to do something a lot.
meanings.example: She is keen to learn new words every day.
meanings.example_cn: 她热切地想每天学新单词。

meanings.definition: To have and not let go.
meanings.example: I want to keep this shell I found on the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我想把在海滩上捡到的这个贝壳留下来。

meanings.definition: To continue doing something.
meanings.example: Keep practicing the piano every day and you’ll get better.
meanings.example_cn: 每天坚持练钢琴，你就会越来越好。

meanings.definition: To store or hold onto something.
meanings.example: Please keep your shoes in the closet.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的鞋子收进壁橱里。

meanings.definition: A small metal tool used to open locks.
meanings.example: She used a key to unlock the front door.
meanings.example_cn: 她用钥匙打开了前门。

meanings.definition: To enter words or numbers by typing them on a keyboard.
meanings.example: Please key your name into the computer to sign in.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的名字输进电脑里登录。

meanings.definition: Very important or essential.
meanings.example: It’s key to remember your homework so you don’t fall behind in class.
meanings.example_cn: 记住做作业很关键，这样你才不会在课上落后。

meanings.definition: To hit something using your foot.
meanings.example: I can kick the soccer ball into the goal.
meanings.example_cn: 我能把足球踢进球门。

meanings.definition: A blow or hit with the foot
meanings.example: His kick sent the soccer ball into the goal.
meanings.example_cn: 他一脚把足球踢进了球门。

meanings.definition: A child or young person.
meanings.example: Every kid in class brought a snack for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 班里每个孩子都带了零食来参加派对。

meanings.definition: To say something is not true as a joke.
meanings.example: I was just kidding when I said there was a monster under the bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我说床底下有怪物，我只是在开玩笑。

meanings.definition: To make something or someone die.
meanings.example: The bug spray will kill any ants that come inside.
meanings.example_cn: 杀虫剂会杀死爬进来的蚂蚁。

meanings.definition: An animal that has been hunted and caught for food.
meanings.example: After a long chase, the wolf dragged its kill back to the pack.
meanings.example_cn: 经过长时间追逐，这只狼把捕获的猎物拖回狼群。

meanings.definition: A type or sort of thing in a group.
meanings.example: My favourite kind of fruit is watermelon.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的水果是西瓜。

meanings.definition: Friendly, caring, and nice to others.
meanings.example: It’s kind to share your toys with others.
meanings.example_cn: 和别人分享玩具是善良的表现。

meanings.definition: A man who is the ruler of a country.
meanings.example: The king wore a golden crown and a red robe.
meanings.example_cn: 国王戴着金色的王冠，穿着红色的长袍。

meanings.definition: To touch someone with your lips to show love or affection.
meanings.example: Dad kissed me on the forehead before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 睡觉前，爸爸在我额头上亲了一下。

meanings.definition: Touching someone with your lips to show love or care.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a goodnight kiss before I went to sleep.
meanings.example_cn: 我睡觉前，妈妈给了我一个晚安吻。

meanings.definition: A light frame covered with paper or cloth that you fly in the wind on a string.
meanings.example: It was a windy day, perfect for flying a bright red kite.
meanings.example_cn: 今天风很大，正好放一只鲜红色的风筝。

meanings.definition: A small fuzzy brown fruit.
meanings.example: I like to eat kiwi because it’s sweet and a little sour.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢吃猕猴桃，因为它甜甜的，带一点酸。

meanings.definition: The joint in the middle of your leg that lets you bend it.
meanings.example: My knee got scraped when I slid on the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我在操场上滑倒时擦破了膝盖。

meanings.definition: To go down and rest on your knees.
meanings.example: We kneel in the garden to plant seeds in the dirt.
meanings.example_cn: 我们跪在花园里，把种子种进土里。

meanings.definition: A tool with a sharp edge used for cutting things.
meanings.example: Please be careful when you use a knife to cut your food.
meanings.example_cn: 用刀切食物时要小心。

meanings.definition: To hit a surface to make a noise.
meanings.example: Please knock on the door before coming in.
meanings.example_cn: 进来之前请先敲门。

meanings.definition: A sound or action made by hitting something, usually a door.
meanings.example: I heard a knock at the door while I was doing my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我做作业时听到有人敲门。

meanings.definition: A way of tying rope or string.
meanings.example: The scout leader showed us how to make a strong knot with the rope so our tent wouldn’t blow away.
meanings.example_cn: 童子军队长教我们怎样用绳子打一个牢固的绳结，这样帐篷就不会被风吹走。

meanings.definition: To tie a piece of string, rope, or ribbon so it cannot come undone easily.
meanings.example: Let me knot your shoelaces so they don’t come undone.
meanings.example_cn: 我来帮你把鞋带系紧，这样就不会松了。

meanings.definition: A tangled or tied part in rope, string, or hair.
meanings.example: There was a tight knot in my shoelace that I couldn’t untie.
meanings.example_cn: 我的鞋带缠了一个紧紧的结，解不开。

meanings.definition: To understand something.
meanings.example: I know how to tie my shoes by myself.
meanings.example_cn: 我知道怎么自己系鞋带。

meanings.definition: To be familiar with something or someone.
meanings.example: Do you know this fun game we're playing?
meanings.example_cn: 你知道我们在玩的这个游戏吗？

meanings.definition: Recognised by many people.
meanings.definition_cn: 知名的；被许多人认识的
meanings.example: The old tree is known for its big branches.
meanings.example_cn: 那棵老树以它粗大的枝干而闻名。

meanings.definition: Something that people understand or have heard about.
meanings.definition_cn: 为人们所了解或听说的
meanings.example: Polar bears are known for living in cold, snowy places.
meanings.example_cn: 北极熊以生活在寒冷多雪的地方而闻名。

meanings.definition: A special room where scientists do experiments and tests.
meanings.example: We did a cool science experiment in the lab.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在实验室里做了一个很酷的科学实验。

meanings.definition: A string for tying shoes or clothes.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to tie the lace on your shoes before running.
meanings.example_cn: 跑步前别忘了系好鞋带。

meanings.definition: To tie or fasten with shoelaces or strings.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to lace your shoes before you run outside.
meanings.example_cn: 跑出去之前别忘了系好鞋带。

meanings.definition: A pretty and delicate fabric with lots of holes and patterns.
meanings.example: The edge of the dress was decorated with pretty white lace.
meanings.example_cn: 裙子的边上装饰着漂亮的白色蕾丝。

meanings.definition: A boy or young man.
meanings.example: The young lad wore a red cap and ran through the field.
meanings.example_cn: 那个年轻小伙子戴着红帽子，在田野里跑。

meanings.definition: A woman, especially one who is polite or of high status.
meanings.example: A kind lady helped me find my lost puppy.
meanings.example_cn: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了走失的小狗。

meanings.definition: A small, round, red insect with black spots on its back.
meanings.example: A tiny ladybug landed on my finger.
meanings.example_cn: 一只小瓢虫落在我的手指上。

meanings.definition: A large area of water surrounded by land.
meanings.example: The lake was calm and full of ducks.
meanings.example_cn: 湖面平静，满是鸭子。

meanings.definition: A young sheep.
meanings.example: The lamb followed its mother around the field.
meanings.example_cn: 小羊跟着妈妈在田野里走。
