meanings.example_cn: 我用蓝色钢笔写了一封感谢信。

meanings.definition: To write or compose something.
meanings.example: She penned a thank-you note to her teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 她给老师写了一封感谢信。

meanings.definition: A tool with a thin stick of graphite used for writing or drawing.
meanings.example: Please use a pencil to complete your maths worksheet.
meanings.example_cn: 请用铅笔完成你的数学作业单。

meanings.definition: A spice or seasoning that adds flavour to food.
meanings.example: Mom sprinkled some white pepper on the soup to give it more flavour.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈往汤里撒了一些白胡椒，让汤更有味道。

meanings.definition: To put pepper on food.
meanings.example: I like to pepper my eggs before eating them.
meanings.example_cn: 吃鸡蛋之前我喜欢撒上胡椒粉。

meanings.definition: To hit or spray repeatedly with small objects.
meanings.example: The kids peppered the snowman with tiny snowballs.
meanings.example_cn: 孩子们用小雪球不停地砸雪人。

meanings.definition: Without any mistakes or faults.
meanings.example: Your drawing is perfect—there’s not a single mistake!
meanings.example_cn: 你的画太完美了——一个错都没有！

meanings.definition: To do or carry out something.
meanings.example: The robot can perform many tasks all by itself.
meanings.example_cn: 这个机器人可以独立完成许多任务。

meanings.definition: To act, sing, or play in front of people.
meanings.example: Our class will perform a song at the school concert.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班会在学校音乐会上表演一首歌。

meanings.definition: A liquid that smells nice and is worn on the body.
meanings.example: Mom sprayed a little perfume on her wrist before leaving the house.
meanings.example_cn: 出门前妈妈在手腕上喷了一点香水。

meanings.definition: To make something smell sweet by putting perfume on it.
meanings.example: She likes to perfume her letters so they smell nice when you open them.
meanings.example_cn: 她喜欢在信上喷香水，这样你打开的时候会闻到香味。

meanings.definition: Suggests something is possible but not certain.
meanings.example: Perhaps we can go to the park after it stops raining.
meanings.example_cn: 也许雨停之后我们可以去公园。

meanings.definition: A human being.
meanings.example: A friendly person helped me carry my books.
meanings.example_cn: 一位友善的人帮我搬书。

meanings.definition: An animal kept for fun or companionship.
meanings.example: My pet dog loves to play fetch in the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我的宠物狗喜欢在院子里玩抛接球。

meanings.definition: To gently stroke or touch an animal.
meanings.example: Can I pet your puppy? He looks so soft!
meanings.example_cn: 我能摸摸你的小狗吗？它看起来好软！

meanings.definition: One of the colourful leaf parts of a flower.
meanings.example: Each petal on the rose was soft and bright pink.
meanings.example_cn: 玫瑰的每一片花瓣都软软的，是鲜艳的粉色。

meanings.definition: A shop where you can buy medicine and health products.
meanings.example: We stopped at the pharmacy to pick up some cough syrup.
meanings.example_cn: 我们停在药店买了点止咳糖浆。

meanings.definition: A device for talking to people far away.
meanings.example: I called my grandma on the phone to tell her about my day.
meanings.example_cn: 我给奶奶打电话，告诉她我今天过得怎么样。

meanings.definition: To call and talk to someone using a telephone.
meanings.example: I will phone my friend to invite her to my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我要给朋友打电话，邀请她来参加我的生日聚会。

meanings.definition: A picture taken with a camera.
meanings.example: Dad hung a photograph of our family on the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸把我们的全家福照片挂在墙上。

meanings.definition: To take a photograph of someone or something
meanings.example: I want to photograph my dog playing in the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我想拍下小狗在院子里玩耍的样子。

meanings.definition: A large musical instrument with black and white keys.
meanings.example: My sister plays songs on the piano every evening.
meanings.example_cn: 我姐姐每天晚上都在钢琴上弹曲子。

meanings.definition: To choose or select something.
meanings.example: You can pick your favourite colour for the project.
meanings.example_cn: 做这个小作品时你可以挑自己最喜欢的颜色。

meanings.definition: A choice or something you select.
meanings.example: You get the first pick of the board games tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 今晚桌游你可以第一个挑。

meanings.definition: To pull or pluck something, like a flower or fruit, off a plant.
meanings.example: She likes to pick fresh apples from the tree in her backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 她喜欢从自家后院的树上摘新鲜苹果。

meanings.definition: A drawing, painting, or photograph that shows what something looks like.
meanings.example: There’s a picture of a castle hanging on my wall.
meanings.example_cn: 我房间墙上挂着一幅城堡的画。

meanings.definition: To imagine or visualise something in your mind
meanings.example: Close your eyes and picture a beautiful rainbow in the sky.
meanings.example_cn: 闭上眼睛，想象天空中有一道美丽的彩虹。

meanings.definition: A baked dish with a crust and filling, often sweet or savoury.
meanings.example: Grandma made a delicious apple pie for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶做了一个美味的苹果派当甜点。

meanings.definition: A part or portion of something.
meanings.example: Can I have a piece of your chocolate bar?
meanings.example_cn: 我能吃一块你的巧克力吗？

meanings.definition: A farm animal with a snout that often likes to roll in mud.
meanings.example: The pig rolled in the mud to stay cool on a sunny day.
meanings.example_cn: 阳光明媚的日子，猪在泥里打滚来保持凉爽。

meanings.definition: A stack or heap of things.
meanings.example: There was a pile of books stacked on my desk.
meanings.example_cn: 我的桌子上摞着一堆书。

meanings.definition: To stack or put things in a big heap.
meanings.example: Let’s pile all the dirty clothes into the laundry basket.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把所有脏衣服都堆进洗衣篮里吧。

meanings.definition: A person who flies an airplane.
meanings.example: The pilot greeted us before the plane took off.
meanings.example_cn: 飞机起飞前飞行员向我们打招呼。

meanings.definition: To fly or guide an airplane, boat, or other vehicle.
meanings.example: My uncle will pilot the plane on our trip to Florida.
meanings.example_cn: 我叔叔会驾驶我们去佛罗里达旅行的飞机。

meanings.definition: A small metal stick with a sharp point for fastening things.
meanings.example: Use a pin to hold the paper together.
meanings.example_cn: 用一根大头针把纸别在一起。

meanings.definition: To attach or fasten something using a pin.
meanings.example: Please pin your name tag to your shirt so everyone knows your name.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的姓名牌别在衬衫上，这样大家就知道你的名字了。

meanings.definition: A tree with long needles that stays green all year.
meanings.example: We decorated the pine tree with lights for the holidays.
meanings.example_cn: 过节时我们用彩灯装饰了松树。

meanings.definition: A light red colour, like the colour of some flowers.
meanings.example: She painted her room a soft pink colour.
meanings.example_cn: 她把房间刷成了柔和的粉色。

meanings.definition: A tube for carrying liquid or gas.
meanings.example: Water flows through the pipe under the sink.
meanings.example_cn: 水从水槽下面的管子里流过。

meanings.definition: To carry something, like water or gas, through a tube.
meanings.example: The workers will pipe water into the new swimming pool.
meanings.example_cn: 工人会用水管把水引到新游泳池里。

meanings.definition: How high or low a sound is.
meanings.example: The singer’s voice went up to a high pitch.
meanings.example_cn: 歌手的声音升高到了很高的音调。

meanings.definition: To set up a tent.
meanings.example: Let’s pitch the tent in a flat, grassy spot.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在一块平坦的草地上搭帐篷吧。

meanings.definition: To throw something.
meanings.example: The baseball player pitched the ball quickly to the catcher.
meanings.example_cn: 棒球手快速地把球投给捕手。

meanings.definition: Feeling sorry for someone else's trouble or sadness.
meanings.example: I felt pity for the lost puppy and wanted to help.
meanings.example_cn: 我同情那只走失的小狗，想帮帮它。

meanings.definition: To feel sorry for someone.
meanings.example: I pity the lost kitten and hope someone finds her.
meanings.example_cn: 我可怜那只走失的小猫，希望有人能找到它。

meanings.definition: A round, flat food from Italy with cheese, sauce, and toppings.
meanings.example: We ordered a cheesy pizza with extra pepperoni for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 我们点了带额外意大利辣香肠的芝士披萨当晚餐。

meanings.definition: A space, spot, or area where something is or happens.
meanings.example: This playground is my favourite place to have fun.
meanings.example_cn: 这个操场是我最喜欢玩的地方。

meanings.definition: To put something in a particular spot or position.
meanings.example: Please place your backpack on the shelf when you come in.
meanings.example_cn: 请进来的时候把你的背包放到架子上。

meanings.definition: Simple, not fancy or decorated.
meanings.example: She wore a plain white shirt with no designs on it.
meanings.example_cn: 她穿着一件没有图案的素白衬衫。

meanings.definition: A large, flat area of land with few trees.
meanings.example: Herds of animals live and graze on the grassy plain.
meanings.example_cn: 成群的动物在长满青草的平原上生活、吃草。

meanings.definition: An idea for what you want to do and how you will do it.
meanings.example: Our plan is to visit the zoo this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的计划是这个周末去动物园。

meanings.definition: To think about and decide what you are going to do before you do it.
meanings.example: We plan to have a picnic in the park this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我们计划这周末去公园野餐。

meanings.definition: A short word for “aeroplane.”
meanings.example: The plane flew high above the clouds.
meanings.example_cn: 飞机飞得很高，越过了云层。

meanings.definition: A flat surface.
meanings.example: In maths class, we drew shapes on a plane to learn about geometry.
meanings.example_cn: 数学课上，我们在平面上画图形来学习几何。

meanings.definition: A living thing that grows in the ground, like a flower or tree.
meanings.example: We watered the plant on the windowsill every day.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每天给窗台上的植物浇水。

meanings.definition: To put a seed into the ground so it will grow.
meanings.example: Let’s plant some sunflower seeds in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们在花园里种一些向日葵种子。

meanings.definition: A strip of material used to cover a cut.
meanings.example: The nurse put a plaster on my scraped knee.
meanings.example_cn: 护士在我擦破的膝盖上贴了创可贴。

meanings.definition: A soft material for walls.
meanings.example: The workers covered the cracks in the wall with fresh plaster to make it smooth again.
meanings.example_cn: 工人们用新灰泥补上墙上的裂缝，让它重新变得平整。

meanings.definition: To cover a wall with plaster.
meanings.example: The workers will plaster the walls before painting them.
meanings.example_cn: 工人会先给墙面抹灰泥，再上油漆。

meanings.definition: A round, flat dish you put food on.
meanings.example: There is a slice of pizza left on the plate.
meanings.example_cn: 盘子里还剩一块披萨。

meanings.definition: To arrange food on a plate for serving.
meanings.example: Mom plated the spaghetti for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈把意大利面装盘端上晚餐。

meanings.definition: To do something fun, like a game.
meanings.example: Let’s play a board game after dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭后我们玩个棋盘游戏吧。

meanings.definition: To make music by using an instrument.
meanings.example: He can play the piano really well.
meanings.example_cn: 他钢琴弹得非常好。

meanings.definition: A story acted out on a stage for others to watch.
meanings.example: Our class put on a play for the school.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班给全校演了一出戏。

meanings.definition: Someone who takes part in a game or sport.
meanings.example: Each player wore a different coloured jersey in the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛中每位球员都穿着不同颜色的球衣。

meanings.definition: To ask politely for something.
meanings.example: Please close the door gently when you leave the room.
meanings.example_cn: 离开房间时请轻轻关门。

meanings.definition: To make someone happy.
meanings.example: I wanted to please my grandma, so I cleaned my room without being asked.
meanings.example_cn: 我想让奶奶高兴，所以没被要求就自己打扫了房间。

meanings.definition: Something used to connect to power.
meanings.example: The computer wouldn’t turn on because its plug wasn’t fully pushed into the socket.
meanings.example_cn: 电脑开不了机，因为插头没有完全插进插座里。

meanings.definition: To connect things together.
meanings.example: Please plug your phone into the charger to fill the battery.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的手机插到充电器上，把电池充满。

meanings.definition: A small object used to block a hole so that liquid cannot flow through.
meanings.example: Dad put the plug in the sink so the water wouldn’t drain out.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸把塞子堵在水槽里，这样水就不会流走了。

meanings.definition: A small, round fruit with smooth skin and a stone in the middle.
meanings.example: I picked a juicy plum from the tree in our yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我从院子里的树上摘了一颗多汁的李子。

meanings.definition: Added to.
meanings.example: You get a cookie plus a glass of milk for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 甜点你会得到一块饼干，再加一杯牛奶。

meanings.definition: The sharp end of something.
meanings.example: Be careful with the point of that pencil.
meanings.example_cn: 小心那支铅笔的笔尖。

meanings.definition: An idea, fact, or reason that helps explain something.
meanings.example: That’s a good point you made about recycling.
meanings.example_cn: 你关于回收利用提出的观点很好。

meanings.definition: To show something by stretching out your finger.
meanings.example: Please point to the answer on the board.
meanings.example_cn: 请指向黑板上的答案。

meanings.definition: Something that can make you very sick or cause death.
meanings.example: Never touch a bottle marked “poison” because it can hurt you.
meanings.example_cn: 千万不要碰标着“毒药”的瓶子，因为它会伤害你。

meanings.definition: To harm someone or something by giving them something dangerous to eat or drink.
meanings.example: Never eat strange berries because they could poison you.
meanings.example_cn: 千万不要吃陌生的浆果，它们可能有毒。

meanings.definition: Related to the North or South Pole.
meanings.example: Polar bears live in the polar regions where it is very cold and snowy.
meanings.example_cn: 北极熊住在又冷又多雪的极地地区。

meanings.definition: A long, straight stick or rod.
meanings.example: We raised the flag up the pole during the morning assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 晨会时我们把旗子升到旗杆上。

meanings.definition: Having good manners and being respectful to others.
meanings.example: It is polite to say “thank you” when someone helps you.
meanings.example_cn: 别人帮助你时说“谢谢”是有礼貌的表现。

meanings.definition: A survey where people give their opinions or votes.
meanings.example: Our class took a poll to see which game everyone wanted to play.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班做了一个投票，看大家想玩哪个游戏。

meanings.definition: To ask people questions to find out what they think.
meanings.example: The teacher will poll the class to see which field trip we want.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会在班里做个调查，看我们想去哪里实地考察。

meanings.definition: A small area of still water, smaller than a lake.
meanings.example: We saw frogs and lily pads in the quiet pond.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在安静的池塘里看到了青蛙和睡莲叶。

meanings.definition: A small horse.
meanings.example: I rode a gentle pony at the petting zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 我在小动物园骑了一匹温顺的小马。

meanings.definition: A small area of water where people can swim.
meanings.example: The pool was warm and perfect for swimming on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 炎热的天气里，游泳池水暖暖的，非常适合游泳。

meanings.definition: A small, natural lake.
meanings.example: The frogs were hopping around a quiet pool in the forest after the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 雨后，青蛙们在森林里一个安静的池塘周围蹦跳。

meanings.definition: To combine money, resources, or ideas for everyone to share.
meanings.example: We decided to pool our money to buy a pizza for lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定把钱凑在一起，买一个披萨当午饭。

meanings.definition: Not having much money.
meanings.example: The poor family worked hard to buy enough food for everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 这个贫困的家庭努力劳作，为所有人买到足够的食物。

meanings.definition: Not very good at something.
meanings.example: I am poor at drawing, but I still enjoy making pictures.
meanings.example_cn: 我画画很不行，但我还是喜欢画画。

meanings.definition: Weak, bad, or disappointing, so you might feel sorry for it.
meanings.example: The poor puppy looked sad and cold in the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 那只可怜的小狗在雨中看上去又难过又冷。

meanings.definition: Music that is popular and easy to listen to.
meanings.example: My favourite pop song always makes me want to dance.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的流行歌总让我想跳舞。

meanings.definition: To burst open with a quick, small sound.
meanings.example: Let’s pop the balloons after the party is over.
meanings.example_cn: 聚会结束后我们把气球捏爆吧。

meanings.definition: A tiny hole in the skin or surface of something.
meanings.example: Sweat comes out of the tiny pores on your skin when you are hot.
meanings.example_cn: 你热的时候，汗水从皮肤上的小毛孔里冒出来。

meanings.definition: Meat that comes from a pig.
meanings.example: We had pork chops and mashed potatoes for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 我们晚饭吃了猪排和土豆泥。

meanings.definition: A place by the water where ships load and unload goods.
meanings.example: The ship arrived at the busy port with lots of cargo.
meanings.example_cn: 船抵达了繁忙的港口，载着很多货物。

meanings.definition: A long stick set upright.
meanings.example: We hung the sign on a wooden post by the road.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把标志牌挂在路边的一根木桩上。

meanings.definition: To stick or put up a notice in a public place for others to see.
meanings.example: I will post my drawing on the bulletin board for everyone to see.
meanings.example_cn: 我会把我的画贴在布告栏上让大家看。

meanings.definition: To send something by mail.
meanings.example: I will post this letter to my friend tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我明天把这封信寄给我的朋友。

meanings.definition: A container used for cooking or planting.
meanings.example: We made soup in a big pot for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们用一个大锅做了汤。

meanings.definition: A round, brown vegetable that grows underground.
meanings.example: We made crispy potato chips together at home.
meanings.example_cn: 我们一起在家做了脆脆的薯片。

meanings.definition: A unit of weight.
meanings.example: The puppy weighed just one pound when it was born.
meanings.example_cn: 这只小狗刚出生时只有一磅重。

meanings.definition: To hit something very hard.
meanings.example: We had to pound the dough with our fists to make pizza crust.
meanings.example_cn: 我们得用拳头捶面团，来做披萨饼底。

meanings.definition: To make liquid flow out.
meanings.example: Please pour the juice into my cup.
meanings.example_cn: 请把果汁倒进我的杯子里。

meanings.definition: To rain very heavily, when lots of rain falls quickly and it feels like buckets of water are coming down from the sky.
meanings.example: We had to stay inside because it was pouring outside.
meanings.example_cn: 外面下着倾盆大雨，我们只好待在屋里。

meanings.definition: The ability or strength to do something.
meanings.example: Superheroes use their power to help people in trouble.
meanings.example_cn: 超级英雄运用他们的力量帮助陷入困境的人们。

meanings.definition: The electricity that makes things like lights, TVs, and computers work.
meanings.example: The storm knocked out the power in our neighbourhood.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨让我们的街区停了电。

meanings.definition: To supply energy to something.
meanings.example: The wind turbines power the lights in our school.
meanings.example_cn: 风力涡轮机为学校的灯供电。

meanings.definition: Doing something again and again to get better.
meanings.example: You need lots of practice to play the piano well.
meanings.example_cn: 想把钢琴弹好，你需要大量练习。

meanings.definition: A usual or regular way of doing something.
meanings.example: Brushing your teeth every night is a good practice to keep them healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 每天晚上刷牙是保持牙齿健康的好习惯。

meanings.definition: To do something again and again so you can get better at it.
meanings.example: I practise playing the piano every day so I can get better at my songs.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天都练弹钢琴，这样我的曲子就能弹得更好。

meanings.definition: A small shellfish like a shrimp.
meanings.example: We saw a prawn swimming in the ocean at the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在水族馆看到一只对虾在海里游。

meanings.definition: To make something or someone ready.
meanings.example: Let’s prepare our backpacks for school tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我们为明天上学把书包收拾好。

meanings.definition: Being in a place and not absent.
meanings.example: All the students were present in class for the field trip today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天所有学生都到校集合，准备参加实地考察。

meanings.definition: A gift, something that you give to someone, usually to celebrate a special occasion or to show you care.
meanings.example: I gave my friend a birthday present wrapped in shiny paper.
meanings.example_cn: 我送给朋友一份用闪亮纸包着的生日礼物。

meanings.definition: To show, display, or explain something to others.
meanings.example: I will present my science project to the class.
meanings.example_cn: 我会向全班展示我的科学项目。

meanings.definition: A feeling of urgency or stress.
meanings.example: I felt a lot of pressure before my piano recital.
meanings.example_cn: 钢琴独奏会前我感到很大的压力。

meanings.definition: To try to make someone do something by asking or urging them a lot.
meanings.example: Don’t pressure your friend to play if she doesn’t want to.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你的朋友不想玩，就不要逼她。

meanings.definition: A strong push or force on something.
meanings.example: The pressure in the balloon made it pop when I squeezed it.
meanings.example_cn: 我一捏，气球里的压力就让它爆了。

meanings.definition: To act like something is true when it is not.
meanings.example: We pretend to be pirates when we play in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在后院玩的时候假装自己是海盗。

meanings.definition: The act of making-believe.
meanings.example: Playing pretend is fun when we act like pirates or astronauts.
meanings.example_cn: 我们扮演海盗或宇航员的时候，过家家很好玩。

meanings.definition: To stop something from happening.
meanings.example: Wearing a helmet will help prevent injuries when you ride your bike.
meanings.example_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔能防止受伤。

meanings.definition: How much something costs.
meanings.example: What is the price of this toy car?
meanings.example_cn: 这辆玩具车多少钱？

meanings.definition: To decide how much something will cost.
meanings.example: The store manager will price all the new toys before putting them on the shelves.
meanings.example_cn: 商店经理会给所有新玩具定价，然后再摆上货架。

meanings.definition: The son of a king or queen.
meanings.example: The prince learned how to ride a horse.
meanings.example_cn: 王子学会了骑马。

meanings.definition: The daughter of a king or queen.
meanings.example: The princess wore sparkling shoes to the ball.
meanings.example_cn: 公主穿着闪亮的鞋子去参加舞会。

meanings.definition: To put words, pictures, or designs on paper with ink or a printer.
meanings.example: I like to print my drawings with colourful markers.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢用彩色马克笔把我的画印出来。

meanings.definition: A picture or photo made by printing.
meanings.example: I made a colourful print of my hand with paint in art class.
meanings.example_cn: 美术课上我用颜料印了一个彩色的手掌印。

meanings.definition: Something you win or are given for doing well.
meanings.example: I won a prize for finishing first in the race.
meanings.example_cn: 我因为赛跑得了第一名而获奖。

meanings.definition: To value or think something is very important and special.
meanings.example: Grandma prizes the family photos because they remind her of happy times.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶很珍视这些家庭照片，因为照片让她想起快乐的时光。

meanings.definition: Something that is difficult or needs to be solved.
meanings.example: We worked together to solve the maths problem.
meanings.example_cn: 我们一起努力解这道数学题。

meanings.definition: A planned set of things to do.
meanings.example: The school started a recycling program for students.
meanings.example_cn: 学校为学生们启动了一个回收项目。

meanings.definition: A computer application.
meanings.example: I used a drawing program on my computer to make a picture.
meanings.example_cn: 我在电脑上用绘图软件画画。

meanings.definition: To schedule or plan something.
meanings.example: The teacher will program the computer to help us learn math.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会给电脑编程，帮助我们学数学。

meanings.definition: A special task or activity that takes time and planning.
meanings.example: Our science project was about how plants grow.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的科学项目是关于植物如何生长的。

meanings.definition: To estimate or guess what will happen in the future based on information you have now.
meanings.example: The weather experts project that it will be sunny all week.
meanings.example_cn: 气象专家预测整周都会是晴天。

meanings.definition: To show something on a screen.
meanings.example: They will project the movie onto a big screen in the gym.
meanings.example_cn: 他们会把电影投放到体育馆的大屏幕上。

meanings.definition: To say you will definitely do something.
meanings.example: I promise to feed the goldfish every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我保证每天早上喂金鱼。

meanings.definition: Words you say to show you really mean you will do something.
meanings.example: I made a promise to my friend that I would keep her secret.
meanings.example_cn: 我向朋友许下承诺，会保守她的秘密。

meanings.definition: Facts or evidence that show something is true.
meanings.example: The muddy paw prints were proof that the dog had been inside.
meanings.example_cn: 泥泞的爪印是狗进屋过的证据。

meanings.definition: Feeling happy because you or someone you know did something well.
meanings.example: I felt proud when I finished the puzzle by myself.
meanings.example_cn: 我一个人完成拼图时感到很自豪。

meanings.definition: Open for everyone to use or see, not private.
meanings.example: The public park is open for everyone to enjoy.
meanings.example_cn: 这个公共公园对所有人开放，供大家享受。

meanings.definition: A small burst of air, smoke, or breath.
meanings.example: The train let out a big puff of smoke as it started moving.
meanings.example_cn: 火车开动时冒出一大股烟。

meanings.definition: To blow out small bursts of air or smoke.
meanings.example: Watch the dragon puff smoke from his nose in the cartoon.
meanings.example_cn: 看动画片里龙从鼻子里喷烟。

meanings.definition: To draw or move something towards you.
meanings.example: Pull the wagon up the hill with me.
meanings.example_cn: 和我一起把小车拉上山坡。

meanings.definition: The act of pulling something.
meanings.example: With a strong pull, the door finally opened.
meanings.example_cn: 用力一拉，门终于打开了。

meanings.definition: To attract or draw in a person or people, making them interested or wanting to come closer.
meanings.example: The new playground has a big pull for kids in the neighbourhood because it is so much fun.
meanings.example_cn: 新游乐场对附近的孩子有巨大的吸引力，因为它太好玩了。

meanings.definition: To hit something with your fist.
meanings.example: Tom accidentally punched the ball instead of catching it during the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛时汤姆不小心一拳打到球，没能接住它。

meanings.definition: When you hit something or someone with your hand closed into a fist.
meanings.example: The boxer threw a powerful punch during the match.
meanings.example_cn: 拳击手在比赛中打出一记有力的重拳。

meanings.definition: To make someone suffer because they did something wrong.
meanings.example: If you break the rules, the teacher might punish you by taking away recess.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你违反规则，老师可能会取消你的课间休息来惩罚你。

meanings.definition: A student.
meanings.example: The teacher praised the pupil for always working hard and paying attention in class.
meanings.example_cn: 老师表扬这名学生，因为他学习认真，上课专心听讲。

meanings.definition: The black, round part in the centre of your eye.
meanings.example: The doctor checked my pupil with a small flashlight.
meanings.example_cn: 医生用一个小手电筒检查了我的瞳孔。

meanings.definition: A baby dog.
meanings.example: Our new puppy likes to chew on everything!
meanings.example_cn: 我们的新小狗喜欢什么都啃！

meanings.definition: A colour made by mixing red and blue.
meanings.example: My favourite dress is purple with white polka dots.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的连衣裙是紫色的，带白色波点。

meanings.definition: To move something away from you by pressing on it.
meanings.example: Push the door gently so it doesn’t slam.
meanings.example_cn: 轻轻推门，别让它砰地关上。

meanings.definition: When you use your hands or body to move something or someone away from you.
meanings.example: With a gentle push, Mia sent the swing higher into the air.
meanings.example_cn: 米娅轻轻一推，把秋千推得飞向更高的空中。

meanings.definition: To move something to a place.
meanings.example: Please put your backpack by the door.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的书包放在门边。

meanings.definition: To say or explain something in a certain way.
meanings.example: He didn’t know how to put his excitement into words.
meanings.example_cn: 他不知道该怎么用语言表达自己激动的心情。

meanings.definition: To cause someone to be in a situation.
meanings.example: The funny movie put everyone in a good mood.
meanings.example_cn: 这部有趣的电影让大家心情都很好。

meanings.definition: A game or problem that makes you think.
meanings.example: The jigsaw puzzle had a thousand tiny pieces.
meanings.example_cn: 这个拼图有一千个小小的碎片。

meanings.definition: To confuse someone or make them unsure about something.
meanings.example: The tricky riddle puzzled everyone in the class.
meanings.example_cn: 这个难解的谜语把班上所有人都难住了。

meanings.definition: One of four equal parts of something.
meanings.example: I ate a quarter of the pizza and saved the rest for later.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了四分之一块披萨，剩下的留着晚点吃。

meanings.definition: A district or area that is part of a town.
meanings.example: We visited the old French quarter where the streets are made of bricks.
meanings.example_cn: 我们参观了老法国区，那里的街道由砖铺成。

meanings.definition: To cut or divide something into four equal pieces.
meanings.example: We will quarter the apple so everyone gets a piece.
meanings.example_cn: 我们会把苹果切成四份，这样每人都能分到一块。

meanings.definition: A woman who rules a country or is married to a king.
meanings.example: The queen waved to everyone from her balcony.
meanings.example_cn: 女王从阳台上向大家挥手。

meanings.definition: A sentence you ask to get information.
meanings.example: My teacher asked a tricky question about the story we just read.
meanings.example_cn: 老师就我们刚读的故事问了一个刁钻的问题。

meanings.definition: To ask someone things in order to get answers or information.
meanings.example: The detective will question everyone who was at the scene.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探会盘问每一个在现场的人。

meanings.definition: A line of people or vehicles waiting for their turn.
meanings.example: We stood in a long queue waiting to buy tickets for the movie.
meanings.example_cn: 我们排了很长的队等着买电影票。

meanings.definition: To wait in line for your turn.
meanings.example: We must queue outside the classroom and wait for the teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 我们必须在教室外面排队等老师。

meanings.definition: Moving fast or happening in a short time.
meanings.example: The rabbit was so quick, it dashed across the yard in seconds.
meanings.example_cn: 兔子太快了，几秒钟就窜过了院子。

meanings.definition: Able to understand or learn things fast.
meanings.example: She is quick to solve math problems in class.
meanings.example_cn: 她在课堂上解数学题很快。

meanings.definition: Not making much noise and being peaceful or silent.
meanings.example: The library is a quiet place to read books.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆是安静读书的地方。

meanings.definition: To make things calm and silent or to become silent.
meanings.example: The teacher asked us to quiet down before starting the lesson.
meanings.example_cn: 老师让我们在上课前安静下来。

meanings.definition: To a certain or full degree.
meanings.example: I was quite sure that I had left my backpack in the classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 我很确定我把背包落在了教室里。

meanings.definition: A short test of knowledge, sometimes in a competition.
meanings.example: We had a fun quiz on animal facts during science class.
meanings.example_cn: 科学课上我们做了一次有趣的动物知识小测验。

meanings.definition: To ask questions or test someone’s knowledge.
meanings.example: The teacher will quiz us about the new spelling words tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 老师明天会考我们新的拼写单词。

meanings.definition: A small, furry animal with long ears that lives in a burrow.
meanings.example: The rabbit hopped quickly through the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 兔子在花园里快速蹦跳。

meanings.definition: A contest to see who is the fastest.
meanings.example: I ran my fastest in the school race and came in second place.
meanings.example_cn: 我在学校赛跑中拼尽全力，得了第二名。

meanings.definition: One of the main groups people are divided into by things like skin colour and background.
meanings.example: People from every race and country came together for the big celebration.
meanings.example_cn: 来自各个种族和国家的人们聚在一起参加盛大的庆典。

meanings.definition: To move very quickly, especially to win.
meanings.example: The kids race to see who can reach the playground first.
meanings.example_cn: 孩子们比赛，看谁能先到操场。

meanings.definition: A bar used as a barrier or support.
meanings.example: Hold onto the rail so you don’t slip on the stairs.
meanings.example_cn: 扶着栏杆，这样你在楼梯上就不会滑倒。

meanings.definition: Water that falls from the clouds in drops.
meanings.example: We jumped in puddles after the rain stopped.
meanings.example_cn: 雨停后我们在水坑里跳来跳去。

meanings.definition: To fall from the clouds as drops of water.
meanings.example: If it rains tomorrow, we'll play board games inside.
meanings.example_cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就在室内玩棋盘游戏。

meanings.definition: Having a lot of rain.
meanings.example: It was a rainy day, so we played games inside.
meanings.example_cn: 这是个下雨天，所以我们在屋里玩游戏。

meanings.definition: A sloped surface that joins two levels.
meanings.example: The ramp helps people in wheelchairs get into the building.
meanings.example_cn: 坡道帮助坐轮椅的人进入大楼。

meanings.definition: A position in a group or organization.
meanings.example: He got the highest rank in his karate class.
meanings.example_cn: 他在空手道班里拿到了最高等级。

meanings.definition: To put things or people in order from best to worst, or by level.
meanings.example: Let’s rank the flavours of ice cream from best to least favourite.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把冰淇淋口味从最喜欢到最不喜欢排个序吧。

meanings.definition: Doing things without thinking carefully
meanings.example: It was rash to run outside without your jacket in the cold.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷时没穿外套就跑出去是很鲁莽的。

meanings.definition: Red spots on your skin, usually from an allergy or illness.
meanings.example: She got a rash on her arm after playing in the grass.
meanings.example_cn: 在草地上玩过后，她胳膊上起了皮疹。

meanings.definition: A small, soft, red fruit made up of many tiny parts.
meanings.example: She added raspberry jam to her toast.
meanings.example_cn: 她在吐司上加了木莓果酱。

meanings.definition: To some degree.
meanings.example: The soup is rather hot, so let it cool before eating.
meanings.example_cn: 汤有点烫，等它凉一凉再喝。

meanings.definition: Used to show what you would prefer or want more.
meanings.example: I would rather play outside than watch TV.
meanings.example_cn: 我宁愿出去玩，也不愿看电视。

meanings.definition: A large black bird similar to a crow.
meanings.example: A raven sat in the tall tree and cawed loudly.
meanings.example_cn: 一只渡鸦坐在高高的树上，呱呱地叫。

meanings.definition: Not cooked.
meanings.example: You can eat carrots raw or cook them for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 胡萝卜可以生吃，也可以煮了当晚饭。

meanings.definition: Not experienced or new to something.
meanings.example: He was raw at playing chess, but he learned quickly with practice.
meanings.example_cn: 他刚开始下国际象棋还很生，但练着练着就学快了。

meanings.definition: To look at letters and words and understand what they mean.
meanings.example: I like to read adventure books before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢睡前读冒险书。

meanings.definition: To say words out loud from a book, sign, or paper.
meanings.example: She will read her poem out loud to the class.
meanings.example_cn: 她会向全班大声朗读她的诗。

meanings.definition: Something that is good or fun to read.
meanings.example: This comic book is a really fun read.
meanings.example_cn: 这本漫画书读起来真的很有趣。

meanings.definition: It means something is actually true or for sure, not pretend or made up.
meanings.example: I really enjoyed the science museum yesterday.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天我在科学博物馆玩得很开心。

meanings.definition: Used to show something is surprising.
meanings.example: You really finished all your homework already?
meanings.example_cn: 你真的已经做完所有作业了？

meanings.definition: The back part of something.
meanings.example: The puppy wagged its tail at the rear of the car.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗在汽车后面摇着尾巴。

meanings.definition: The cause or explanation for something happening.
meanings.example: The reason I was late is because my alarm didn’t go off.
meanings.example_cn: 我迟到的原因是我闹钟没响。

meanings.definition: To think and figure things out in a logical way.
meanings.example: Let’s reason together and find a fair way to share the toys.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们一起推理，找到一个公平分享玩具的办法。

meanings.definition: To be given something or to get something.
meanings.example: I was happy to receive a letter from my pen pal.
meanings.example_cn: 我很高兴收到笔友的来信。

meanings.definition: To suggest someone or something as being good or right for a purpose.
meanings.example: I recommend this book because it’s really interesting.
meanings.example_cn: 我推荐这本书，因为它真的很有趣。

meanings.definition: To save sounds, pictures, or information so you can listen to, watch, or look at them again later.
meanings.example: Dad will record my school play so we can watch it at home.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会录制我的校园演出，这样我们就能在家观看。

meanings.definition: Something written down or saved to remember important information.
meanings.example: The doctor keeps a record of each patient’s visits.
meanings.example_cn: 医生会记录每位病人的就诊情况。

meanings.definition: To reuse materials by making them into something new.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to recycle your plastic bottles after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后别忘了回收你的塑料瓶。

meanings.definition: The colour of strawberries.
meanings.example: I wore my bright red hat to school today.
meanings.example_cn: 我今天戴着鲜红色的帽子去上学。

meanings.definition: The person who makes sure the rules are followed in a game or sport.
meanings.example: The referee blew the whistle to start the soccer match.
meanings.example_cn: 裁判吹响了哨子，开始足球比赛。

meanings.definition: To act as the person who makes sure the rules are followed in a game.
meanings.example: My dad volunteered to referee our basketball game this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我爸爸自愿这个周末为我们的篮球赛当裁判。

meanings.definition: To show an image on a surface, like a mirror.
meanings.example: The lake was so still it could reflect the trees like a mirror.
meanings.example_cn: 湖面静得像镜子一样，能倒映出树木。

meanings.definition: To think quietly and carefully about something.
meanings.example: After the game, we took time to reflect on what went well and what we could improve.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束后，我们花时间回想哪些做得好、哪些可以改进。

meanings.definition: To say “no” to something you do not want to do or accept.
meanings.example: The puppy refused to go outside in the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗不肯在下雨天出门。

meanings.definition: Things people throw away or do not need, like rubbish or trash.
meanings.example: Please put all the refuse in the trash can after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后请把所有垃圾扔进垃圾桶。

meanings.definition: To feel sorry about something that happened.
meanings.example: I regret not studying harder for the test.
meanings.example_cn: 我后悔没有为考试更努力学习。

meanings.definition: A sad or disappointed feeling about something you did or did not do.
meanings.example: My biggest regret was not studying for the test.
meanings.example_cn: 我最大的遗憾就是没有为考试复习。

meanings.definition: To refuse to accept or agree to something.
meanings.example: Lila had to reject the candy because her mum said she could not eat sweets before dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 莱拉不得不拒绝糖果，因为妈妈告诉她饭前不能吃甜食。

meanings.definition: Something or someone that has been rejected or not accepted
meanings.example: The cracked cup was a reject from the factory.
meanings.example_cn: 这个有裂痕的杯子是工厂的次品。

meanings.definition: To become calm or less tense.
meanings.example: Let’s relax by reading a book on the couch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在沙发上看本书放松一下吧。

meanings.definition: Someone or something that you can trust to work well every time.
meanings.example: My dog is a reliable friend who always greets me after school.
meanings.example_cn: 我的狗是可靠的朋友，放学后总是迎接我。

meanings.definition: To keep something in your mind.
meanings.example: Remember to bring your lunch to school tomorrow!
meanings.example_cn: 明天上学记得带午饭！

meanings.definition: To fix something that is broken.
meanings.example: Dad will repair my bike so I can ride it again.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会修好我的自行车，这样我又能骑了。

meanings.definition: The act of fixing something that is broken.
meanings.example: The repair to my bike’s chain was quick and easy.
meanings.example_cn: 我自行车链条的修理又快又简单。

meanings.definition: To do or say something again.
meanings.example: Repeat the words after me to practice your spelling.
meanings.example_cn: 跟着我重复这些词，练习拼写。

meanings.definition: Something that happens or is done again.
meanings.example: This song is so good, I want to listen to it on repeat!
meanings.example_cn: 这首歌太好听了，我想单曲循环！

meanings.definition: To save someone from danger.
meanings.example: The lifeguard jumped into the pool to rescue the boy who was struggling to swim.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员跳进泳池，营救那个游泳时快要呛水、拼命挣扎的男孩。

meanings.definition: The act of saving someone or something from danger.
meanings.example: The firefighters’ rescue of the kitten from the tree made the news.
meanings.example_cn: 消防员把小猫从树上救下来的事上了新闻。

meanings.definition: A feeling of admiration or regard.
meanings.example: We should always show respect to our teachers and classmates.
meanings.example_cn: 我们应该一直尊重老师和同学。

meanings.definition: To treat others kindly and politely.
meanings.example: It’s important to respect your classmates and listen when they talk.
meanings.example_cn: 尊重同学、在他们说话时认真听很重要。

meanings.definition: To admire someone.
meanings.example: We respect our teacher by listening carefully when she talks.
meanings.example_cn: 我们认真听老师讲话，以此表达对她的尊重。

meanings.definition: Being in charge of something or someone.
meanings.example: I am responsible for feeding the cat every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我负责每天早上喂猫。

meanings.definition: When something is the cause of something else happening.
meanings.example: Eating too many sweets was responsible for my sore tummy.
meanings.example_cn: 吃太多甜食导致了我肚子疼。

meanings.definition: A period of relaxing, sleeping, or taking a break.
meanings.example: I took a short rest after playing outside all afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 玩了一下午之后，我休息了一小会儿。

meanings.definition: To stop working or moving so you can relax.
meanings.example: After soccer practice, I need to rest before doing my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 足球训练之后，我得先休息一下再做作业。

meanings.definition: What happens because of something else.
meanings.example: Maya studied hard, and the result was a high score on her math test.
meanings.example_cn: 玛雅努力学习，结果她在数学测试中拿到了高分。

meanings.definition: To happen because of something else.
meanings.example: If you water your plant every day, flowers will result.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你每天给植物浇水，就会开出花来。

meanings.definition: A prize given for good behaviour or work.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a reward for helping clean the house.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈因为我帮忙打扫房子给了我奖励。

meanings.definition: To give a prize or treat for something good that was done.
meanings.example: Mom promised to reward us with ice cream if we cleaned the garage.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈答应如果我们打扫车库，就奖励我们冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: Small grains that people cook and eat, often as part of a meal.
meanings.example: We ate rice and vegetables for dinner last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚我们晚饭吃了米饭和蔬菜。

meanings.definition: Having a lot of money or resources.
meanings.example: The story was about a rich king who shared his gold with others.
meanings.example_cn: 故事讲的是一个富有的国王和别人分享他的金子。

meanings.definition: Having a strong, full, and pleasant taste.
meanings.example: This chocolate cake has a rich, yummy taste.
meanings.example_cn: 这个巧克力蛋糕味道浓郁又好吃。

meanings.definition: Having a lot of something, like nutrients or important qualities.
meanings.example: Spinach is rich in vitamins that help you grow strong.
meanings.example_cn: 菠菜富含维生素，能帮助你长得强壮。

meanings.definition: A question or puzzle that is tricky to answer.
meanings.example: Can you solve this tricky riddle about an animal?
meanings.example_cn: 你能解出这个关于动物的刁钻谜语吗？

meanings.definition: To fill or spread through something, like holes in cheese.
meanings.definition_cn: 布满；弥漫（如奶酪上的洞）
meanings.example: The old tree was riddled with tiny holes from woodpeckers.
meanings.example_cn: 那棵老树被啄木鸟啄得满是小小的洞。

meanings.definition: To sit on and be carried by a vehicle or animal.
meanings.example: We will ride our bikes to the park this afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 今天下午我们骑自行车去公园。

meanings.definition: A trip or journey in a car, bus, or other vehicle.
meanings.example: The roller coaster was the best ride at the amusement park.
meanings.example_cn: 过山车是游乐园里最棒的游乐项目。

meanings.definition: Doing something the correct way or giving the correct answer.
meanings.example: You got the right answer on your maths test!
meanings.example_cn: 你数学考试答对了！

meanings.definition: The direction opposite of left.
meanings.example: Turn right at the corner to get to the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 在拐角处右转就能到操场。

meanings.definition: To make something correct or to fix a mistake.
meanings.example: He tried to right the answer after seeing it was wrong.
meanings.example_cn: 看到答案错了之后，他试着把它纠正过来。

meanings.definition: A small, round band, often worn on a finger.
meanings.example: She wears a silver ring on her finger that sparkles in the light.
meanings.example_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚银戒指，在阳光下闪闪发光。

meanings.definition: To make a sound like a bell does.
meanings.example: I heard the school bell ring for lunchtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我听到学校的铃声响起，到了午饭时间。

meanings.definition: The chance that something bad might happen.
meanings.example: There’s a risk of falling if you climb too high.
meanings.example_cn: 你爬得太高就有摔下来的风险。

meanings.definition: To do something that might be dangerous or cause harm.
meanings.example: Don’t risk running on the slippery floor—you might fall.
meanings.example_cn: 别在湿滑的地板上跑——你可能会摔倒。

meanings.definition: A large stream of water that flows across the land.
meanings.example: We saw ducks swimming in the slow-moving river.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看到鸭子在缓缓流动的河里游水。

meanings.definition: A path made for cars to drive on.
meanings.example: The road to our house is lined with tall trees.
meanings.example_cn: 通往我们家的路两旁种着高大的树。

meanings.definition: To cook food in an oven.
meanings.example: Dad likes to roast vegetables in the oven until they are golden and crispy.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸喜欢把蔬菜放进烤箱烘烤，烤到金黄酥脆。

meanings.definition: Cooked by using dry heat, usually in an oven.
meanings.example: We had roast chicken for dinner, and it was cooked perfectly in the oven.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们吃了烤鸡，在烤箱里烤得刚刚好。

meanings.definition: A piece of meat that is cooked in an oven.
meanings.example: We had a delicious roast for dinner with potatoes and carrots.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们吃了一块美味的烤肉，配土豆和胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: A machine that can do tasks automatically.
meanings.example: The robot helped clean up the toys after playtime.
meanings.example_cn: 玩耍时间结束后，机器人帮忙收拾玩具。

meanings.definition: A big, hard piece of stone found on the ground.
meanings.example: We climbed on the big rock in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我们爬上了公园里那块大石头。

meanings.definition: To move gently back and forth.
meanings.example: She will rock the baby to sleep in her arms.
meanings.example_cn: 她怀里摇晃着宝宝，哄他入睡。

meanings.definition: To shake or cause something to shake.
meanings.example: The earthquake made the ground rock back and forth.
meanings.example_cn: 地震使地面来回晃动。

meanings.definition: The top covering of a building or house.
meanings.example: The cat climbed up to the roof to watch the birds.
meanings.example_cn: 猫爬上了屋顶去看鸟。

meanings.definition: A space inside a building with walls, floor, and ceiling.
meanings.example: I cleaned my room and made my bed before breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 早餐前我打扫了房间、整理了床铺。

meanings.definition: There is enough area or capacity for something or someone.
meanings.example: There’s plenty of room in the car for everyone to sit.
meanings.example_cn: 车里有充足的空间，可以坐下所有人。

meanings.definition: The part of a plant that grows under the ground and takes in water.
meanings.example: The root of the plant was long and strong.
meanings.example_cn: 这棵植物的根又长又壮。

meanings.definition: To support or cheer for.
meanings.example: I root for my favourite team at every game.
meanings.example_cn: 每一场比赛我都为我最喜欢的队伍加油。

meanings.definition: To establish something firmly.
meanings.example: The new trees will root in the garden and start to grow.
meanings.example_cn: 这些新树会在花园里扎根并开始生长。

meanings.definition: Thick, strong string made by twisting fibres together.
meanings.example: We used a rope to tie up the tent during our camping trip.
meanings.example_cn: 露营时我们用绳子把帐篷固定好。

meanings.definition: To tie or fasten with a rope.
meanings.example: Let’s rope the boxes together so they don’t fall off the cart.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把箱子捆在一起，免得从推车上掉下来。

meanings.definition: A prickly bush with pretty, often fragrant flowers.
meanings.example: A red rose grew in the garden and smelled wonderful.
meanings.example_cn: 花园里长着一朵红玫瑰，闻起来香极了。

meanings.definition: To turn around a centre point.
meanings.example: The Earth will rotate once every day.
meanings.example_cn: 地球每天自转一圈。

meanings.definition: Not smooth, feels bumpy or uneven.
meanings.example: The stone felt rough in my hand.
meanings.example_cn: 那块石头在我手里摸起来很粗糙。

meanings.definition: Not exact or precise, just an estimate or a close guess.
meanings.example: Can you give a rough estimate?
meanings.example_cn: 你能给个粗略的估算吗？

meanings.definition: Acting in a way that is harsh, forceful, or not careful.
meanings.example: The puppy played rough and knocked over the blocks.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗玩得很粗暴，把积木碰倒了。

meanings.definition: Shaped like a circle or ball.
meanings.example: The playground had a round sandbox that looked like a giant circle.
meanings.example_cn: 操场上有一个圆形沙坑，看起来像一个大圆圈。

meanings.definition: Moving in a circle or all the way around something.
meanings.example: We marched round the playground during the parade.
meanings.example_cn: 游行时我们绕着操场走圈。

meanings.definition: To make something round in shape.
meanings.example: We will round the corners of the table so they aren’t sharp.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把桌角弄圆，这样就不会扎人。

meanings.definition: The way or path taken to get somewhere.
meanings.example: We took the fastest route to get to grandma’s house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们走最快的路去奶奶家。

meanings.definition: To send or guide along a certain path.
meanings.example: The coach will route the runners along the safest path in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 教练会让跑步者沿公园里最安全的路线跑。

meanings.definition: Things or people arranged in a straight line horizontally.
meanings.example: We sat in the front row at the school assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 学校集会时我们坐在前排。

meanings.definition: A loud argument or fight.
meanings.example: There was a loud row in the hallway when the two classmates argued.
meanings.example_cn: 两个同学吵架时，走廊里响起了大声的争吵。

meanings.definition: To move a boat forward using oars.
meanings.example: We learned how to row the boat across the lake at camp.
meanings.example_cn: 露营时我们学会了怎么把船划过湖。

meanings.definition: To press and move your hand or something else back and forth over a surface.
meanings.example: Please rub some lotion on your dry skin.
meanings.example_cn: 请在你干燥的皮肤上擦一些润肤露。

meanings.definition: An act of rubbing something
meanings.example: A quick rub made the spot disappear from my shirt.
meanings.example_cn: 快速揉搓几下，衬衫上的污渍就不见了。

meanings.definition: Not polite, doing or saying things that can hurt someone’s feelings.
meanings.example: It’s rude to interrupt when someone else is speaking.
meanings.example_cn: 别人说话时打断别人是不礼貌的。

meanings.definition: An instruction or law that must be followed.
meanings.example: There’s a rule that says you must raise your hand before speaking.
meanings.example_cn: 有一条规则说，说话前必须先举手。

meanings.definition: To be in charge of or control something.
meanings.example: The king will rule the land and make important decisions.
meanings.example_cn: 国王会统治这个国家，并做重要的决定。

meanings.definition: A tool for measuring.
meanings.example: Use the ruler to draw a straight line.
meanings.example_cn: 用尺子画一条直线。

meanings.definition: A person who leads a country or group.
meanings.example: The ruler of the kingdom made fair laws for everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 这个王国的统治者制定了公平的法律。

meanings.definition: To move quickly on your feet.
meanings.example: The children run around the playground after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后孩子们在操场跑来跑去。

meanings.definition: To flow or move as a liquid, like water coming out of a tap.
meanings.example: Water will run down the hill after it rains.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨后水会从山上流下来。

meanings.definition: To manage something, like a shop or event.
meanings.example: My mom helps run the school book fair every year.
meanings.example_cn: 每年我妈妈都帮忙操办学校的书展。

meanings.definition: To move or do something quickly because you do not have much time.
meanings.example: We had to rush to catch the last bus.
meanings.example_cn: 我们得赶紧去赶最后一班公交车。

meanings.definition: A fast movement, often because you are in a hurry.
meanings.example: There was a rush to the door when the school bell rang.
meanings.example_cn: 下课铃一响，大家冲向门口。

meanings.definition: Feeling unhappy or upset.
meanings.example: I was sad when my favourite toy broke.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的玩具坏了，我很伤心。

meanings.definition: Protected from harm, not in danger.
meanings.example: Always wear a helmet to stay safe when biking.
meanings.example_cn: 骑车时一定要戴头盔以保证安全。

meanings.definition: A strong metal box with a lock where people keep money or valuables.
meanings.example: She puts the jewels in the safe.
meanings.example_cn: 她把珠宝放进保险箱里。

meanings.definition: To travel on water in a boat.
meanings.example: We will sail across the lake in a small boat this afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 今天下午我们乘小船划过湖。

meanings.definition: A trip or journey in a boat, especially when you travel smoothly on the water.
meanings.example: We went for a relaxing sail on the lake last weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 上周末我们在湖上惬意地航行了一圈。

meanings.definition: A piece of fabric on a boat that catches wind to move it.
meanings.example: The boat’s white sail filled with wind and moved us across the lake.
meanings.example_cn: 船的白帆兜满了风，载着我们划过湖面。

meanings.definition: A dish made with raw vegetables, often mixed with dressing.
meanings.example: I made a healthy salad with lettuce, tomato, and carrots.
meanings.example_cn: 我做了一份健康的沙拉，里面有生菜、西红柿和胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: When goods are exchanged for money.
meanings.example: The sale of the old car gave us enough money to buy a new bike.
meanings.example_cn: 卖掉旧汽车的钱，够我们买一辆新自行车了。

meanings.definition: An event where things are sold at lower prices.
meanings.example: There’s a sale at the toy store, so everything costs less today.
meanings.example_cn: 玩具店在打折，所以今天所有东西都更便宜。

meanings.definition: The white crystals you add to food to make it taste better.
meanings.example: Sprinkle some salt on your popcorn for extra flavour.
meanings.example_cn: 往爆米花上撒点盐，增加风味。

meanings.definition: To add salt to food.
meanings.example: Please salt your popcorn if you want more flavour.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你想要味道更足，可以给爆米花撒点盐。

meanings.definition: Tasting of or containing salt.
meanings.example: The popcorn tasted very salty because of all the butter.
meanings.example_cn: 爆米花因为放了很多黄油，吃起来很咸。

meanings.definition: Exactly alike, not different at all.
meanings.definition_cn: 完全相同的；一模一样的
meanings.example: We wore the same costume for the school play.
meanings.example_cn: 学校话剧我们穿了同样的服装。

meanings.definition: Tiny grains that cover beaches and deserts.
meanings.example: I like to dig in the sand and look for seashells.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢在沙子里挖掘，寻找贝壳。

meanings.definition: To smooth a surface with sandpaper
meanings.example: Dad will sand the rough wood to make it smooth.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会打磨粗糙的木头，让它变得光滑。

meanings.definition: Food made with two slices of bread and something inside, like cheese or meat.
meanings.example: My favourite sandwich is peanut butter and jelly.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的三明治是花生酱和果酱的。

meanings.definition: To fit tightly between two other things, like the filling in bread.
meanings.example: I was sandwiched between two large men.
meanings.example_cn: 我被夹在两个大男人中间。

meanings.definition: Feeling happy because you have what you want or need.
meanings.example: I felt satisfied after finishing my big bowl of soup.
meanings.example_cn: 喝完一大碗汤后我感到心满意足。

meanings.definition: To meet a rule or requirement.
meanings.example: You must satisfy all the homework rules to get a good grade.
meanings.example_cn: 你必须遵守所有作业要求，才能拿到好成绩。

meanings.definition: To make someone happy by giving them what they want or need.
meanings.example: The big piece of cake was enough to satisfy my hunger.
meanings.example_cn: 这一大块蛋糕足够填饱我的肚子。

meanings.definition: The seventh day of the week.
meanings.example: Saturday is the best day to sleep in and relax.
meanings.example_cn: 星期六是睡懒觉和放松的最佳日子。

meanings.definition: A liquid or soft food served on or with other foods to give flavour.
meanings.example: Mom poured tomato sauce over the spaghetti.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈把番茄酱浇在意大利面上。

meanings.definition: Minced meat stuffed in a skin, cooked and eaten.
meanings.example: We had sausage and eggs for breakfast today.
meanings.example_cn: 我们今天早餐吃了香肠和鸡蛋。

meanings.definition: To protect from harm or loss.
meanings.example: She helped save her friend by catching him before he fell.
meanings.example_cn: 在朋友摔倒之前，她一把扶住他，救下了朋友。

meanings.definition: The act of stopping something bad from happening, like catching a ball in sports.
meanings.example: The goalie made an amazing save and stopped the ball from going into the net.
meanings.example_cn: 守门员做出了一个精彩的扑救，挡住了进门的球。

meanings.definition: To keep something in a safe place so you can use it later.
meanings.example: Always save your work on the computer so you don’t lose it.
meanings.example_cn: 在电脑上一定要随时保存，免得弄丢。

meanings.definition: A tool with a sharp edge used for cutting wood or other materials.
meanings.example: Dad used a saw to cut the wooden board in half.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸用一把锯子把木板锯成两半。

meanings.definition: To cut something using a saw tool.
meanings.example: He sawed the plank in half.
meanings.example_cn: 他把木板锯成了两半。

meanings.definition: To speak words out loud.
meanings.example: Please say your name clearly so everyone can hear.
meanings.example_cn: 请清楚地报出你的名字，让大家都能听到。

meanings.definition: The size or level of something.
meanings.example: The scale of the playground was much bigger than I expected.
meanings.example_cn: 操场的规模比我想象的要大得多。

meanings.definition: To climb up something, like a wall or mountain.
meanings.example: They scaled the mountain in five hours.
meanings.example_cn: 他们花了五个小时攀登那座山。

meanings.definition: A tool that measures how much something weighs.
meanings.example: Please step on the scale so the doctor can check your weight.
meanings.example_cn: 请站到秤上，让医生检查你的体重。

meanings.definition: A mark left on the skin after a wound has healed.
meanings.example: He has a little scar on his knee from when he fell.
meanings.example_cn: 他膝盖上有一个小时候摔跤留下的小疤痕。

meanings.definition: To hurt someone’s feelings or mind in a way that can last a long time, even after the bad thing is over.
meanings.example: The accident scarred her for life.
meanings.example_cn: 那次事故给她留下了终身的心灵创伤。

meanings.definition: To make someone suddenly afraid.
meanings.example: The loud thunder can scare our puppy.
meanings.example_cn: 响雷会吓到我们的小狗。

meanings.definition: A sudden moment when you feel frightened.
meanings.example: That loud noise gave me a real scare last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚那声巨响真把我吓了一跳。

meanings.definition: Feeling afraid or frightened.
meanings.example: I was scared during the thunderstorm last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚雷雨时我很害怕。

meanings.definition: A piece of cloth worn around the neck.
meanings.example: I wore a warm scarf around my neck on the cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷时我在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

meanings.definition: Causing someone to feel fear.
meanings.example: That movie was so scary, I had to cover my eyes!
meanings.example_cn: 那部电影太吓人了，我不得不捂住眼睛！

meanings.definition: A smell, often a nice one.
meanings.example: The scent of cookies baking made my mouth water.
meanings.example_cn: 烤饼干的香味让我流口水。

meanings.definition: To smell something or notice its smell.
meanings.example: I could scent the cookies baking as soon as I came home.
meanings.example_cn: 我一回到家就闻到了烤饼干的香味。

meanings.definition: A place where children go to learn from teachers.
meanings.example: School starts at eight o’clock every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 学校每天早上八点开始上课。

meanings.definition: A group of fish.
meanings.example: A school of fish swam past our boat.
meanings.example_cn: 一群鱼游过我们的船边。

meanings.definition: A deep spoon for serving or picking up things.
meanings.example: Use the scoop to put ice cream in your bowl.
meanings.example_cn: 用勺子把冰淇淋舀到你的碗里。

meanings.definition: To pick up or take out something using a scoop or spoon.
meanings.example: I will scoop some ice cream into your bowl.
meanings.example_cn: 我给你的碗里舀一些冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: The range or area that something covers.
meanings.example: The scope of our project is to learn about planets.
meanings.example_cn: 我们这个项目的范围是了解行星。

meanings.definition: The number of points made in a game or test.
meanings.example: Our team got the highest score in the game.
meanings.example_cn: 我们队在比赛中得了最高分。

meanings.definition: To get points in a game or contest.
meanings.example: He scored a goal in the last minute.
meanings.example_cn: 他在最后一分钟进了一球。

meanings.definition: A small animal with eight legs and a stinger in its tail.
meanings.example: We learned about the scorpion and its stinger in science.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在科学课上学习了蝎子及其毒刺。

meanings.definition: To rub or mark with something sharp.
meanings.example: My cat likes to scratch the couch with her claws.
meanings.example_cn: 我的猫喜欢用爪子抓沙发。

meanings.definition: A line or mark made by scraping or rubbing something sharp.
meanings.example: There’s a scratch on my knee from where I fell off my bike.
meanings.example_cn: 我从自行车上摔下来，膝盖上有一道刮痕。

meanings.definition: To shout or cry out very loudly, usually when scared or excited.
meanings.example: The children scream with excitement when they see the fireworks.
meanings.example_cn: 孩子们看到烟花时兴奋地尖叫起来。

meanings.definition: A loud, sudden cry made when someone is scared or excited.
meanings.example: She let out a loud scream when she saw the spider.
meanings.example_cn: 她看到蜘蛛时发出了一声尖叫。

meanings.definition: The huge body of salty water that covers much of the Earth.
meanings.example: We saw dolphins jumping in the blue sea by the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看见海豚在沙滩边的蓝色大海里跳跃。

meanings.definition: A very large amount or number of something.
meanings.example: There was a sea of balloons at the birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 生日派对上有一大堆气球。

meanings.definition: A large mammal that eats fish and lives both in the sea and on land or ice.
meanings.example: The seal clapped its flippers at the aquarium show.
meanings.example_cn: 海豹在水族馆表演时拍动它的鳍。

meanings.definition: To close something tightly so nothing can get in or out.
meanings.example: She sealed the envelope with wax.
meanings.example_cn: 她用蜡封住了信封。

meanings.definition: One of the four parts of the year (spring, summer, autumn, winter).
meanings.example: My favourite season is winter because I love snow.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的季节是冬天，因为我喜欢雪。

meanings.definition: To add things like salt or pepper to food so it tastes yummy.
meanings.example: Dad likes to season the soup with herbs so it has more flavour.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸喜欢往汤里加香草调味，让它更有味道。

meanings.definition: Something made for sitting on.
meanings.example: I saved a seat for you next to me.
meanings.example_cn: 我在我旁边给你留了个座位。

meanings.definition: To give someone a place to sit.
meanings.example: The usher will seat us near the front for the play.
meanings.example_cn: 引座员会把我们安排在靠近前面的位置看戏。

meanings.definition: Coming right after the first.
meanings.example: I finished second in the spelling contest.
meanings.example_cn: 我在拼字比赛中得了第二名。

meanings.definition: A very short amount of time, with sixty seconds in one minute.
meanings.example: The light turned green just a second ago.
meanings.example_cn: 就在一秒钟前，灯变绿了。

meanings.definition: To support someone’s idea or suggestion.
meanings.example: I second your idea to have pizza for lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 我赞成你吃披萨当午饭的想法。

meanings.definition: To notice with your eyes.
meanings.example: Can you see the tiny ladybug on the leaf?
meanings.example_cn: 你能看到叶子上的那只小瓢虫吗？

meanings.definition: To understand or figure out something, not just with your eyes.
meanings.example: Now I see what you meant about the puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 现在我明白你说这道谜题是什么意思了。

meanings.definition: The small part of a plant that you put in the ground to grow a new plant.
meanings.example: We planted a tiny seed and watched it grow into a sunflower.
meanings.example_cn: 我们种下一颗小小的种子，看着它长成一株向日葵。

meanings.definition: To put seeds into soil so new plants will grow.
meanings.example: They seeded the lawn in spring.
meanings.example_cn: 他们春天在草坪上播种。

meanings.definition: To look or appear to be a certain way.
meanings.example: You seem happy today with your bright smile.
meanings.example_cn: 你带着灿烂的笑容，今天看起来很开心。

meanings.definition: To choose one thing or person from a group.
meanings.example: Please select your favourite flavour of ice cream.
meanings.example_cn: 请挑选你最喜欢的冰淇淋口味。

meanings.definition: The act of choosing something from a group.
meanings.example: There was a big selection of books in the library.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆里有大量的书可供选择。

meanings.definition: A person’s own identity or sense of who they are.
meanings.example: After a long vacation, Max finally felt like his happy self again.
meanings.example_cn: 长假过后，麦克斯终于变回那个开心的自己了。

meanings.definition: To exchange something for money.
meanings.example: We will sell lemonade at our stand to raise money for charity.
meanings.example_cn: 我们会在小摊上卖柠檬水，为慈善筹款。

meanings.definition: To make something go or be taken to another place or person.
meanings.example: I will send you a postcard from my trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我会从旅途中给你寄一张明信片。

meanings.definition: Any of the five ways your body understands the world, like sight or touch.
meanings.example: My sense of smell helps me know when cookies are baking.
meanings.example_cn: 我的嗅觉能让我知道什么时候在烤饼干。

meanings.definition: To notice or become aware of something.
meanings.example: I can sense when my dog is feeling sad.
meanings.example_cn: 我能感觉到我的狗什么时候难过。

meanings.definition: A group of words that tells a complete idea.
meanings.example: Try to write a complete sentence about your weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 试着写一个关于你周末的完整句子。

meanings.definition: To declare someone's punishment in a court of law
meanings.example: The judge will sentence the person after the trial.
meanings.example_cn: 审判结束之后，法官将会对这个人宣判。

meanings.definition: The ninth month of the year.
meanings.example: September is when school usually starts for us.
meanings.example_cn: 九月通常是我们开学的时候。

meanings.definition: A dark shape made when something blocks light.
meanings.example: My shadow followed me as I walked in the sunlight.
meanings.example_cn: 我在阳光下走路时，影子跟着我。

meanings.definition: To secretly follow someone.
meanings.example: A detective might shadow someone to see where they go.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探可能会跟踪某人，看他去哪里。

meanings.definition: To move something quickly back and forth.
meanings.example: Sam began to shake with excitement when he saw his birthday cake.
meanings.example_cn: 萨姆看到生日蛋糕时，激动得浑身发抖。

meanings.definition: The act of moving something quickly back and forth.
meanings.example: Give the bottle a shake before opening it.
meanings.example_cn: 打开前先摇一摇瓶子。

meanings.definition: Used to politely ask if someone wants to do something or to offer an idea.
meanings.definition_cn: （礼貌征求意见、提建议）要不要…，可以… 吗，继续吗？
meanings.example: Shall we play outside after lunch?
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们去外面玩好吗？

meanings.definition: A word showing something will happen in the future (often used formally).
meanings.example: Heavy rain shall continue throughout the night.
meanings.example_cn: 大雨将持续一整夜。

meanings.definition: Not deep, only a little distance from top to bottom.
meanings.example: The shallow pool is safe for babies to play in.
meanings.example_cn: 浅水池对婴儿来说是安全的，可以玩。

meanings.definition: A feeling of guilt.
meanings.example: He felt shame after breaking the vase and not telling the truth.
meanings.example_cn: 打碎花瓶又没说实话之后，他感到羞愧。

meanings.definition: To make someone feel embarrassed or bad about what they did.
meanings.example: Don’t shame someone for making a mistake; everyone messes up sometimes.
meanings.example_cn: 不要因为别人犯错就羞辱他；谁都有搞砸的时候。

meanings.definition: A feeling of embarrassment.
meanings.example: I felt a little shame when I spilled juice on the carpet in front of everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 当着所有人的面把果汁洒在地毯上，我有点不好意思。

meanings.definition: The form or outline of something.
meanings.example: The cookie cutter makes the dough into the shape of a star.
meanings.example_cn: 饼干模子把面团压成星星的形状。

meanings.definition: To form or mold something into a certain look.
meanings.example: Let’s shape the clay into a funny animal.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把黏土捏成一只好玩的动物吧。

meanings.definition: To give some of what you have to others.
meanings.example: Remember to share your crayons with your friends.
meanings.example_cn: 记得和朋友分享你的蜡笔。

meanings.definition: A part or piece that belongs to someone.
meanings.example: I had my share of pizza and let my brother have the last piece.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了自己那份披萨，把最后一块留给弟弟。

meanings.definition: A large, powerful fish with sharp teeth that lives in the sea.
meanings.example: The shark swam quickly through the deep ocean.
meanings.example_cn: 鲨鱼在深海中快速游动。

meanings.definition: Having a thin edge or point that can cut things easily.
meanings.example: Be careful with that knife; it’s very sharp.
meanings.example_cn: 小心那把刀，它非常锋利。

meanings.definition: Exactly on time, not late.
meanings.example: The meeting starts at seven o'clock sharp.
meanings.example_cn: 会议在七点整开始。

meanings.definition: A word for a girl or woman.
meanings.example: She dances gracefully during ballet class.
meanings.example_cn: 她在芭蕾课上优雅地跳舞。

meanings.definition: A farm animal with woolly hair, often kept for its wool.
meanings.example: The sheep in the field have thick, woolly coats.
meanings.example_cn: 田野里的羊有厚厚的羊毛。

meanings.definition: A large piece of fabric for a bed.
meanings.example: I put a clean sheet on my bed every week.
meanings.example_cn: 我每周都在床上换一张干净的床单。

meanings.definition: A single piece of paper.
meanings.example: Please hand me a sheet of paper for my drawing.
meanings.example_cn: 请递给我一张纸来画画。

meanings.definition: A thin, flat piece of something.
meanings.example: The baker placed a sheet of dough on the table to make cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 面包师把一片擀好的面团放在桌上做饼干。

meanings.definition: A flat board to hold things.
meanings.example: Put your books back on the shelf when you’re done reading.
meanings.example_cn: 看完书把书放回架子上。

meanings.definition: The hard outer covering of something, like a nut or an animal.
meanings.example: I found a pretty shell on the sandy beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我在沙滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

meanings.definition: To remove the hard outside covering from something, like a nut or pea.
meanings.example: She shelled the peas.
meanings.example_cn: 她给豌豆剥了壳。

meanings.definition: To give off light or be bright.
meanings.example: The sun will shine brightly in the sky today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天太阳会在天空中明亮地照耀。

meanings.definition: Bright light.
meanings.example: The car had a nice shine after Dad washed and polished it.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸洗完并打了蜡之后，车闪闪发亮。

meanings.definition: Bright and glossy.
meanings.example: Her new shoes are so shiny, they sparkle in the light.
meanings.example_cn: 她的新鞋亮闪闪的，在光线下闪闪发光。

meanings.definition: A very large boat used on the sea.
meanings.example: The ship sailed across the wide sea.
meanings.example_cn: 船驶过宽阔的大海。

meanings.definition: To send something somewhere, often by boat or another transport.
meanings.example: The goods will be shipped next week.
meanings.example_cn: 货物下周会装运。

meanings.definition: Clothing worn on the upper body, often with buttons.
meanings.example: I spilled juice on my clean shirt at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭时我把果汁洒在了干净的衬衫上。

meanings.definition: To shake a little, usually from cold or fear.
meanings.example: I always shiver when I get out of the pool on a cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷时我从泳池出来总会发抖。

meanings.definition: A small shake or tremble, often from being cold or scared.
meanings.example: He gave a little shiver when he stepped into the cold pool.
meanings.example_cn: 他走进冷水池时轻轻打了个哆嗦。

meanings.definition: A sudden and surprising event.
meanings.example: It was a shock to see snow falling in April.
meanings.example_cn: 四月看到下雪真让人震惊。

meanings.definition: To surprise someone in a strong or sudden way.
meanings.example: It may shock you to know that I’ve never eaten sushi!
meanings.example_cn: 告诉你我从没吃过寿司，可能会吓你一跳！

meanings.definition: A strong, sudden, and unpleasant feeling.
meanings.example: When Sam saw the broken window and realized someone had broken in, he felt a terrible shock and started to cry.
meanings.example_cn: 山姆看见破碎的窗户，意识到有人闯进来了，他吓坏了，哭了起来。

meanings.definition: Something you wear on your foot to protect it.
meanings.example: My new shoe lights up when I walk.
meanings.example_cn: 我的新鞋走路时会发光。

meanings.definition: A place where you buy things.
meanings.example: We stopped at the shop to buy some ice cream.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在商店停下来买了点冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: To go to stores to look at things and buy what you need or want.
meanings.example: We will shop for new school supplies this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我们这周末要去购买新的学习用品。

meanings.definition: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or river.
meanings.example: We walked along the shore and collected colourful stones.
meanings.example_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，收集彩色的石头。

meanings.definition: To support or hold something up so it doesn’t fall.
meanings.example: The fence was shored up with posts.
meanings.example_cn: 栅栏用柱子加固了。

meanings.definition: Not long in length or time.
meanings.example: We took a short walk to the park before dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭前，我们步行一小段路去了公园。

meanings.definition: Not tall and having little height.
meanings.example: My little brother is still short, so he needs help reaching the sink.
meanings.example_cn: 我的弟弟个子还矮，所以要别人帮忙才能够到洗手池。

meanings.definition: Clothes you wear on the bottom half of your body, like trousers but with short legs, so they only cover part of your legs.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to pack your shorts for sports day—it’s going to be really hot!
meanings.example_cn: 运动会别忘了带上短裤，天气会非常热！

meanings.definition: A try or attempt at doing something.
meanings.example: He took a shot at making the basketball, but it bounced off the rim.
meanings.example_cn: 他试着投那个篮球，但球弹筐而出。

meanings.definition: The firing of a gun or other weapon.
meanings.example: The loud shot scared the birds away.
meanings.example_cn: 巨大的枪声把鸟儿都吓跑了。

meanings.definition: A small amount of medicine given with a needle.
meanings.example: I got a flu shot at the doctor’s office.
meanings.example_cn: 我在诊所打了流感疫苗。

meanings.definition: Used for advice or to tell what is right to do.
meanings.example: You should eat vegetables because they are healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 你应该吃蔬菜，因为它们对健康有益。

meanings.definition: The part of the body where the arm attaches.
meanings.example: I carried my backpack on my shoulder as I walked to school.
meanings.example_cn: 我走路上学的时候把书包挎在肩上。

meanings.definition: To carry something by resting it on your shoulder.
meanings.example: Let me shoulder your backpack so you don’t get tired on the hike.
meanings.example_cn: 我来帮你背包吧，这样你徒步时就不会累。

meanings.definition: To say something very loudly.
meanings.example: Don’t shout in the library; use your quiet voice.
meanings.example_cn: 不要在图书馆大声喊叫，用你安静的声音。

meanings.definition: A loud cry or call made with your voice.
meanings.example: We heard a shout for help.
meanings.example_cn: 我们听到了一声呼救。

meanings.definition: To let someone see something.
meanings.example: Can you show me your favourite dance move?
meanings.example_cn: 你能给我看看你最喜欢的舞蹈动作吗？

meanings.definition: To be easy to see or to be visible.
meanings.example: The rainbow will show after the rain stops.
meanings.example_cn: 雨停后彩虹会出现。

meanings.definition: A performance with singing, dancing, or acting for an audience.
meanings.example: We watched a funny show with singing and dancing.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看了一场有唱歌又有跳舞的精彩演出。

meanings.definition: When water sprays from above so you can wash your body.
meanings.example: I take a shower every night before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天晚上睡觉前都冲澡。

meanings.definition: To wash your body while standing under running water.
meanings.example: I like to shower after playing outside because it makes me feel fresh.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完之后我喜欢冲个澡，这样感觉清爽。

meanings.definition: A short time when it rains.
meanings.example: We had a quick shower of rain right before recess.
meanings.example_cn: 课间休息前我们刚遇了一阵急雨。

meanings.definition: A small torn or cut piece.
meanings.example: There was a shred of paper left on my desk after I finished my project.
meanings.example_cn: 做完作品后，我的桌上还留着一小片碎纸。

meanings.definition: To tear something into thin, small pieces.
meanings.example: Let’s shred the old papers before we throw them away.
meanings.example_cn: 扔掉旧文件之前我们先把它们碎掉。

meanings.definition: A small sea animal with a shell, often pink, that people eat.
meanings.example: We saw pink shrimp swimming in the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看见粉色的虾在水族馆里游动。

meanings.definition: To close something so it is not open.
meanings.example: Please shut the door so the cold air stays out.
meanings.example_cn: 请关上门，让冷空气进不来。

meanings.definition: Closed or not open.
meanings.example: The door was shut, so we knocked before going in.
meanings.example_cn: 门关着，所以我们进去前敲了敲门。

meanings.definition: Feeling nervous or timid around other people.
meanings.example: I feel shy when meeting new people.
meanings.example_cn: 见到新朋友时我会害羞。

meanings.definition: To suddenly move back because of fear.
meanings.example: The horse shied at the noise.
meanings.example_cn: 马被那声音吓了一跳。

meanings.definition: Feeling unwell or experiencing illness.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school because I felt sick.
meanings.example_cn: 我感觉不舒服，所以没去上学待在家里。

meanings.definition: Very unpleasant or disgusting.
meanings.example: The smell from the garbage can was so sick I had to hold my nose.
meanings.example_cn: 垃圾桶的味道太恶心了，我只好捂住鼻子。

meanings.definition: The edge or surface of something.
meanings.example: The playground has a slide on each side.
meanings.example_cn: 操场的两边各有一个滑梯。

meanings.definition: Either the left or right part of something.
meanings.example: She hurt the right side of her foot while running.
meanings.example_cn: 她跑步时伤了右脚。

meanings.definition: A team or group in a game or competition.
meanings.example: Our side cheered loudly when we scored a goal.
meanings.example_cn: 当我们进球时，我们队大声欢呼。

meanings.definition: To let out a long breath, often to show sadness or relief.
meanings.example: After finishing her homework, Lily sighed with relief.
meanings.example_cn: 莉莉做完作业后，松了一口气。

meanings.definition: A long, slow breath that you can hear, often showing sadness or relief.
meanings.example: She let out a big sigh when she finished her homework.
meanings.example_cn: 做完作业之后她长长地叹了口气。

meanings.definition: The ability to see things with your eyes.
meanings.example: Owls have very good sight at night.
meanings.example_cn: 猫头鹰在夜间拥有很好的视力。

meanings.definition: To catch a quick look at something.
meanings.example: They sighted land after weeks at sea.
meanings.example_cn: 在海上航行了数周后，他们看到了陆地。

meanings.definition: A mark, gesture, or symbol that gives information.
meanings.example: The stop sign tells cars where to stop.
meanings.example_cn: 停止标志告诉汽车该在哪里停。

meanings.definition: To write your name to show you agree or approve.
meanings.example: Please sign your name at the bottom of the permission slip.
meanings.example_cn: 请在同意书的底部签上你的名字。

meanings.definition: A sound or gesture used to send a message.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a signal to come inside for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈给了我一个信号，叫我进屋吃晚饭。

meanings.definition: To make a sign or motion to give information or instructions.
meanings.example: Raise your hand to signal the teacher if you need help.
meanings.example_cn: 需要帮助时举手示意老师。

meanings.definition: The state of being completely quiet.
meanings.example: There was complete silence in the library.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆里一片寂静。

meanings.definition: To make someone or something quiet.
